4.278: skal thi fon them hôhoston heƀankuninge

4.280: ne sô mâri mid mannun, hwand siu kumid thurh maht godes
4.281: an [these] wîdon werold." Thô warð [eft] thes wîbes hugi
4.283: an godes willeon. "[Than] ik hêr garu standu", quað siu,

4.286: werðe mi aftar thînun wordun, al sô is willeo sî,

4.330: [giwendid] aftar them wordun, that he im te them wîƀa genam,

5.414: Afhôƀun thô [hêlagna] sang, thô sie eft te heƀanwanga
5.415: wundun thurh thiu wolkan. Thea wardos hôrdun,
5.416: hwô thiu engilo kraft alomahtigna god
5.420: endi friðu an erðu firiho barnun,
5.423: that sie mahtig thing gimanod habda,
5.425: nahtes sîðon; was im niud mikil,

6.427: Habda im the engil godes al giwîsid
6.428: torhtun têknun, that sie [im tô] selƀun,
6.432: waldande mid iro wordun endi wîdo [kûðdun]
6.433: oƀar thea berhtun burg, hwilik im thar [biliði] warð
6.435: fagar an felde. That [frî] al biheld
6.437: thiu magað an ira môde, sô hwat sô siu gihôrda thea mann sprekan.
6.438: Fôdda ina thô fagaro frîho skâniosta,
6.439: thiu môdar thurh minnea managaro drohtin,
6.441: an them ahtodon daga erlos managa,
6.442: swîðo glawa gumon mid thera godes thiornun,
6.443: that he Hêleand te namon hebbean skoldi,
6.444: sô it the godes engil Gabriel gisprak
6.445: wâron wordun endi them wîƀe gibôd,
6.446: bodo drohtines, thô siu êrist that barn antfeng
6.447: wânum te thesero weroldi. Was iru willeo mikil,
6.448: that siu ina sô [hêlaglîko] haldan môsti,
6.449: fulgeng im thô sô gerno. That gêr furðor skrêd
6.450: untthat that friðubarn godes fiwartig habda
6.451: dago endi nahto. Thô skoldun sie thar êna dâd frummean,
6.452: that sie ina te Hierusalem [forgeƀan] skoldun
6.453: waldanda te them wîha. [Sô] was iro wîsa than,
6.454: thero liudeo landsidu, that that ni môsta forlâtan negên
6.455: idis undar Ebreon, ef iru [at] [êrist] warð
6.456: sunu afôdit, ne siu ina simbla [tharod]
6.457: te them godes wîha forgeƀan skolda.
6.458: Giwitun im thô thiu gôdun twê, Joseph endi Maria
6.459: bêðiu fon Bethleem: habdun that barn mid im,
6.460: hêlagna Krist, sôhtun im hûs godes
6.461: an Hierusalem; thar skoldun sie is geld frummean
6.463: Judeo folkes. Thar fundun sea ênna gôdan man
6.465: [the] habda [at] them wîha sô filu wintro endi sumaro
6.466: gilibd an them liohta: oft warhta he thar lof goda
6.467: mid hluttru hugi; habda im hêlagna gêst,
6.470: langa hwîla, that he ni môsta [êr] thit lioht ageƀan,
6.471: wendean af thesero weroldi, êr than im the willeo gistôdi,
6.473: hêlagna heƀankuning. Thô warð im is hugi swîðo
6.474: blîði an is briostun, thô he gisah that [barn] kuman
6.475: [an thena wîh innan]. [Thuo sagda hie waldande thank],
6.476: almahtigon gode, thes he ina mid is ôgun gisah.
6.477: Geng im thô tegegnes endi ina gerno antfeng
6.478: ald mid is armun: al antkende
6.479: bôkan endi biliði endi ôk that barn godes,
6.480: hêlagna heƀankuning. "Nu ik thi, [hêrro], skal", quað he,
6.481: "gerno biddean, nu ik sus gigamalod bium,
6.482: that thu thînan holdan [skalk] [nu] hinan hwerƀan lâtas,
6.483: an [thîna friðuwâra] faran, thar êr mîna forðrun dedun,
6.484: weros fon thesero weroldi, nu mi the willeo gistôd,
6.485: dago lioƀosto, that ik mînan drohtin gisah,
6.486: holdan hêrron, sô mi gihêtan was
6.487: langa hwîla. Thu bist lioht mikil
6.488: allun elithiodun, thea êr thes alowaldon
6.489: kraft ne antkendun. Thîna kumi sindun
6.490: te dôma endi te diurðon, drohtin frô mîn,
6.492: thînun lioƀun liudiun." Listiun talde thô
6.493: the aldo man an [them] alaha [idis] thero gôdun,
6.494: sagda sôðlîko, hwô iro sunu skolda
6.496: sumun te falle, sumun te frôƀru firiho [barnun],
6.497: them liudiun te leoƀa, the is lêrun gihôrdin,
6.498: endi them te harma, the hôrien ni [weldin]
6.499: Kristas lêron. "Thu skalt noh", quað he, "kara thiggean,
6.500: harm [an thînumu] herton, than ina heliðo barn
6.501: wâpnun wîtnod. That wirðid thi werk mikil,
6.502: thrim te githolonna." Thiu thiorna al forstôd
6.503: wîsas mannas word. Thô quam thar ôk ên wîf gangan
6.504: ald innan [them] alaha: Anna was siu hêtan,
6.505: dohtar Fanueles; siu habde ira drohtine wel
6.506: githionod te thanka, was iru [githungan] wîf.
6.507: Siu môsta aftar ira magaðhêdi, sîðor siu mannes warð,
6.509: sô môsta siu mid ira brûdigumon [bôdlo] giwaldan
6.510: siƀun wintar [saman]. Thô gifragn ik that iru thar sorga gistôd
6.511: that [sie] thiu mikila maht metodes tedêlda,
6.512: wurêð [wurdigiskapu]. Thô was siu widowa aftar thiu
6.514: wintro an iro weroldi, sô siu nia thana wîh ni forlêt,
6.515: ak siu thar ira drohtine [wel] dages endi nahtes,
6.516: gode thionode. [Siu] quam thar ôk gangan tô
6.517: an thea selƀun tîd: sân antkende
6.518: that [hêlage] barn godes endi them [heliðon] kûðde,
6.519: them weroda aftar [them] wîha wilspel mikil,
6.520: quað that im neriandas ginist ginâhid wâri,
6.521: helpa heƀenkuninges: "nu is the hêlago Krist,
6.522: waldand selƀo an thesan wîh kuman
6.523: te [alôsienne] thea liudi, the hêr nu lango [bidun]
6.525: [thurftig] thioda, sô nu thes thinges mugun
6.527: werod aftar [them] wîha: gihôrdun wilspel mikil
6.528: fon gode seggean. That geld habde thô gilêstid
6.529: thiu idis an [them] alaha, [al] sô it im an ira êwa gibôd
6.531: hêlagaro handgiwerk. Giwitun im thô te hûs thanan
6.535: managaro mundboron, sô it gio mâri ni warð
6.536: than wîdor an thesaro weroldi, [bûtan] sô is willeo geng,

7.538: Krist antkendi, thoh ni warð it gio te thes kuninges hoƀe
7.539: them mannun gimârid, thea im an iro môdseƀon
7.540: holde ni wârun, ak was im sô bihalden forð
7.541: mid wordun endi mid werkun, antthat thar weros ôstan,
7.543: threa te thero thiodu, thegnos snelle,
7.544: [an] langan weg oƀar that land tharod:
7.545: folgodun ênun berhtun [bôkne] endi sôhtun that barn godes
7.546: mid hluttru hugi: weldun im hnîgan tô,
7.547: [gehan] im te jungrun: driƀun im godes giskapu.
7.548: Thô sie Erodesan thar rîkean fundun
7.550: môdagna mid is mannun: - [simbla] was he [morðes] gern -
7.551: thô quaddun sie ina kûsko an kuning[wîsun],
7.552: fagaro an is flettie, endi he frâgoda sân,
7.554: weros an thana wuraksîð: "hweðer lêdiad gi [wundan] gold
7.555: te geƀu hwilikun gumuno? te huî gi [thus] an ganga kumad,
7.556: gifaran an [fôðiu]? Hwat, gi [nêthwanan] ferran sind
7.557: erlos fon ôðrun thiodun. Ik [gisihu] that gi sind eðili[giburdiun]
7.558: kunnies fon knôsle gôdun: nio hêr êr sulika kumana ni wurðun
7.559: [êri] fon ôðrun thiodun, sîðor ik môsta thesas erlo folkes,
7.560: giwaldan [thesas] wîdon rîkeas. Gi skulun mi te wârun seggean
7.561: for thesun liudio folke, [bihwî] gi sîn te thesun lande [kumana]".
7.562: Thô sprâkun im eft [tegegnes] gumon ôstronea,
7.563: wordspâhe weros: "wi thi te wârun mugun", quâðun sie,
7.565: giseggean sôðlîko, [bihwî] wi quâmun an thesan sið herod
7.566: fon [ôstan] [te] thesaro erðu. Giu wârun thar aðalies man,
7.567: gôdsprâkea gumon, thea ûs gôdes sô filu,
7.569: wârum wordun. Than was thar ên [giwittig] man,
7.570: frôd endi filuwîs - forn was that giu -,
7.571: ûse aldiro ôstar hinan, - thar ni warð sîðor ênig man
7.572: sprâkono sô [spâhi] -; [he] mahte rekkien spel godes,
7.574: that he mahte fon erðu up gihôrean
7.575: waldandes word: bithiu was is giwit mikil,
7.576: thes [thegnes] githâhti. Thô he thanan skolda,
7.578: forlâten liudio drôm, sôkien lioht ôðar,
7.581: sagde sôðlîko: - that al sîðor quam,
7.582: giwarð an thesaro weroldi -: [thô] [sagda] [he] that hêr skoldi kuman ên wîskuning
7.583: mâri endi mahtig an thesan middilgard
7.584: [thes] bezton giburdies; quað that [it] skoldi wesan barn godes,
7.585: quað that he thesero [weroldes] waldan skoldi
7.586: gio te êwandaga, erðun endi himiles.
7.587: He quað that an them selƀon daga, the ina sâligna
7.589: sô quað he that ôstana [ên] skoldi skînan
7.590: himiltungal huît, sulik sô wi hêr ne habdin êr
7.592: ne sulik barn ne sulik bôkan. Hêt that thar te bedu fôrin
7.593: threa man fon thero thiodu, hêt sie thenkean wel,
7.594: hwan êr sie gisâwin ôstana up [sîðogean],
7.595: that godes bôkan gangan, hêt sie garuwian sân,
7.596: hêt that wi im folgodin, sô it furi wurði,
7.597: westar oƀar thesa [weroldi]. Nu is it al giwârod sô,
7.598: kuman thurh kraft godes: the kuning is gifôdit,
7.599: giboran bald endi strang: wi gisâhun is bôkan skînan
7.600: hêdro fon himiles tunglun, sô ik wêt, that it hêlag drohtin,
7.601: markoda [mahtig] selƀo. Wi gisâhun morgno gihwilikes
7.602: blîkan thana berhton sterron, endi wi gengun aftar them bôkna herod
7.603: wegas endi waldas hwîlon. [That wâri ûs] allaro willeono mêsta,
7.604: that wi ina [selƀon gisehan môstin], wissin, hwar wi [ina] sôkean skoldin,
7.605: thana kuning [an] thesumu kêsurdôma. Saga ûs, undar hwilikumu he sî thesaro kunneo afôdit."
7.607: harm wið herta, bigan [im] is hugi wallan,
7.608: seƀo mid sorgun: gihôrde seggean thô,
7.611: [sâligoron] undar them gisîðea. Thô he samnon hêt,
7.612: sô hwat sô an Hierusalem gôdaro manno
7.614: endi an iro brioston bôkkraftes mêst
7.615: wissun te wârun, endi he sie mid [wordun] fragn,
7.617: kuning thero liudio, hwar Krist giboran
7.619: friðugumono bezt. Thô sprak im eft [that folk] angegin,
7.620: that werod wârlîko, quâðun that sie wissin garo,
7.621: that he skoldi an Bethleem giboran werðan: "sô is an [ûsun] bôkun giskriƀan,
7.623: swîðo glawa gumon bi godes krafta
7.625: that skoldi fon Bethleem burgo hirdi,
7.626: liof landes ward an thit lioht kuman,

8.630: [Thô] gifragn ik that sân aftar thiu slîðmôd kuning
8.631: thero wârsagono word them wrekkiun sagda,
8.633: ferran gifarana, endi he frâgoda aftar thiu,
8.636: hêdro fon himile. Sie ni weldun is im thô helen [eowiht],
8.637: ak sagdun it im sôðlîko. Thô hêt he sie an thana sîð faran,
8.638: hêt that sie ira ârundi al undarfundin
8.639: umbi thes kindes kumi, endi the kuning selƀo gibôd
8.641: them wîsun mannun, êr than sie fôrin [westan] forð,
8.642: that sie im eft gikûðdin, hwar he thana kuning skoldi
8.643: sôkean [at] is [selðon]; quað that he thar weldi mid is gisîðun tô,
8.644: bedan [te them] barne. Than hogda he im te banon werðan
8.645: wâpnes eggiun. Than eft waldand god
8.646: thâhte wið them thinga: [he] mahta [athengean] mêr,
8.647: gilêstean an thesum liohte: that is noh lango skîn,
8.648: gikûðid kraft godes. Thô gengun eft thiu kumbl forð
8.649: wânum undar [wolknun]. Thô wârun thea wîson man
8.650: fûsa te faranne: giwitun [im] forð thanan
8.651: balda an bodskepi: weldun that barn godes
8.652: [selƀon] sôkean. Sie ni habdun thanan gisîðeas mêr,
8.653: [bûtan] that sie thrie wârun: wissun im thingo giskêð,
8.654: wârun im glawe gumon, the thea geƀa lêddun.
8.655: Than sâhun sie sô wîslîko undar thana wolknes skion,
8.656: up te them hôhon himile, hwô fôrun thea hwîton sterron
8.657: - antkendun sie [that] kumbal godes -, [thiu] wârun thurh [Krista] herod
8.658: giwarht te thesero weroldi. Thea weros aftar gengun,
8.659: folgodun ferahtlîko - sie frumide the mahte -
8.661: berht bôkan godes, blêk an himile
8.663: hwît oƀar them hûse, thar that hêlage barn
8.664: wonode an willeon endi ina that wîf biheld,
8.665: thiu thiorne githiudo. Thô warð [thero] thegno hugi
8.666: blîði an iro briostun: bi them bôkna forstôdun,
8.667: that sie that friðubarn godes funden habdun,
8.668: hêlagna heƀenkuning. Thô sie an that hûs innan
8.669: mid iro geƀun gengun, gumon ôstronea,
8.671: thea weros waldand Krist. Thea wrekkion fellun
8.672: te them kinde an kneobeda endi ina an kuningwîsa
8.673: gôdan grôttun endi im thea geƀa drôgun,
8.675: endi [myrra] thar [mid]. Thea man stôdun garowa,
8.676: holde for iro hêrron, thea it mid iro handun sân
8.677: fagaro [antfengun]. Thô giwitun im thea [ferahton] man,
8.679: gumon an gastseli. Thar im godes engil
8.681: gidrog [im] an drôme, al so it drohtin self,
8.682: [waldand] welde, [that] [im] [thûhte] that man im mid wordun gibudi,
8.683: that sie im thanan ôðran weg, erlos fôrin,
8.684: liðodin sie te lande endi thana lêðan man,
8.686: môdagna kuning. Thô warð morgan kuman
8.687: wânum te thesero weroldi. Thô bigunnun thea wîson man
8.689: waldandes word, hwand sie giwit mikil
8.690: bârun an iro briostun: bâdun alowaldon,
8.691: [hêron] heƀenkuning, that sie môstin is huldi forð,
8.692: giwirkean is willeon, quâðun that sea [ti] im habdin giwendit hugi,
8.693: [iro] môd [morgan] [gihwem]. Thô [fôrun] eft thie man thanan,
8.694: erlos ôstronie, al sô im the engil godes
8.695: wordun giwîsde: nâmun im weg ôðran,
8.696: fulgengun godes lêrun: ni weldun [themu] [Judeo] kuninge
8.697: umbi thes barnes giburd bodon ôstronie,

9.699: Thô warð sân aftar thiu waldandes,
9.701: sagde im an swefne slâpandium [an] naht,
9.702: bodo drohtines, that that barn godes
9.704: âhtean is aldres; "nu [skaltu] ine an Aegypteo
9.705: land [antlêdean] endi undar them luidiun wesan
9.706: mid thiu godes barnu endi mid theru gôdan thiornan,
9.707: wonon undar themu werode, untthat thi word [kume]
9.708: hêrron thînes, that thu that hêlage barn
9.709: eft te thesum landskepi lêdian môtis,
9.710: drohtin thînen." Thô fon them drôma ansprang
9.711: Joseph an is gestseli, endi that godes gibod
9.712: sân antkenda: giwêt im an [thana] sîð thanen
9.713: the thegan mid theru thiornon, sôhta im thiod ôðra
9.714: oƀar brêdan berg: welda that barn godes
9.715: fîundun antfôrian. Thô gifrang aftar thiu
9.716: Erodes the kuning, thar he an is rîkea sat,
9.717: [that] wârun thea wîson man westan gihworƀan
9.718: ôstar an iro ôðil endi fôrun im ôðran weg:
9.719: wisse [that] sie [im] that ârundi eft ni weldun
9.720: seggian an is selðon. Thô [warð] im [thes] an sorgun hugi,
9.721: môd mornondi, quað that it [im] thie man dedin,
9.722: heliðos te hônðun. Thô he [sô] hriwig sat,
9.723: balg ina an is briostun, quað that he is mahti [betaron] râd,
9.725: wêt is [wintergitalu]: nu ik giwinnan mag,
9.726: that he [io] oƀar thesaro erðu ald ni wirðit,
9.727: [hêr] undar thesum heriskepi." Thô he sô hardo gibôd,
9.728: Erodes oƀar is riki, hêt thô is rinkos faran
9.729: kuning thero liudio, hêt that sie kinda sô filo
9.731: sô manag barn umbi Bethleem, sô filo sô thar giboran wurði,
9.733: [thes] kuninges gisîðos. Thô skolda thar sô manag kindisk man
9.734: [sweltan] sundiono lôs. Ni warð sið [noh] êr
9.737: môdar managa, gisâhun iro megi spildian:
9.738: ni mahte siu im [nio] giformon, thoh siu mid iro faðmon twêm
9.740: liof endi luttil, thoh skolda is [simbla] that lîf [geƀan],
9.741: the magu for theru môdar. Mênes ni sâhun,
9.745: kindjungaro qualm. Cara was an Bethleem,
9.746: hofno hlûdost: thoh man [im] iro herton an twê
9.747: sniði mid swerdu, thoh ni mohta im gio sêrara dâd
9.748: werðan an thesaro weroldi, wîƀun managun,
9.749: brûdiun an Bethleem: gisâhun iro barn biforan,
9.751: [blôdag] an iro barmun. Thie banon wîtnodun
9.753: thea man umbi mênwerk: weldun mahtigna,
9.754: Krist selƀon aquellian. Than habde ina kraftag god
9.755: [gineridan] wið iro nîðe, that inan nahtes thanan
9.757: gumon mid Josepe an thana [grôneon] wang,
9.758: an erðono beztun, thar ên aha fliutid,
9.761: wonoda an willeon, antthat wurd fornam
9.762: Erodes thana kuning, that he forlêt eldeo barn,
9.763: môdag manno drôm. Thô skolda thero marka giwald
9.764: êgan is erƀiward: the was Archelâus
9.766: the skolda umbi Hierusalem Judeono folkes,
9.767: werodes giwaldan. Thô warð word kuman
9.769: that [he] thar te Josepe, godes engil sprak,
9.770: bodo drohtines, hêt ina eft that barn thanan
9.771: lêdien te lande. "nu haƀað thit lioht [afgeƀen]", quað he,
9.772: "Erodes [the] kuning; he welde is âhtien giu,
9.773: frêson is ferahas. Nu maht thu [an] [friðu] lêdien
9.774: that kind undar ewa kunni, nu the kuning ni liƀod,
9.776: Josep godes têkan: geriwide ina sniumo
9.777: the thegan mit thera thiornun, thô sie thanan weldun
9.778: bêðiu mid thiu barnu: lêstun thiu berhton giskapu,
9.779: waldandes willion, al sô he im [êr] mid is wordun gibôd.

10.780: Giwitun im thô eft an [Galilealand] Joseph endi Maria,
10.782: wârun im an Nazarethburg. Thar the neriondio Krist
10.783: wôhs undar them werode, [warð] giwitties ful,
10.784: an was imu anst godes, he was allun liof
10.785: môdarmâgun: he ni was ôðrun mannun [gilîk],
10.786: [the] gumo an sînera gôdi. Thô he [gêrtalo]
10.787: tweliƀi habde, thô warð thiu tîd kuman,
10.788: that [sie] thar te Hierusalem, Juðeo liudi
10.790: wirkean is willeon. Thô warð thar an thana wîh innan
10.793: self an gisîðea endi iru sunu habda,
10.794: godes [êgan] barn. Thô sie that geld habdun,
10.796: gilêstid te iro landwîsun, thô fôrun im eft thie liudi thanan,
10.797: weros an iro willion endi thar an them wîha afstôd
10.798: mahtig barn godes, sô ina thiu môdar thar
10.799: ni wissa te wâron; ak siu wânda that he mid them weroda forð,
10.800: fôri mit iro friundun. Gifrang aftar thiu
10.802: sâlig thiorna, that he undar them gisîðia ni was.
10.803: Warð Mariun thô môd an sorgun,
10.804: hriwig umbi iro herta, thô siu that hêlaga barn
10.805: ni fand undar them folka: filu [gornoda]
10.806: thiu godes thiorna. Giwitun im thô eft te Hierusalem
10.807: iro sunu sôkean, fundun ina sittean thar
10.808: an them wîha innan, thar the [wîsa] man,
10.810: lâsun ende lînodun, hwô sie lof skoldin
10.811: wirkean mid iro wordun them, the thesa werold giskôp.
10.812: Thar sat undar middiun mahtig barn godes,
10.813: Krist alowaldo, sô is thea ni mahtun antkennian wiht,
10.817: [buhwî] gio sô kindisk man sulika quidi [mahti]
10.819: sittean under them [gisîðea] endi iro sunu [grôtta],
10.820: wîsan undar them weroda, sprak [im] [mid] ira wordun [tô]:
10.821: "hwî weldes thu thînera môdar, manno lioƀosto,
10.822: gisidon [sulika] [sorga], that ik thi sô sêragmôd,
10.824: undar thesun burgliudiun?" Thô sprak iru eft that barn angegin
10.825: wîsun wordun: "hwat, thu wêst garo", [quað he],
10.826: "that ik thar girîsu, thar ik bi rehton skal
10.827: wonon an willeon, thar giwald haƀad
10.828: mîn mahtig fader." Thie man ni forstôdun,
10.829: thie weros an them wîha, bihwî he sô that word gisprak,
10.830: gimênda mid is mûðu: Maria al biheld,
10.831: [gibarg] an ira breostun, sô hwat sô siu gihôrda ira barn sprekan
10.832: wisaro wordo. Giwitun im thô eft [thanan]
10.834: habdun im te gisîðea sunu drohtines,
10.835: allaro barno [bezta], thero the io [giboran] wurði
10.836: magu fon môdar: habdun im thar minnea tô
10.837: thurh [hluttran] hugi, endi he sô gihôrig was,
10.840: ni welda an is kindiski thô noh is kraft mikil
10.841: mannun mârean, that he sulik megin êhta,
10.842: giwald an thesaro weroldi, ak he im an is willeon bêd
10.843: githiudo undar thero thiodu thrîtig gêro,
10.844: êr than he thar têkan ênig tôgean weldi,
10.845: seggean them gisîðea, that he selƀo was
10.848: word endi wîsdôm ende allaro giwitteo mêst,
10.849: tulgo spâhan hugi: ni mahta [man is] an is sprâkun werðan,
10.850: an is wordun [giwar], that he sulik giwit êhta,
10.851: [thegan] sulika githâhti, ak he im sô githiudo bêd
10.852: torhtaro têkno. Ni was noh than thiu tîd kuman,
10.853: that he ina oƀar thesan middilgard mârean skolda,
10.854: lêrian thie liudi, hwô sie [skoldin] iro gilôƀon haldan,
10.855: wirkean willeon godes. Wissun that thoh managa
10.856: liudi aftar them landa, that he was an thit lioht kuman,
10.857: thoh sie ina kûðlîko ankennian ni mahtin,
10.858: êr than he ina selƀo seggean welda.

11.859: Than was im Johannes fon is juguðhêdi
11.860: awahsan an ênero wôstunni; thar ni was werodes than mêr,
11.861: [bûtan] that he thar ênkora alowaldon gode,
11.864: an thero wôstunni word fon himila,
11.866: that he Cristes kumi endi is kraft mikil
11.871: welono wunsamost. Im was thô willeo mikil,
11.872: that [he] fon sulikun sâldun seggean môsti.
11.873: Giwêt im thô gangan, al sô Jordan flôt,
11.874: watar an willeon, endi them weroda allan dag,
11.875: aftar them landskepi them liudiun kûðda,
11.876: that sie mid fastunniu firinwerk manag,
11.878: "that gi werðan hrênea", quað he. "Heƀanriki is
11.879: ginâhid manno [barnun]. Nu lâtad [eu] an ewan môdseƀon
11.881: [lêdas] that gi an thesun liohta [fremidun], endi mînun lêrun hôread,
11.882: wendeat aftar mînun wordun. Ik eu an watara skal
11.883: gidôpean diurlîko, thoh ik ewa dâdi ne mugi,
11.885: that gi thurh mîn handgiwerk hluttra werðan
11.886: lêðaro gilêsto: ak the is an thit lioht kuman,
11.887: mahtig te mannun endi undar eu middiun stêd,
11.888: - thoh gi ina selƀun gisehan ni [willean] -,
11.889: the eu [gidôpean] skal an ewes drohtines namon
11.890: an thana [hâlagon] gêst. That is hêrro oƀar al:
11.891: he mag allaro manno gihwena mêngithâhteo,
11.892: sundeono sikoron, sô hwene sô sô sâlig môt
11.893: werðen an thesaro weroldi, that thes willeon haƀad,
11.894: that he sô gilêstea, sô he thesun liudiun wili,
11.895: gibioden barn godes. Ik bium an is [bods]kepi herod
11.896: an thesa werold kumen endi skal im thana weg rûmien,
11.897: lêrean thesa liudi, hwô sea [skulin] iro gilôƀon haldan
11.898: thurh hluttran hugi, endi that sie an hellea ni thurƀin,
11.899: faran an fern that hêta. Thes wirðid sô fagan an is môde
11.900: man te sô managaro [stundu], sô hwe sô that mên forlâtid,
11.901: gerno thes gramon anbusni, - sô mag im thes gôdon giwirkean,
11.902: huldi heƀenkuninges, - sô hwe sô haƀad hluttra trewa
11.903: up te them alomahtigon gode." Erlos managa
11.904: bi them lêrun thô, liudi wândun,
11.905: weros wârlîko, that that waldand Krist
11.906: selbo wâri, hwanda he sô filu sôðes gisprak,
11.907: wâroro wordo. Thô warð that sô wîdo kûð
11.908: oƀar that forgeƀana land gumono gihwilikum,
11.909: seggiun [at] iro selðun: thô quâmun ina sôkean tharod
11.911: bodon fon theru [burgi] [endi] [frâgodun], ef he wâri that barn godes,
11.912: "that hêr lango giu", quaðun sie, "liudi sagdun,
11.913: weros wârlîko, that he skoldi an thesa werold kuman".
11.914: Johannes thô gimahalde endi tegegnes sprak
11.915: them bodun baldlîko: "ni bium ik", quað he, "that barn godes,
11.916: wâr waldand Krist, ak ik skal im thana weg rûmien,
11.918: thea thar an them ârundie erlos wârun,
11.919: bodon fon [thero] [burgi]: "ef thu [nu] ni bist that barn godes,
11.920: bist thu than thoh Elias, the hêr an êrdagun
11.921: was undar thesumu werode? He is [wiskumo]
11.922: [eft] [an] thesan middilgard. Saga ûs hwat thu manno sîs!
11.923: Bist thu ênig [thero], the hêr [êr] wâri
11.924: [wîsaro] wârsaguno? Hwat skulun wi them werode fon thi
11.925: seggean te sôðon? Neo hêr [êr sulik] ni warð
11.927: dâdiun sô mâri. Bihwî thu hêr [dôpisli]
11.928: [fremis] undar thesumu folke, ef thu tharo forasagono
11.929: ênhwilik [ni] bist?" Thô habde eft garo
11.932: lioƀes hêrron; ik skal thit land rekon,
11.933: thit [werod] aftar is willion. Ik hebbiu fon is worde mid mi
11.934: stranga stemna, thoh sie hêr ni willie forstandan filo
11.935: werodes an thesaro wôstunni. Ni bium ik mid wihti [gilîk]
11.936: drohtine mînumu: he is mid is dâdiun sô strang,
11.937: sô mâri endi sô mahtig - that wirðid managun kûð,
11.938: werun aftar thesaro weroldi - that ik thes wirðig ni bium,
11.939: that ik môti an is giskuoha, thoh ik sî is [skalk] [êgan],
11.940: an sô [rîkiumu] drohtine, thea reomon antbindan:
11.941: sô mikilu is he betara than ik. Nis thes [bodon] gimako
11.942: ênig oƀar erðu, ne nu aftar ni skal
11.943: werðan an thesaro weroldi. Hebbiad ewan willion tharod,
11.946: forlâtad lêðaro drôm [endi] sôkead eu lioht godes,
11.948: hôhan heƀenwang. Ne lâtad ewan hugi twîflien!"

12.949: Sô sprak thô jung gumo bi godes lêrun
12.952: quâmun thar te Johannese kuningo gisîðos,
12.953: liudi te lêrun endi iro gilôƀon antfengun.
12.954: He dôpte sie dago gihwilikes endi im iro dâdi lôg,
12.955: wrêðaro willion, endi loƀode im word godes,
12.957: "garu gumono sô hwem, sô ti gode thenkid
12.959: lêstean is lêra". Thô ni was lang [te] thiu,
12.960: that im fon Galilea giwêt godes êgan barn,
12.962: Was im thuo an is wastme waldandes barn,
12.963: al sô he mid thero thiodu thrîtig habdi
12.964: wintro an is weroldi. Thô he an is willeon [quam],
12.967: dôpte diurlîko. [Reht] sô he thô is drohtin gisah,
12.968: holden hêrron, sô warð im is hugi blîði,
12.969: thes im [the] willeo gistôd, endi sprak [im thô] mid is wordun [tô],
12.971: "nu kumis thu te mînero dôpi, drohtin frô mîn,
12.972: thiod[gumono] [bezto]: sô skolde ik te thînero duan,
12.973: hwand thu bist allaro kuningo kraftigost." Krist selƀo gibôd,
12.974: waldand wârlîko, that he ni sprâki thero wordo than mêr:
12.975: "wêst thu, that ûs [sô] girîsid", quað he, "allaro rehto [gihwilik]
12.979: werod an watere endi [ôk] waldand Krist,
12.981: an allaro [baðo] them [bezton] endi im thar te bedu gihnêg
12.982: an kneo kraftag. Krist up giwêt
12.983: fagar fon them flôde, friðubarn godes,
12.984: liof liudio ward. Sô he thô that land [afstôp],
12.985: sô anthlidun thô himiles doru, endi quam the hêlago gêst
12.986: fon them alowaldon oƀane te Kriste:
12.988: diurlîkara dûƀun - endi sat im uppan ûses drohtines [ahslu],
12.989: [wonoda] im oƀar them waldandes barne. Aftar quam thar word fon himile,
12.990: hlûd fon them [hôhon] radura [en] grôtta thane hêleand selƀon,
12.991: [Crista], allaro kuningo bezton, quað that he ina gikorana habdi
12.992: selƀo fon sînun rîkea, quað that im the sunu [lîkodi]
12.993: bezt allaro giboranaro manno, quað that he im wâri allaro barno lioƀost.
12.994: That môste Johannes [thô], al sô it god welde,
12.995: [gisehan] endi gihôrean. He gideda it sân aftar thiu
12.997: hêrron habdun: ["thit] is", quað he, "heƀenkuninges sunu,
12.998: ên alowaldand: thesas willeo ik urkundeo
12.999: wesan an thesaro weroldi, [hwand] it sagda mi word godes,
12.1000: drohtines stemne, thô he mi dôpean hêt
12.1001: weros an watare, sô hwar sô ik gisâhi wârlîko
12.1004: kuman mid kraftu; that quað, [that] skoldi Crist wesan,
12.1005: diurlîk drohtines suno. Hie dôpean skal
12.1006: an thana hêlagan gêst endi hêlean managa
12.1007: manno mêndâdi. He haƀad [maht] fon gode,
12.1008: that he alâtan mag liudeo gihwilikun
12.1009: saka endi sundea. Thit is selƀo Krist,
12.1011: friðu wið fîundun. Wala that eu thes mag frâhmôd hugi
12.1012: wesan an thesaro weroldi, thes eu the willeo gistôd,
12.1013: that gi sô [libbeanda] thana landes ward
12.1014: selƀon gisâhun. Nu môt [sliumo] sundeono lôs
12.1015: manag gêst faran an godes willeon
12.1016: tionon atômid, the mid trewon wili
12.1017: wið is wini wirkean endi an waldand Krist
12.1018: fasto gilôƀean. That skal te [frumun] werðen
12.1019: gumono sô hwilikun, sô that gerno dôt".

13.1020: Sô gefragn ik that [Johannes thô] gumono gihwilikun,
13.1024: sâlig sinlîf. Thô he [im] selƀo giwêt
13.1027: was im thar an thero ênôdi erlo drohtin
13.1028: lange hwîla; ne habda liudeo than mêr,
13.1029: seggeo te gisîðun, al sô he im selƀo gikôs:
13.1030: welda is thar lâtan [koston] kraftiga wihti,
13.1031: selƀon [Satanasan], the gio an sundea spenit,
13.1032: man an mênwerk: he konsta is môdseƀon,
13.1033: wrêðan willeon, hwô he thesa werold êrist,
13.1035: bisuêk mit sundiun, thô he thiu [sinhîun] twê,
13.1039: gumono gêstos. Thô welda that god mahtig,
13.1040: waldand wendean endi welda thesum werode forgeƀen
13.1041: hôh himilrîki: bethiu he herod hêlagna bodon,
13.1043: [tulgo harm] an is hugi: afonsta heƀanrîkies
13.1045: mid them selƀon sakun sunu drohtines,
13.1047: darnungo bidrôg, that he warð is drohtine lêð,
13.1048: biswêk ina mid sundiun - sô welda he thô selƀan dôn
13.1049: [hêlandean] Krist. Than habda he is hugi fasto
13.1052: liudiun gilêstean. Was im thes landes ward
13.1055: than [langa] ni gidorstun im dernea wihti,
13.1057: grôtean ina geginwarðan: wânde that he [god] ênfald,
13.1059: hêleg himiles ward. Sô he ina thô gehungrean lêt,
13.1060: that ina bigan bi thero mennisko môses lustean
13.1061: aftar them fiwartig dagun, the fîund nâhor geng,
13.1062: mirki mênskaðo: wânda that he man [ênfald]
13.1063: wâri wissungo, sprak im thô mid is wordun tô,
13.1064: grôtta ina the gêrfîund: "ef thu sîs godes sunu", quað he,
13.1065: "behwî ni hêtis thu than werðan, ef thu giwald haƀes,
13.1066: allaro barno bezt, brôd af thesun stênun?
13.1067: [Gehêli] thînna hungar." Thô sprak [eft] the hêlago Crist:
13.1069: liudi libbien, ak sie skulun thruh lêra godes
13.1070: wesan an thesero weroldi endi skulun thiu werk frummien,
13.1071: thea thar werðad ahlûdid fon thero hêlogun tungun,
13.1072: fon them galme godes: that is gumono lîf
13.1073: liudeo sô [hwilikon], sô that lêstean wili,
13.1075: Thô bigan eft niuson endi nâhor geng
13.1077: fandoda is frôhan. That friðubarn tholode
13.1079: that he umbi is kraft mikil koston [môsti],
13.1080: lêt ina thô lêdean thana liudskaðon,
13.1081: that he [ina] an Hierusalem te them godes wîha,
13.1083: an allaro hûso hôhost, endi hoskwordun sprak,
13.1084: the gramo thurh gelp mikil: "ef thu sîs godes sunu", quað he,
13.1085: "skrîd [thi te] erðu hinan. Geskriƀan was it giu lango,
13.1086: an bôkun gewriten, hwô giboden haƀad
13.1088: that sie thi at [wege] gehwem wardos sinðun,
13.1089: haldad thi undar iro handun. Hwat, thu hwargin ni tharft
13.1090: mid thînun fôtun an felis bespurnan,
13.1091: an hardan stên." [Thô] sprak eft the hêlago Crist,
13.1092: allaro barno bezt: "sô is ôk an bôkun geskriƀan", quað he,
13.1093: "that thu te hardo ni skalt hêrran thînes,
13.1094: fandon thînes frôhan: that nis thi allaro frumono [negên]."
13.1095: Lêt ina thô an thana thriddean sîð thana thiodskaðon
13.1096: gibrengen uppan [ênan berg then] hôhon: thar ina the [balowîso]
13.1099: endi all sulik ôdes, sô thius erða [bihaƀad]
13.1100: fagororo frumono, endi sprak im thô the fîund angegin,
13.1101: quað that he im that al sô gôdlîk forgeƀen weldi,
13.1102: hôha heridômos, "ef thu [wilt] hnîgan te mi,
13.1103: fallan te mînun fôtun endi mi [for] frôhan haƀas,
13.1104: bedos te mînun barma. Than lâtu ik thi brûkan wel
13.1105: alles [thes] ôdwelon, thes ik thi hebbiu giôgit hîr."
13.1106: Thô ni welda thes lêðan word lengeron hwîle
13.1107: hôrean the hêlago Crist, ak he ina [fon] is huldi fordrêf,
13.1109: allaro barno [bezt], quað that man bedon skoldi
13.1110: [up] te them alomahtigon gode endi [im ênum thionon]
13.1112: heliðos aftar is huldi: "thar ist thiu helpa gelang
13.1113: manno gehwilikun." Thô giwêt im the [mêns]kaðo,
13.1115: fîund undar [fern]dalu. Warð thar folk mikil
13.1116: fon them alowaldan oƀana te Criste
13.1117: godes engilo kumen, thie im sîðor jungardôm,

14.1121: Was im [an] them sinweldi sâlig barn godes
14.1122: lange hwîle, untthat im thô [lioƀora] warð,
14.1123: that he is kraft mikil kûðien wolda
14.1124: weroda te willion. Thô forlêt he waldes hlêo,
14.1125: ênôdies ard endi sôhte im eft erlo gemang,
14.1127: geng im thô bi [Jordanes] staðe: thar ina Johannes antfand,
14.1130: Johannes is jungurun, thô he ina gangan gesah:
14.1131: "thit is that lamb godes, that thar lôsean skal
14.1132: af thesaro wîdon werold wrêða sundea,
14.1134: kuningo kraftigost." Krist im forð giwêt
14.1135: an Galileo land, godes êgan barn,
14.1136: fôr im te them friundun, thar he afôdit was,
14.1137: tîrlîko atogan, endi talda mid wordun
14.1138: Krist undar is kunnie, kuningo rîkeost,
14.1139: hwô sie skoldin iro selƀoro sundea bôtean,
14.1140: hêt that sie im iro harmwerk manag hrewan lêtin,
14.1141: [feldin] iro firindâdi: "nu is it all [gefullot] sô,
14.1142: sô hîr alde man êr hwanna sprâkun,
14.1144: nu is it [giu] ginâhid thurh thes neriandan kraft: thes môtun gi neotan forð,
14.1145: sô hwe sô gerno wili gode theonogean,
14.1146: wirkean aftar is willeon." Thô warð thes werodes [filu],
14.1147: thero liudeo an lustun: wurðun im thea lêra Cristes,
14.1148: sô suôtea them gisîðea. He bigan im samnon thô
14.1150: wordspâha weros. Geng im thô bi ênes watares staðe,
14.1151: that [thar] habda Jordan aneƀan Galileo land
14.1152: ênna sê gewarhtan. Thar he sittean fand
14.1153: Andreas endi Petrus bi them ahastrôme,
14.1154: bêðea thea gebrôðar, thar sie an brêd watar
14.1156: fiskodun im an them flôde. Thar sie that friðubarn godes
14.1158: hêt that sie im folgodin, quað that he [im] sô filu woldi
14.1159: godes rîkeas forgeƀen; "[al] sô git hîr an [Jordanes] strôme
14.1160: fiskos [fâhat], sô skulun git noh firiho barn
14.1161: halon te inkun handun, that sie an heƀenrîki
14.1163: faran folk manag." Thô warð frômôd hugi
14.1164: [bêðiun] them gibrôðrun: antkendun that barn godes,
14.1166: Andreas endi Petrus, sô hwat sô sie bi theru ahu habdun,
14.1167: [gewunstes] bi them watare: was im willeo mikil,
14.1168: that sie mid them godes barne gangan môstin,
14.1169: samad an is gisîðea, skoldun sâliglîko
14.1170: lôn antfâhan: sô dôt liudeo so hwilik,
14.1172: gewirkean is willeon. Thô sie bi thes watares staðe
14.1173: furðor quâmun, thô fundun sie [thar] ênna frôdan man
14.1174: sittean bi them sêwa endi is suni twêne,
14.1175: Jakobus endi Johannes: wârun im junga man.
14.1176: Sâtun im thâ gesunfader an ênumu sande uppen,
14.1178: thiu netti niudlîko, thea sie habdun nahtes êr
14.1179: forsliten an them sêwa. Thar sprak im selƀo tô
14.1180: sâlig barn godes, hêt that sie an thana sîð mid im,
14.1182: kindjunge man. [Thô] wârun im Kristes word
14.1183: sô [wirðig] an thesaro weroldi, that sie bi thes watares staðe
14.1185: frôdan bi them flôde, endi al that sie thar fehas êhtun,
14.1186: nettiu endi [neglitskipu], [gekurun im] thana neriandan Krist,
14.1187: hêlagna te hêrron, was im [is helpono] tharf
14.1188: [te githiononne: sô is allaro thegno gehwem,]
14.1189: wero an thesero weroldi. Thô giwêt im the waldandes sunu
14.1190: mid them fiwariun forð, endi im thô thana fîfton gikôs
14.1191: Krist an ênero kôpstedi, kuninges jungoron,
14.1192: môdspâhana man: Mattheus was he hêtan,
14.1194: skolda thar te is hêrron handun antfâhan
14.1195: tins endi [tolna]; trewa habda he gôda,
14.1197: gold endi siluƀar endi geƀa managa,
14.1198: diurie mêðmos, endi warð im ûses drohtines man;
14.1199: kôs im the kuninges [thegn] Crist te hêrran,
14.1201: [wâri] an thesero weroldi: feng im wôðera thing,
14.1202: langsamoron râd. Thô warð it allun them liudiun kûð,
14.1203: fon allaro burgo gihwem, hwô that barn godes
14.1205: sô manag wîslîk word endi wâres sô filu,
14.1207: gewarhte an thesero weroldi. Was that an is wordun skîn
14.1208: jak an is dâdiun sô same, that he drohtin was,
14.1209: himilisk hêrro endi te helpu quam

15.1211: Oft gededa he that an them lande skîn,
15.1212: than he thar [torhtlîko sô manag] têkan giwarhte,
15.1213: thar he hêlde mid is handun halte endi [blinde],
15.1214: lôsde af theru lêfhêdi liudi manage,
15.1215: af sulikun suhtiun, sô than allaro swâroston
15.1217: tulgo langsam legar. Thô fôrun thar thie liudi tô
15.1218: allaro dago [gehwilikes], thar ûsa drohtin was
15.1219: selƀo undar them gisîðie, untthat thar gesamnod warð
15.1221: thoh sie thar [alle be gelîkumu gelôƀon ni quâmin.]
15.1222: weros thurh ênan willeon: sume sôhtun sie that waldandes barn,
15.1223: armoro manno filu - was [im] âtes tharf -,
15.1224: that sie im thar [at] theru menigi [mates] endi drankes,
15.1225: [thigidin at] theru thiodu; hwand thar was manag thegan sô gôd,
15.1227: gerno gâƀun. Sume wârun sie im eft Judeono kunnies,
15.1228: fêgni folkskepi: wârun [thar gefarana] te thiu,
15.1229: that sie ûses drohtines dâdio endi wordo
15.1232: alêdien them liudiun, that sie is lêron ni hôrdin,
15.1233: ne [wendin] aftar is willion. Suma wârun sie im eft sô wîse man,
15.1234: wârun [im] glauwe gumon endi gode werðe,
15.1235: alesane undar them liudiun, quâmun im [tharod] be them lêron Cristes,
15.1236: that sie is hêlag word [hôrien] môstin,
15.1237: lînon endi lêstien: habdun mid iro gelôƀon te im
15.1239: wurðun is thegnos te thiu, that he sie an thiodwelon
15.1241: an godes [rîki]. He sô gerno antfeng
15.1243: te langaru hwîlu, [endi] mahta sô gilêstien wel.
15.1244: Thô warð thar megin sô mikil umbi thana mârion Crist,
15.1245: liudio gesamnod: thô [gisah he] fon allun landun kuman,
15.1246: fon allun wîdun wegun werod tesamne
15.1247: [lungro] liudio: is lof was sô wîdo
15.1248: managun gemârid. Thô giwêt im mahtig self
15.1249: an ênna berg uppan, barno rîkiost,
15.1250: sundar gesittien, endi im selƀo gekôs
15.1252: gôdoro gumono, thea he im te jungoron forð
15.1255: Nemnida sie thô bi naman endi hêt sie [im thô] nâhor gangan,
15.1257: gebrôðar twêne, endi bêðie mid im,
15.1258: Jakobus endi Johannes: sie wârun gode [werðe];
15.1259: mildi was he [im] an is môde; sie wârun ênes mannes suni
15.1260: bêðie bi geburdiun; sie [kôs] that barn godes
15.1261: gôde te jungoron endi gumono filu,
15.1264: is selƀes swiri: sie wârun fon [gisustruonion] twêm
15.1266: gôde gadulingos. Thô habda thero gumono thar
15.1268: trewafte man: thô hêt he ôk thana tehandon gangan
15.1269: [selƀo] mid them gisîðun: Sîmon was he hêtan;
15.1270: hêt ôk Bartholomeus an thana berg uppan
15.1271: faran [fan] them folke âðrum endi Philippus mid im,
15.1272: trewafte man. Thô gengun sie tweliƀi samad,
15.1273: rinkos te theru rûnu, thar [the] râdand sat,
15.1276: formon wið them ferne, sô hwem sô frummien wili
15.1277: sô lioƀlîka lêra, sô he them liudiun thar

16.1279: Thô umbi thana [neriendon] Krist nâhor gengun
16.1280: sulike gesîðos, sô he im selƀo gekôs,
16.1281: waldand undar them werode. Stôdun wîsa man,
16.1282: gumon umbi thana godes sunu gerno swîðo,
16.1283: weros an willeon: was im thero wordo [niud],
16.1284: thâhtun endi thagodun, hwat im [thero] thiodo drohtin,
16.1286: thesum liudiun te [lioƀe]. Than sat im the landes hirdi
16.1287: geginward for them gumun, godes êgan barn:
16.1289: lêrean thea liudi, [hwô] sie lof gode
16.1291: Sat im thô endi swîgoda endi sah sie an lango,
16.1292: was im hold an is hugi hêlag drohtin,
16.1293: mildi an is môde, endi thô [is mund] antlôk,
16.1295: manag mârlîk thing endi them [mannum sagde]
16.1296: spâhun wordun, them the he te theru sprâku [tharod],
16.1300: sagde im thô te [sôðan], quað that thie sâliga wârin,
16.1301: man an thesoro middil[gardun], thie hêr an iro [môde] wârin
16.1304: sinlîf fargeƀen." Quað that ôk sâlige wârin
16.1305: mâðmundie man: "thie môtun thie mârion erðe,
16.1306: [ofsittien] that selƀe rîki." Quað [that] ôk sâlige wârin,
16.1307: thie hîr [wiopin] iro wammun dâdi; "thie môtun eft willion gebîdan,
16.1308: frôfre [an iro frâhon rîkia]. Sâlige sind ôk, the sie hîr frumono [gilustid],
16.1309: rinkos, that [sie] rehto adômien. Thes môtun sie werðan an them rîkia drohtines
16.1310: gifullit thurh iro ferhton dâdi: sulîkoro môtun sie frumono [biknêgan]
16.1311: thie rinkos, thie hîr rehto [adômiad], ne williad an [rûnun] beswîkan
16.1312: man, thar sie [at] mahle [sittiad]. Sâlige sind ôk them hîr mildi wirðit
16.1313: hugi an heliðo briostun: them wirðit the hêlego drohtin,
16.1314: mildi mahtig selƀo. Sâlige sind ôk undar thesaro managon thiodu,
16.1315: [thie] hebbiad iro herta [gihrênod]: thie môtun thane heƀenes waldand
16.1316: sehan an sînum rîkea." Quað [that ôk] sâlige wârin,
16.1317: "thie [the friðusamo] undar thesumu [folke libbiod] endi ni williad êniga fehta gewirken,
16.1318: saka mid iro selƀoro [dâdiun]: thie môtun wesan suni drohtines [genemnide],
16.1319: hwande he im [wil] genâdig werðen; [thes] môtun sie niotan lango
16.1320: selƀon [thes] sînes rîkies." Quað that ôk sâlige wârin
16.1321: thie rinkos, the rehto weldin, "endi thurh that tholod rîkioro manno
16.1322: heti endi harmquidi: them is ôk an himile [eft]
16.1324: aftar te êwandage, sô [is] io endi ni kumit,
16.1325: [welan wunsames]." Sô habde thô waldand Crist
16.1326: for them erlon thar ahto getalda
16.1327: sâlda gesagda; mid them skal simbla gihwe
16.1328: himilrîk gehalon, ef he it hebbien wili,
16.1329: [ettho] he skal te êwandaga aftar tharƀon
16.1330: welon endi willion, sîðor he these werold agiƀid,
16.1331: erðlîƀigiskapu, endi sôkit im ôðar lioht
16.1332: sô liof sô lêð, sô he mid thesun liudiun hêr
16.1333: giwerkod an thesoro weroldi, al sô it thar thô mid is wordun sagde
16.1336: "Ge werðat ôk [sô] sâlige", quað he, "thes iu saka [biodat]
16.1337: liudi aftar theson lande endi lêð [sprekat],
16.1338: hebbiad iu te [hoska] endi harmes filu
16.1339: gewirkiad an thesoro weroldi endi wîti gefrummiad,
16.1342: harmes thurh [iuwen] hêrron. Thes lâtad gi ewan hugi [simbla],
16.1343: lîf an lustun, hwand iu that lôn stendit
16.1344: an godes rîkia garu, gôdo gehwilikes,
16.1345: mikil endi managfald: that is iu te mêdu fargeƀen,
16.1346: hwand gi hêr êr biforan arƀid tholodun,
16.1347: wîti an thesoro weroldi. Wirs is them ôðrun,
16.1348: [giƀiðig] grimmora thing, them the hêr gôd êgun,
16.1349: [wîdan] woroldwelon: thie forslîtat iro wunnia hêr;
16.1350: geniudot sie genôges, skulun eft narowaro thing
16.1352: Than [wuôpian] thar wanskefti, thie hêr êr an wunnion [sîn],
16.1353: libbiad an [allon] lustun, ne williad thes farlâtan wiht,
16.1354: mênigithâhtio, thes sie an iro môd spenit,
16.1355: lêðoro gilêstio. Than im that lôn kumid,
16.1356: uƀil arƀetsam, than sie is thane endi skulun
16.1357: sorgondi gesehan. Than wirðid im sêr hugi,
16.1358: thes sie thesero weroldes sô filu willean fulgengun,
16.1359: man an iro môdseƀon. Nu skulun gi im that mên lahan,
16.1360: werean mid wordun, al sô ik giu nu gewîsean mag,
16.1362: wârun wordun, that gi thesoro weroldes nu [forð]
16.1364: [bôtian] iro baludâdi, that sie [an] betara thing,
16.1366: [diuƀales] gedâdi, endi sôkean iro drohtines rîki.
16.1367: Sô skulun gi mid iuwon lêrun liudfolk manag
16.1368: wendean aftar mînon willeon. Ef iuwar than awirðid hwilik,
16.1369: farlâtid thea lêra, thea he lêstean skal,
16.1370: than is im sô them salte, [the] man bi sêes staðe
16.1371: wîdo tewirpit: than it te wihti ni dôg,
16.1372: ak it firiho barn fôtun spurnat,
16.1373: gumon an greote. Sô wirðid them, the that godes word [skal]
16.1374: mannum mârean: ef he im than lâtid is môd twehon,
16.1375: [that hi ne willea mid hluttro hugi te] heƀenrîkea
16.1376: spanen mid is sprâku endi seggean spel godes,
16.1377: ak wenkid thero wordo, than wirðid im waldand gram,
16.1378: mahtig môdag, endi sô samo manno barn;

17.1381: So sprak he [thô] spâhlîko endi sagda spel godes,
17.1382: lêrde the landes ward liudi sîne
17.1384: gumon umbi thana godes sunu gerno swîðo,
17.1385: weros an willeon: was im thero wordo [niud],
17.1386: thâhtun endi thagodun, gihôrdun [thero] thiodo drohtin
17.1388: gihêt im heƀenrîki endi te them heliðun sprak:
17.1389: "ôk mag ik iu seggean, gesîðos mîna,
17.1390: wârun wordun, that gi thesoro weroldes nu forð
17.1392: fagar mid firihun oƀar folk manag,
17.1393: wlitig endi wunsam: ni mugun iuwa werk mikil
17.1394: biholan werðan, mid hwiliko gi sea hugi kûðeat:
17.1395: than mêr the thiu burg ni mag, thiu an berge stâð,
17.1397: wrisilîk giwerk, ni mugun iuwa word than mêr
17.1399: iuwa dâdi bidernit. Dôt, sô ik iu lêriu:
17.1400: lâtad iuwa lioht mikil liudiun skînan,
17.1401: manno barnun, that sie farstandan iuwan môdseƀon,
17.1402: iuwa werk endi iuwan willeon, endi thes waldand god
17.1404: loƀon an [thesumu] liohte, thes he iu sulika lêra fargaf.
17.1405: Ni skal neoman lioht, the it haƀad, liudiun dernean,
17.1406: te hardo [behwelƀean], ak he it hôho skal
17.1407: an seli settean, that thea gesehan mugin
17.1409: heliðos an hallu. Than [hald] ni skulun gi iuwa hêlag word
17.1411: heliðkunnie farhelan, ak ge it hôho skulun
17.1412: brêdean, that gibod godes, that it allaro barno gehwilik,
17.1414: endi sô gefrummien, sô it an forndagun
17.1416: than sie thana aldan êo erlos heldun,
17.1417: endi ôk suliku swîðor, sô ik iu nu seggean mag,
17.1419: [than] it thar an them aldom êwa gebeode.
17.1420: Ni wâniat gi thes mit wihtiu, that ik bi thiu an thesa werold quâmi,
17.1421: that ik thana aldan êu irrien willie,
17.1422: fellean [undar] thesumu folke eftho thero forasagono
17.1423: word wiðarwerpen, thea hêr sô giwârea man
17.1425: himil endi erðe, thiu nu bihlidan standat,
17.1427: [unlêstid] an thesumu liohte, thea sie thesum liudiun hêr
17.1428: [wârlîko] gebudun. Ni quam ik an thesa werold te thiu,
17.1429: that ik feldi thero forasagono word, ak ik siu fullien skal,
17.1431: thesumu folke te frumu. That was forn geskriƀan
17.1432: an them aldon êo - [ge hôrdun] it oft sprekan
17.1433: [wordwîse] man -: sô hwe sô that an thesoro weroldi gidôt,
17.1435: lîƀu bilôsie, them skulun liudio barn
17.1436: dôd adêlean. Than willeo ik [it] iu diopor nu,
17.1437: furður bifâhan: sô hwe sô ina thurh fîundskepi,
17.1438: man wiðar ôðrana an is môdseƀon
17.1439: [bilgit] an is breostun - hwand sie alle gebrôðar sint,
17.1441: man mid mâgskepi -, than wirðit thoh hwe ôðrumu an is môde sô gram,
17.1442: lîbes weldi ina [bilôsien], of he mahti gilêstien sô:
17.1443: than is he sân afêhit endi is thes ferahas skolo,
17.1444: al sulikes urdêlies sô the [ôðar] was,
17.1446: erl ôðarna. Ôk is an them êo geskriƀan
17.1447: wârun wordun, sô gi witon alle,
17.1449: minnian an is môde, wesen is mâgun hold,
17.1451: [frâhon] is friunda gehwane, endi skal is fîund hatan,
17.1452: wiðerstanden them mid strîdu endi mid starku hugi,
17.1453: werean wiðar wrêðun. Than seggeo ik iu [te wâron nu],
17.1454: fullîkur for thesumu folke, that gi iuwa fîund skulun
17.1455: minneon an iuwomu môde, sô samo sô gi iuwa mâgos dôt,
17.1456: an godes namon. Dôt im gôdes filu,
17.1457: tôgeat im hluttran hugi, holda trewa,
17.1458: liof wiðar ira lêðe. That is langsam râd
17.1459: manno [sô hwilikumu], sô is môd te thiu
17.1460: [geflîhit] wiðar [is] fîunde. Than môtun gi thea fruma êgan,
17.1461: that gi môtun hêten heƀenkuninges suni,
17.1462: is blîði barn. Ne mugun gi iu betaran râd
17.1463: gewinnan an thesoro weroldi. Than seggio ik iu te wâron ôk,
17.1464: barno gehwilikum, that gi ne mugun [mid] gibolgono hugi
17.1465: iuwas gôdes wiht te godes hûsun
17.1466: waldande fargeƀan, that it imu wirðig sî
17.1467: te antfâhanne, sô lango sô thu fîundskepies [wiht],
17.1469: Êr skalt thu thi simbla gesônien wið thana sakwaldand,
17.1470: gemôdi gimahlean: sîðor maht thu mêðmos thîna
17.1471: te them godes altere [ageƀan]: than sind sie themu gôdan werðe,
17.1472: heƀenkuninge. Mêr skulun gi aftar is huldi thionon,
17.1475: sinlîf sehan. Ôk skal [ik] iu seggean noh,
17.1476: hwô it thar an them aldon êo gebiudid,
17.1477: that ênig erl ôðres idis ni biswîka,
17.1478: [wîf] mid wammu. Than seggio ik iu te wâron ôk,
17.1479: that thar man is siuni mugun swîðo farlêdean
17.1480: an mirki [mên], ef hi [ina lâtid] is môd spanen,
17.1481: that [he] beginna thero girnean, thiu imu gegangan ni skal.
17.1482: Than haƀed he an imu selƀon sân sundea gewarhta,
17.1484: Ef than thana man is [siun] wili ettha is [swîðare] hand
17.1485: farlêdien is liðo hwilik an lêðan weg,
17.1486: than is erlo gehwem ôðar betara,
17.1487: firiho barno, that he ina fram werpa
17.1488: endi thana lið lôsie af is lîkhamon
17.1489: endi ina âno kuma up te himile,
17.1490: than he [sô] mid allun te them inferne,
17.1491: hwerƀe mid sô hêlun an helligrund.
17.1492: Than mênid thiu [lêfhêd], that ênig liudeo ni skal
17.1493: farfolgan is friunde, ef he ina an firina spanit,
17.1494: swâs man an saka: [than ne sî he imu eo sô swîðo an sibbiun bilang],
17.1495: [ne] iro mâgskepi sô mikil, ef he ina an morð spenit,
17.1496: bêdid baluwerko; betera is imu than ôðar,
17.1497: that he thana friund fan imu fer farwerpa,
17.1498: mîðe thes mâges endi ni hebbea thar êniga [minnea] tô,
17.1499: that he môti êno up gestîgan

18.1502: Ôk is an them êo geskriƀan
18.1503: wârun wordun, sô gi witun alle,
18.1505: ni forswerie ina selƀon, [hwand] that is sundie te mikil,
18.1507: Than willeo ik iu [eft] seggean, than sân ni swerea neoman
18.1509: ne bi himile themu hôhon, hwand that is thes hêrron stôl,
18.1510: ne bi erðu thar undar, hwand that is thes alowaldon
18.1511: fagar fôtskamel, nek ênig firiho barno
18.1512: ne swerea bi is selƀes hôƀde, hwand he ni mag thar ne swart ne hwît
18.1513: ênig hâr gewirkean, [bûtan] sô it the hêlago god,
18.1515: erlos êðwordo. Sô hwe sô it ofto dôt,
18.1516: sô wirðid is simbla wirsa, hwand he [imu] giwardon ni mag.
18.1517: Bithiu skal ik iu nu te wârun wordun gibeodan,
18.1518: that gi neo ne swerien swîðoron êðos,
18.1519: mêron met mannun, [bûtan] sô ik iu mid mînun hêr
18.1521: ef man hwemu saka sôkea, [biseggea] that wâre,
18.1522: queðe iâ, gef it sî, [geha] thes thar wâr is,
18.1523: queðe nên, af it nis, [lâta] im genôg an thiu;
18.1524: sô hwat sô is mêr oƀar that man gefrummiad,
18.1525: sô kumid it [al] fan uƀile eldibarnun,
18.1526: that erl thurh untrewa ôðres ni uili
18.1527: [wordo] gelôƀian. Than seggio ik iu te wâron ôk,
18.1528: [hwô] it thar an them aldon êo gebiudit:
18.1529: sô [hwe] sô ôgon genimid ôðres mannes,
18.1530: lôsid af is lîkhaman, ettha is [liðo hwilikan],
18.1531: that he it eft mid is selƀes skal sân antgelden
18.1532: mid gelîkun liðion. Than willio ik iu lêrian nu,
18.1533: that gi sô ni [wrekan] wrêða dâdi,
18.1534: ak [that] gi thurh ôdmôdi al gethologian
18.1535: wîties endi wammes, sô hwat sô man iu an thesoro weroldi gedôe.
18.1537: frume endi gefôri, sô he willie, that im [firiho] barn
18.1538: gôdes angegin dôen. Than wirðit im god mildi,
18.1539: liudio sô hwilikum, sô that lêstien wili.
18.1540: Êrod gi [arme man], dêliad iwan ôdwelon
18.1541: undar thero thurftigon thiodu; ne rôkead, hweðar gi [is ênigan thank antfâhan]
18.1542: [eftho lôn an thesoro lêhneon weroldi, ak huggeat te iuwomu leoƀon hêrran]
18.1543: thero geƀono te gelde, that sie iu god lôno,
18.1544: mahtig mundboro, sô hwat sô gi is thurh is minnes [gidôt].
18.1545: Ef thu than geƀogean wili gôdun mannun
18.1546: fagare fehoskattos, thar thu [eft] frumono hugis
18.1547: mêr antfâhan, te hwî haƀas thu thes êniga mêda fon gode
18.1548: ettha lôn an [themu] is liohte? hwand [that] is lêhni feho.
18.1549: Sô is thes alles gehwat, [the] thu ôðrun geduos
18.1550: [liudeon] te leoƀe, thar [thu] hugis eft gelîk neman
18.1551: thero wordo endi thero werko: te hwî wêt thi thes [ûsa] waldand thank,
18.1552: thes thu thîn sô bifilhis endi [antfâhis] eft than thu wili?
18.1553: [Juwan ôðwelon geƀan gi them armun mannun,]
18.1554: [the ina iu an thesoro weroldi ne lônon endi rômot te iuwes waldandes rîkea.]
18.1555: Te hlûd ni dô thu [it], than thu mid thînun handun [bifelhas]
18.1556: thîna alamosna themu armon manne, ak [dô] im thurh ôdmôdien
18.1557: gerno thurh godes thank: than môst thu [eft geld niman],
18.1558: [swîðo] lioflîk lôn, thar thu is lango bitharft,

28.2285: [gôd werk] mid is jungeron, sô neo Judeon umbi that
28.2286: an thea is [mikilun kraft] thiu mêr ne gelôƀdun,
28.2288: landes endi liudio: thes sie noh lôn nimat,
28.2289: wîdana wraksîð, thes sie thar that gewin driƀun
28.2290: wið [selƀan] thene [sunu drohtines]. Thô he [im] mid is gesîðon giwêt
28.2291: eft an [Galilæo land], godes êgan barn,
28.2292: fôr im te them friundun, thar he afôdid was
28.2293: endi al undar is kunnie kindjung awôhs,
28.2294: the hêlago hêleand. Umbi ina heriskepi,
28.2295: theoda thrungun; thar was thegan manag
28.2296: sô sâlig undar them gesîðe. Thar drôgun ênna seokan man
28.2297: erlos [an] iro armun: weldun ina for ôgun Kristes,
28.2298: brengean for that barn godes - was im bôtono tharf,
28.2300: manno mundboro -, the was êr sô managan dag
28.2301: liðuwastmon bilamod, ni mahte is lîkhamon
28.2302: [wiht] gewaldan. Than was thar werodes sô filu,
28.2303: that sie ina fora that barn godes brengean ni mahtun,
28.2304: gethringan thurh thea thioda, that sie [sô] thurftiges
28.2305: sunnea gesagdin. Thô giwêt imu an ênna seli innan
28.2307: megintheodo gemang. Thô bigunnun thea man spreken,
28.2308: the thene lêfna lamon lango fôrdun,
28.2309: bârun mid is beddiu, hwô sie ina gedrôgin fora that [barn godes],
28.2310: [an] that werod innan, thar ina waldand Crist
28.2311: selƀo gisâwi. Thô gengun thea gesîðos tô,
28.2312: hôƀun ina mid iro handun endi uppan that hûs stigun,
28.2313: slitun thene seli oƀana endi [ina] mid sêlun lêtun
28.2314: an thene rakud innan, thar the rîkeo was,
28.2315: kuningo kraftigost. Reht sô he ina [thô] kuman gisah
28.2316: thurh thes hûses hrôst, sô he thô an iro hugi farstôd,
28.2317: an thero manno môdseƀon, that sie [mikilana] te imu
28.2318: gelôƀon habdun, thô he for then liudiun sprak,
28.2319: quað that he thene siakon man sundeono tômean
28.2320: lâtan weldi. Thô sprâkun im eft thea liudi angegin,
28.2322: word [aftarwarodun], quâðun that that ni mahti [giwerðen] sô,
28.2324: waldand thesaro weroldes. Thô habda eft is word garu
28.2325: mahtig barn godes: "ik gidôn that", quað he, "an thesumu [manne] skîn,
28.2326: the hîr sô siak ligid an thesumu seli innan,
28.2327: [te] wundron giwêgid, that ik gewald hebbiu
28.2328: sundea te fargeƀanne endi ôk seokan man
28.2329: te gehêleanne, sô ik ina hrînan ni tharf."
28.2330: Manoda ina thô the mâreo drohtin,
28.2331: liggeandean lamon, hêt ina far them liudiun astandan
28.2332: up alohêlan endi hêt ina an is ahslun niman,
28.2333: is bedgiwâdi te baka; he that gibod lêste
28.2334: sniumo for [themu] [gisîðea] endi geng imu eft gesund thanan,
28.2335: hêl fan themu hûse. Thô thes sô manag hêðin man,
28.2336: weros wundradun, quâðun that imu waldand self,
28.2338: mêron mahti than elkor ênigumu mannes sunie,
28.2339: kraft endi kûsti; sie ni weldun antkennean thoh,
28.2340: Judeo liudi, that he god wâri,
28.2341: ne gelôƀdun is lêran, ak habdun im lêðan strîd,
28.2342: wunnun wiðar is wordun: thes sie werk hlutun,
28.2343: [lêðlîk] lôngeld, endi sô noh lango skulun,
28.2344: thes sie ni weldun hôrien heƀen[kuninges],
28.2345: Cristes lêrun, thea he kûðde oƀar al,
28.2346: wîdo aftar thesaro weroldi, endi lêt sie is werk sehan
28.2347: allaro dago gihwilikes, is dâdi skawon,
28.2348: hôrien is hêlag word, the he te helpu gesprak
28.2349: manno barnun, endi sô manag mahtiglîk
28.2350: têkan getôgda, that sie [gitrûodin] thiu bet,
28.2351: gilôƀdin [an] is [lêra]. He sô managan lîkhamon
28.2353: fargaf fêgiun ferah, them the [fûsid] was
28.2354: helið an helsîð: [than gideda ina the] hêland self,
28.2355: Crist thurh is kraft mikil quikan aftar dôða,
28.2356: lêt ina an thesaro weroldi forð wunneono neotan.

29.2357: Sô hêlde he thea haltun man endi thea hâƀon sô self,
29.2358: bôtta, them thar blinde wârun, lêt sie [that] berhte lioht,
29.2360: gumono grimwerk. Ni was gio [Judeono] bethiu,
29.2362: an thene hêlagon Crist, ak habdun im [hardene] môd,
29.2363: swîðo starkan strîd, farstandan ni weldun,
29.2364: that sie habdun [forfangan] fîundun an willean,
29.2365: liudi mid iro gelôƀun. Ni was gio thiu latoro bethiu
29.2366: sunu drohtines, ak he sagde mid wordun,
29.2368: lêrde aftar themu lande, habde imu thero liudio sô filu
29.2369: giwenid mid is wordun, that im werod mikil,
29.2370: folk folgoda, endi he im filu sagda,
29.2371: be biliðiun that barn godes, thes sie ni mahtun an iro breostun farstandan,
29.2372: undarhuggean an iro herton, êr it im the hêlago Crist
29.2373: oƀar that erlo folk oponun wordun
29.2374: thurh is selƀes kraft seggean welda,
29.2375: mârean hwat he mênde. Thar ina megin umbi,
29.2378: wârfastun word. He stôd imu thô bi ênes watares staðe,
29.2379: ni welde thô bi themu gethringe oƀar that thegno folk
29.2380: an themu lande uppan thea lêra kûðean,
29.2381: ak geng imu thô the gôdo endi is jungaron mid imu,
29.2383: an ên skip innan, endi it skalden hêt
29.2384: lande rûmur, that ina thea liudi sô filu,
29.2385: thioda ni thrungi. Stôd thegan manag,
29.2386: werod bi themu watare, thar waldand Crist
29.2387: oƀar that liudio folk lêra sagde:
29.2388: "hwat, ik iu seggean mag", quað he, "gesîðos mîne,
29.2389: hwô imu ên erl bigan an erðu [sâian]
29.2390: [hrênkorni] mid is handun. Sum it an [hardan] stên
29.2392: that it [thar] mahti wahsan eftha [wurteo] gifâhan,
29.2393: kînan eftha biklîƀen, ak warð that korn farloren,
29.2394: [that thar an theru lêian gilag]. Sum it eft an land bifel,
29.2395: an erðun aðalkunnies: bigan imu aftar thiu
29.2397: [lôd] an lustun: was that land sô gôd,
29.2398: frânisko gifehod. Sum it eft bifallen warð
29.2399: an êna starka strâtun, thar stôpon gengun,
29.2401: [warð imu thar an erðu endi eft up gigeng],
29.2402: bigan imu an themu wege wahsen; thô it eft thes werodes farnam,
29.2403: thes folkes fard mikil endi fuglos alâsun,
29.2404: that [is] themu êksan wiht aftar ni môste
29.2405: werðan te willean, thes thar an thene weg bifel.
29.2406: Sum warð it than bifallen, thar sô filu stôdun
29.2408: warð imu thar an erðu endi eft up gigeng,
29.2409: kên imu thar endi [kliƀode]. Thô [slôgun thar] eft krûd an gimang,
29.2410: weridun imu thene wastom: habda it thes waldes hlea
29.2411: forana [oƀarfangan], that it ni [mahte] te ênigaro frumu werðen,
29.2413: Thô sâtun endi suîgodun gesîðos Cristes,
29.2414: wordspâha weros: was im wundar mikil,
29.2415: be hwilikun biliðiun that barn godes
29.2417: Thô bigan is thero erlo ên frâgoian
29.2419: tulgo werðliko: "hwat, thu gewald haƀas", [quað he],
29.2420: "ja an [himile ja an erðu], hêlag drohtin,
29.2422: gumono gêsto, endi wi thîne jungaron sind,
29.2423: an [ûsumu] hugi holde. Hêrro the gôdo,
29.2424: ef it thîn willeo sî, lât ûs thînaro wordo thar
29.2425: endi gihôrien, that wi it aftar thi
29.2427: Wi witun that thînun wordun wârlîk biliði
29.2428: forð folgoiad, endi ûs is firinun tharf,
29.2429: that wi thîn word endi thîn werk, - hwand [it] fan sulikumu gewittea kumid -
29.2430: that wi it an thesumu [lande at thi] lînon môtin."

30.2431: Thô im eft tegegnes gumono bezta
30.2432: andwordi gesprak: "ni mênde ik elkor wiht", [quað he,]
30.2434: wordo eftha werko; thit skulun gi [witan] alle,
30.2435: jungaron mîne, hwand iu fargeƀen haƀad
30.2436: waldand thesaro weroldes, that gi witan môtun
30.2438: them ôðrun skal man be biliðiun that gibod godes
30.2439: wordun wîsien. Nu williu ik iu te wârun hier
30.2440: mârien, hwat ik mênde, that gi mîna thiu bet
30.2441: oƀar al thit landskepi lêra farstandan.
30.2442: That sâd, that ik iu sagda, that is selƀes word,
30.2444: hwô man thea mârien skal oƀar [thene] middilgard,
30.2445: wîdo aftar thesaro weroldi. Weros sind im gihugide,
30.2448: that ina ni gewerðod, that he it be iuwon wordun [due,]
30.2449: that he [thesa] mîna lêra forð lêstien willie,
30.2450: ak werðad thar sô farlorana lêra mîna,
30.2451: godes ambusni endi iuwaro gumono word
30.2452: an themu uƀilon manne, sô ik iu êr sagda,
30.2453: that that korn farwarð, that thar mid kîðun ni mahte
30.2454: an themu stêne uppan stedihaft werðan.
30.2455: Sô wirðid al farloran eðilero sprâka,
30.2456: ârundi godes, sô hwat sô man themu uƀilon manne
30.2457: wordun gewîsid, endi [he] an thea wirson hand,
30.2459: an godes unwilean endi an gramono hrôm
30.2460: endi an fiures [farm]. Forð skal he [hêtean]
30.2462: Nio gi an thesumu lande thiu lês lêra mîna
30.2463: wordun ni wîsiad: is theses werodes sô filu,
30.2464: erlo aftar thesaro erðun: bistêd thar ôðar man,
30.2465: the is [imu jung] endi glau, - endi haƀad imu gôdan môd -,
30.2466: sprâkono spâhi endi wêt iuwaro spello giskêð,
30.2467: hugid is than an is herton endi hôrid thar mid is ôrun [tô]
30.2469: an is breost hledid that gibod godes,
30.2470: lînod endi lêstid: is is gilôƀo sô gôd,
30.2471: talod imu, hwô he ôðrana eft gihwerƀie
30.2474: Than brêdid an thes breostun that gibod godes,
30.2475: thie luƀigo gilôbo, sô an themu lande duod
30.2476: that korn mid kîðun, thar it [gikund] haƀad
30.2477: endi imu thiu [wurð] bihagod [endi wederes gang],
30.2478: regin endi sunne, that it is reht haƀad.
30.2479: Sô duod thiu godes lêra an themu gôdun manne
30.2480: dages endi nahtes, endi [gangid] imu [diuƀal] fer,
30.2481: wrêða wihti endi the ward godes
30.2483: anttat sie ina brengead, that thar bêðiu wirðid
30.2484: ja thiu lêra te frumu liudio barnun,
30.2485: [the] fan is mûðe kumid, [jak] wirðid the man gode;
30.2488: welono [thene] mêstan: farid imu an giwald godes,
30.2491: gelîk sulikumu gilôƀon. Wesad iuwaro lêrono forð
30.2492: mankunnie mildie; sie sind sô mislîka,
30.2493: heliðos gehugda: sum haƀad iro hardan strîd,
30.2495: is imu fêknes ful endi firinwerko.
30.2496: Than biginnid imu thunkean, than he undar theru thiodu stâd
30.2498: thea godes lêra, than thunkid imu, that he sie [gerno forð]
30.2499: lêstien willie; than biginnid imu thiu [lêra godes]
30.2500: an is hugi hafton, anttat imu [than] eft an hand kumid
30.2501: feho te gifôrea endi fremiði skat.
30.2503: than he imu farfâhid an fehogiri,
30.2504: aleskid thene gilôbon: than was imu that luttil fruma,
30.2505: that he it gio an is hertan [gehugda,] ef he it halden ne wili.
30.2506: That is sô the wastom, the an themu wege began,
30.2507: liodan an themu lande: [thô] farnam ina eft thero liudio fard.
30.2508: Sô duot [thea] meginsundeon an [thes] mannes hugi
30.2509: thea godes lêra, ef he is ni gômid wel;
30.2510: elkor bifelliad sia ina ferne te boðme,
30.2512: ni] wirðid furður te frumu, ak ina fîund skulun
30.2513: [wîtiu giwaragean.] Simla gi mid wordun forð
30.2514: lêread an thesumu lande: ik kan thesaro liudio hugi,
30.2516: sô wanda wîsa sô werold haƀit
30.2517: Sum haƀit all te thiu is muod gilâtan endi [mêr] sorogot,
30.2518: hwô hie that [hord bihalde, than] hwô hie heƀankuninges
30.2519: willeon giwirkie. Bethiu thar wahsan ni mag
30.2520: that hêlaga gibod godes, thoh it thar ahafton mugi,
30.2521: wurtion biwerpan, hwand it thie welo thringit.
30.2522: Sô samo sô that krûd endi thie thorn that korn antfâhat,
30.2523: weriat im thena [wastom], sô duot thie welo manne:
30.2524: giheftid is herta, that hie it gihuggian ni muot,
30.2525: thie man an is muode, thes hie mêst bitharf,
30.2526: hwô hie that giwirkie, than lang thie hie an thesaro weroldi sî,
30.2527: that hie ti êwondage after muoti
30.2528: hebbian thuru is hêrren thank himiles rîki,
30.2529: sô endilôsan welon, sô that ni [mag] ênig man
30.2530: witan an thesaro weroldi. Nio hie sô wîdo ni kan
30.2531: te githenkeanne, thegan an is muode,
30.2532: that it bihaldan mugi herta thes mannes,
30.2533: that hie that ti wâron witi, hwat waldand god haƀit
30.2534: guodes gigerewid, that all geginwerd stêð
30.2535: manno sô hwilikon, sô ina hier minniot wel
30.2536: endi selƀo te thiu is seola gihaldit,
30.2537: that hie an lioht godes lîðan muoti."

31.2538: Sô wîsda hie thuo mid wordon, stuod werod mikil
31.2539: umbi that barn godes, gehôrdun ina bi biliðon filo
31.2540: umbi thesaro weroldes giwand wordon tellian;
31.2541: quat that im ôk ên aðales man an is akker sâidi
31.2543: wolda im thar sô wunsames wastmes tilian,
31.2544: fagares fruhtes. Thuo geng thar is fîond aftar
31.2545: thuru dernian hugi, endi it all mid durðu oƀarsêu,
31.2546: mid weodo [wirsiston.] Thuo wôhsun sia bêðiu,
31.2547: ge that korn ge that krûd. Sô quâmun gangan
31.2548: is hagastoldos te hûs, iro hêrren sagdun,
31.2550: "hwat, thu sâidos hluttar korn, hêrro thie guodo,
31.2551: [ênfald] an thînon akkar: nu ni gisihit ênig erlo than mêr
31.2552: weodes wahsan. Huî mohta that [giwerðan] sô?"
31.2553: Thuo sprak eft thie aðales man them erlon tegegnes,
31.2554: thiodan wið is thegnos, quat that hie it [mahti] undarthenkian wel,
31.2555: that im thar unhold man aftar sâida,
31.2556: fîond fêkni krûd: "ne [gionsta] mi thero fruhtio wel,
31.2557: awerda mi thena wastom." Thuo thar eft wini sprâkun,
31.2558: is jungron tegegnes, quâðun that sia thar weldin gangan tuo,
31.2559: kuman mid kraftu endi lôsian that krûd thanan,
31.2560: halon it mid iro handon. Thuo sprak im eft iro hêrro angegin:
31.2561: "ne welleo ik, that gi it wiodon", quathie, "hwand gi biwardon ni mugun,
31.2562: gigômean an iuwon gange, thoh gi it gerno ni duan,
31.2563: ni gi thes kornes te filo, kîðo awerdiat,
31.2564: felliat under iuwa fuoti. Lâte man sia forð hinan
31.2565: bêðiu wahsan, und êr bewod kume
31.2566: endi an them felde sind fruhti rîpia,
31.2567: aroa an them akkare: than faran wi thar alla tuo,
31.2568: halon it mid ûssan handon endi that hrênkurni lesan
31.2569: sûƀro tesamne endi it an mînon seli duoian,
31.2570: hebbean it thar gihaldan, that it hwergin ni mugi
31.2571: wiht awerdian, endi that wiod niman,
31.2572: bindan it te burðinnion endi werpan it an [bittar] fiur,
31.2573: lâton it thar haloian hêta lôgna,
31.2574: êld unfuodi." Thuo stuod erl manag,
31.2577: bôknien mid thiu biliðiu barno rîkeost.
31.2578: Bâdun thô sô gerno gôdan drohtin
31.2579: antlûkan thea lêra, that sia môstin thea liudi forð,
31.2580: hêlaga hôrean. Thô sprak [im] eft iro hêrro angegin,
31.2581: [mâri] mahtig Crist: "that is", quað he, "mannes sunu:
31.2582: ik selƀo [bium, that thar] sâiu, endi sind thesa sâliga man
31.2583: that hluttra hrênkorni, thea mi hêr hôread wel,
31.2584: wirkiad mînan willean; thius werold is the akkar,
31.2586: Satanas [selƀo is, that thar] sâid aftar
31.2587: [sô] lêðlîka lêra: haƀad thesaro liudeo sô filu,
31.2589: wirkead aftar is willeon; thoh skulun sie hêr wahsen forð,
31.2590: thea forgriponon gumon, sô samo sô thea gôdun man,
31.2591: anttat mûdspelles megin oƀar man ferid,
31.2592: endi thesaro [weroldes.] Than is allaro [akkaro] gehwilik
31.2593: gerîpod an thesumu rîkea: skulun iro regangiskapu
31.2594: frummien firiho barn. Than tefarid erða:
31.2595: that is allaro bewo brêdost; than kumid the berhto drohtin
31.2596: oƀana mid is engilo [kraftu,] endi kumad [alle] tesamne
31.2597: liudi, the io thit lioht gisâun, endi skulun than lôn antfâhan
31.2598: uƀiles endi gôdes. Than gangad engilos godes,
31.2599: hêlage heƀenwardos, endi [lesat] thea hluttron man
31.2600: sundor tesamne, endi duat sie an sinskôni,
31.2601: hôh himiles lioht, endi thea ôðra an [hellia grund,]
31.2602: werpad thea farwarhton an wallandi fiur;
31.2603: thar skulun sie gibundene bittra logna,
31.2604: thrâwerk tholon, endi thea ôðra thiodwelon
31.2607: weros [waldâdeo]. Sô hwe sô giwit êgi,
31.2608: gehugdi an is hertan, ettha gihôrien mugi,
31.2609: erl mid is ôrun, sô lâta imu [thit an innan sorga,]
31.2610: an is môdseƀon, hwô he skal an themu mâreon dage
31.2611: wið thene rîkeon god an [reðiu] standen
31.2612: wordo endi werko [allaro, the] he an thesaro weroldi giduod.
31.2614: forhtlîkost firiho barnun, that sie skulun wið iro frâhon mahlien,
31.2615: gumon wið thene gôdan drohtin: [than] weldi gerno gehwe wesan,
31.2617: slîðero sakono. Aftar thiu skal sorgon êr
31.2618: allaro liudeo gehwilik, êr he thit lioht [afgeƀe,]

32.2621: Sô gifragn ik that thô selƀo sunu drohtines,
32.2625: quað that oft luttiles hwat liohtora [wurði],
32.2627: that is simla [mêra,] than is man ênig
32.2628: wânie an thesaro weroldi. Ôk is imu that werk [gelîk,]
32.2629: that man an sêo innan segina wirpit,
32.2630: fisknet an flôd endi fâhit bêðiu,
32.2631: uƀile endi gôde, tiuhid up te staðe,
32.2632: liðod sie te lande, lisit aftar thiu
32.2633: thea gôdun an greote endi lâtid thea ôðra eft an grund faran,
32.2634: an wîdan wâg. Sô duod waldand god
32.2635: an themu mâreon dage menniskono barn:
32.2637: lisit imu than thea hluttron an heƀenrîki,
32.2638: lâtid thea fargriponon an grund faren
32.2640: thes wîties wiðarlâga, thes thar weros [thiggeat],
32.2642: Than hald ni mag thera mêdan man gimakon fîðen,
32.2643: ni thes [welon ni thes] willeon, thes thar waldand skerid,
32.2645: sô ina hêr gihaldid, that he an heƀenrîki,
32.2646: an that langsame lioht lîðan môti."
32.2647: Sô lêrda he thô mid listiun. Than fôrun thar thea liudi tô

32.2650: sô spâhlîko gisprokan, that he spel [godes

32.2656: awôhs al undar thesumu [werode:] hwanen [skoldi] imu sulik gewit kuman,
32.2657: mêron mahti, than hêr ôðra [man] êgin?"
32.2658: Sô farmunste ina that manno folk endi [sprâkun] im gimêdlik word,

32.2660: is [gibodskepies]. Ni he thar ôk biliðeo filu
32.2661: thurh iro ungilôƀon ôgean ni welde,
32.2662: torhtero têkno, hwand he wisse iro twîflean hugi,
32.2663: [iro] wrêðan willean, that ni wârun weros ôðra
32.2664: sô grimme under Judeon, sô wârun umbi [Galilæo land,]

32.2669: wêgdin te wundron. Hêtun thô iro werod [kumen,]
32.2672: wrêðes] willeon; ni was im is wordo niud,

32.2674: hwô sie ina sô kraftagne [fan] ênumu kliƀe wurpin,

32.2677: frôlîko fôr: ni was imu [foraht] hugi,
32.2678: - wisse that imu ni mahtun menniskono barn,
32.2680: êr is tîdiun wiht teonon gifrummien,
32.2681: lêðaro gilêsto -, ak he imu mid them liudiun samad
32.2682: stêg uppen thene stênholm, antthat sie te theru stedi quâmun,
32.2683: thar sie ine [fan] themu [walle niðer] werpen hugdun,
32.2684: fellien te foldu, that he wurði is ferhes lôs,
32.2685: is aldres at endie. Thô warð thero erlo hugi,
32.2687: Juðeono tegangen, that iro ênig ni habde sô grimmon seƀon
32.2688: ni sô wrêðen willeon, [that sie mahtin thene waldandes sunu,
32.2690: that sie ina thô undarwissin. Sô mahte he undar ira werode standen
32.2691: endi an iro gimange middiumu gangen,
32.2692: faren undar iro folke. He dede imu thene friðu selƀo,
32.2693: mundburd wið theru menegi endi giwêt imu thurh middi thanan
32.2694: thes fîundo folkes, fôr imu thô, thar he welde,
32.2697: hwar [imu] an themu lande leoƀost wâri

33.2689: Johannes mid is jungarun, godes ambahtman,
33.2701: hêt that sie frume fremidin, firina farlêtin,
33.2702: mên endi morðwerk. He was thar managumu [liof]
33.2703: gôdaro gumono. He sôhte imu thô thene Judeono kuning,
33.2704: thene heritogon at hûs, the hêten [ûuas]
33.2706: bûide imu be theru brûdi, thiu êr sînes brôðer was,
33.2707: idis [an êhti,] anttat he ellior skôk,
33.2708: werold weslode. Thô imu that wîf ginam
33.2709: the kuning te quenun; êr wârun iro kind [ôdan,]
33.2710: barn be is brôðer. Thô [bigan] imu thea brûd lahan
33.2711: Johannes the gôdo, quað that it gode wâri,
33.2712: waldande wiðermôd, that it ênig wero frumidi,
33.2713: that brôðer brûd an is bed nâmi,
33.2714: hebbie sie imu te hîwun. "Ef thu mi hôrien wili,
33.2715: gilôƀien mînun lêrun, ni skalt thu sie leng êgan,
33.2716: ak mîð ire an thînumu môde: ni haƀa [thar] sulika minnea tô,
33.2717: ni sundeo thi te swîðo." Thô warð an sorgun hugi
33.2718: thes wîƀes aftar them wordun; andrêd that he thene weroldkuning
33.2720: that he sie farlêti. Began siu imu thô lêðes filu
33.2721: râden an rûnon, endi ine rinkos hêt,
33.2725: [ine] ferahu bilôsien, hwand sie wârun imu friund alle,
33.2726: wissun ine sô gôden endi gode werðen,
33.2727: [habdun ina for wârsagon, sô sia wela mahtun.]
33.2728: Thô wurðun an themu gêrtale [Judeo] kuninges
33.2729: tîdi kumana, sô thar gitald habdun
33.2731: an lioht kuman. Sô was thero liudio thau,
33.2733: Judeono mid gômun. Thô warð thar an thene gastseli
33.2735: [heritogono] an that hûs, thar iro hêrro was
33.2737: Judeon an thene gastseli; warð im thar gladmôd hugi,
33.2738: blîði an iro breostun: gisâhun iro bâggeƀon
33.2739: wesen an wunneon. Drôg man wîn an flet
33.2741: gengun mid goldfatun: gaman was thar inne
33.2742: hlûd an thero hallu, heliðos drunkun.
33.2743: Was thes an lustun landes hirdi,
33.2744: hwat he themu werode mêst te wunniun [gifremidi.]
33.2745: Hêt he thô gangen forð gêla thiornun,
33.2746: is brôder barn, thar he an is benki sat
33.2747: wînu giwlenkid, endi thô te themu wîbe sprak;
33.2748: grôtte sie fora themu gumskepie endi gerno bad,
33.2749: that siu thar fora them gastiun gaman afhôƀi
33.2750: fagar an flettie: "lât thit folk sehan,
33.2752: te [blîðseanne an] benkiun; ef thu [mi thera] bede [tugiðos],
33.2753: mîn word for thesumu werode, than williu ik it hêr te wârun [gequeðen,]
33.2754: liahto fora thesun liudiun endi ôk gilêstien sô,
33.2755: that ik thi than aftar thiu êron williu,
33.2756: sô hues sô thu mi bidis for thesun mînun bâgwiniun:
33.2757: thoh thu mi thesaro heridômo halƀaro fergos,
33.2758: rîkeas mînes, [thoh gidôn ik,] that it ênig rinko ni mag
33.2759: wordun giwendien, endi it skal giwerðen sô."
33.2760: Thô warð thera magað aftar thiu môd gihuorƀen,
33.2761: hugi aftar iro hêrron, that siu an themu hûse innen,
33.2762: an themu gastseli gamen up ahuof,
33.2763: al sô thero liudio landwîse gidrôg,
33.2764: thero thiodo thau. Thiu thiorne spilode
33.2765: hrôr aftar themu hûse: hugi was an lustun,
33.2768: endi allumu themu erlskepie, [the] thar inne was
33.2769: gôdaro gumono, siu welde thô ira geƀa êgan,
33.2770: thiu magað for theru menegi: geng thô wið iro môdar sprekan
33.2772: hues siu thene [burges] ward biddien skoldi.

33.2779: is word wendien: hêt thô is wâpanberand
33.2780: gangen fan themu gastseli endi hêt thene godes man
33.2781: lîƀu bilôsien. Thô ni was lang te thiu,
33.2782: that man an thea halla hôƀid brâhte
33.2783: thes thiodgumon, endi it thar theru thiornun fargaf,
33.2784: magað for theru menegi: siu drôg it theru môder forð.
33.2786: thes wîsoston, [thero the gio] an thesa werold [quâmi],
33.2788: idis fan erle, lêt man simla then [ênon] biforan,
33.2789: the thiu thiorne [gidrôg], [the] gio thegnes ni warð
33.2790: wîs an iro weroldi, [biûtan] sô ine waldand god
33.2792: gimarkode mahtig: the ni habde [ênigan] gimakon hwergin
33.2795: sâlig gesîði, endi ine an sande bigrôƀun,
33.2796: leoƀes lîkhamon: wissun that he lioht godes,

34.2805: gôdes mannes forgang, hwô habde the Judeono kuning
34.2807: hôƀdu bihauwan: he ni welde [is ênigen] harm spreken,

34.2810: an friðe wiðer fîundun. Thô [sô] gifrâgi warð

34.2842: Andreas fora them erlun endi themu alowaldon
34.2843: selƀumu sagde, that sie an iro gisîðie than mêr
34.2845: fîƀi an ûsaru ferdi endi fiskos twêne.
34.2846: Hwat mag that thoh thesaru menigi?" Thô sprak [imu] eft mahtig Krist,
34.2847: the gôdo godes sunu, endi hêt that gumono folk
34.2848: skerien endi skêðen endi hêt thea skola settien,

34.2851: allaro barno bezt, hêt imu thiu brôd halon
34.2852: endi thea fiskos forð. That folk stillo bêd,
34.2853: sat gesîði mikil; undar thiu he thurh is selƀes kraft,
34.2855: hêlag heƀenkuning, [endi] mid is handun brak,
34.2856: gaf it is jungarun forð, endi [it] sie undar themu gumskepie [hêt]
34.2857: dragan endi dêlien. Sie lêstun iro drohtines word,
34.2859: hêlaga helpa. [It] undar iro handun wôhs,
34.2860: meti manno gihwemu: theru meginthiodu warð
34.2861: lîf an lustun, thea liudi wurðun alle,
34.2862: sade sâlig folk, sô hwat sô thar gisamnod was
34.2863: fan allun wîdun wegun. Thô hêt waldand Krist
34.2864: gangen is jungaron endi hêt sie gômien wel,
34.2865: that thiu lêƀa thar farloren ni wurði;
34.2866: hêt sie thô samnon, thô thar sade wârun
34.2868: brôdes te lêƀu, that man birilos gilas

34.2870: grôt kraft godes, hwand thar was gumono gitald
34.2872: fîf thûsundig. That folk al farstôd,
34.2873: thea man an iro môde, that sie thar mahtigna
34.2875: thea liudi loƀodun, quâðun that gio ni wurði an thit lioht kuman

34.2884: gikurin ine te kuninge: that Kriste ni was

34.2886: erðe endi uphimil thurh is ênes kraft

35.2899: Thô telêt that liudwerod aftar themu lande allumu,
35.2900: tefôr folk mikil, sîðor iro frâho giwêt
35.2901: an that gebirgi uppan, barno rîkeost,
35.2902: waldand an is willeon. Thô te thes watares staðe
35.2903: samnodun thea gesîðos Cristes, the he imu habde selƀo gikorane,
35.2904: sie tweliƀi thurh iro trewa gôda: ni was im tweho nigiean,
35.2905: neƀu sie an [that] godes thionost gerno weldin
35.2906: oƀar thene sêo sîðon. Thô lêtun [sie swîðean] strôm,
35.2911: forðwardes an flôd; warð thiu fiorðe tid
35.2913: warode [thea wâglîðand -:] thô warð wind mikil,
35.2916: thea weros wiðer winde, was im wrêð hugi,
35.2917: seƀo sorgono ful: selƀon ni wândun
35.2919: thurh thes wederes gewin. Thô gisâhun sie waldand Krist
35.2920: an themu sêe uppan selƀun gangan,
35.2921: faran an fâðion: ni mahte an thene flôd innan,
35.2922: an thene sêo sinkan, hwand ine is selƀes kraft
35.2923: hêlag anthabde. Hugi warð an forhtun,
35.2924: thero [manno] môdseƀo: andrêdun that it im mahtig fîund
35.2925: te [gidroge] dâdi. Thô sprak im iro drohtin tô,
35.2926: hêlag heƀenkuning, endi sagde im that [he] iro hêrro was
35.2927: mâri endi mahtig: "nu gi môdes skulun
35.2928: fastes fâhen; ne sî iu forht hugi,
35.2929: [gibâriad] gi baldlîko: ik bium that barn godes,
35.2930: is selƀes sunu, the iu wið thesumu sêe skal,
35.2931: mundon wið thesan meristrôm." Thô sprak imu ên thero manno angegin
35.2933: Petrus [the] gôdo - ni welde pîne tholon,
35.2934: watares wîti -: "ef thu it waldand sîs", quað he,
35.2935: "hêrro the gôdo, sô mi an mînumu hugi thunkit,
35.2936: [hêt] mi than tharod gangan te thi oƀar thesen geƀenes strôm,
35.2937: [drokno] oƀar diap water, ef thu mîn drohtin sîs,
35.2938: managoro mundboro." Thô hêt ine mahtig Crist
35.2939: gangan imu tegegnes. He warð garu sâno,
35.2940: stôp [af] themu stamne endi strîdiun geng
35.2942: thene man thurh maht godes, antat he [imu] an is môde bigan
35.2943: andrâden diap water, thô he drîƀen gisah
35.2944: thene wêg mid windu: wundun ina [ûðeon],
35.2945: [hôh] strôm umbihring. Reht sô he thô an is hugi twehode,
35.2946: sô wêk imu that water under, endi he an thene wâg innan,
35.2947: sank an thene sêostrôm, endi [he] hriop sân aftar thiu
35.2948: [gâhon] te themu godes sunie endi gerno bad,
35.2949: that he ine thô [generidi, thô] he an [nôdiun] was,
35.2951: antfeng ine [mid] is faðmun endi frâgode sâna,
35.2952: te huî he [thô getwehodi:] "hwat, thu [mahtes] getrûoian wel,
35.2953: witen that te wârun, that [thi] watares [kraft]
35.2954: an themu sêe innen thînes sîðes ni mahte,
35.2955: lagustrôm [gilettien], sô lango sô thu [habdes] gelôƀon te mi
35.2956: an thînumu [hugi] hardo. Nu williu ik thi an helpun wesen,
35.2957: [nerien thi] an thesaru nôdi". Thô nam ine alomahtig,
35.2958: hêlag bi handun: thô warð imu eft hlutter water
35.2959: fast under fôtun, endi sie an fâði samad
35.2960: bêðea gengun, antat sie oƀar bord skipes
35.2961: stôpun [fan] themu strôme, [endi] an themu stamne gesat
35.2962: allaro barno bezt. Thô [warð] brêd water,
35.2963: strômos gestillid, endi sie te staðe quâmun,
35.2965: thurh [thes] wateres gewin, [sagdun tho] waldande thank,
35.2967: fellun imu te fôtun endi filu sprâkun
35.2968: wîsaro wordo, quâðun that sie wissin garo,
35.2969: that he wâri selƀo sunu drohtines
35.2970: wâr an thesaru weroldi endi gewald habdi
35.2971: oƀar middilgard, endi that he mahti allaro manno gihwes
35.2972: ferahe giformon, [al] sô he [im] an themu flôde dede

36.2974: sîðon fan themu sêe, sunu drohtines,
36.2977: ferran gefrâgi, that he sô filu sagde
36.2979: that he sulik folkskepi frummien môsti,
36.2980: that sie simla gerno gode thionodin,
36.2982: mankunnies manag. Thô giwêt he imu oƀer thea marka Judeono,
36.2983: sôhte imu Sidono burg, habde [gesîðos] mid imu,
36.2984: gôde jungaron. Thar imu tegegnes quam
36.2985: ên idis fan âðrom thiodun; siu was iru aðaligeburdeo,
36.2986: kunnies fan Cananeo lande; siu bad thene [kraftagan] drohtin,

36.2995: folgode fruokno, antat siu te is fôtun quam,
36.2997: bâdun iro hêrron, that he an is hugea mildi
36.2998: wurði themu wîƀe. Thô habde eft is word garu
36.2999: sunu drohtines endi [te] is gesîðun sprak:
36.3001: folkskepi te [frumu,] that sie ferhtan hugi
36.3002: hebbian te iro hêrron: im is helpono tharf,
36.3003: thea liudi sind farlorane, farlâten habbiad

36.3018: "Wâr is that, waldand", quað siu, "that thu mid thînun wordun sprikis,
36.3019: sôðlîko sagis: hwat, thoh oft an seli innen
