41.3374: lêðaro sprâka, alles is mi nu thes lôn kumen."
41.3375: Imu [andwordiade] thô Abraham - that was aldfader -:
41.3376: "gehugi thu an thînumu herton", quað he, "hwat thu habdes iu
41.3377: welono an weroldi. Hwat, thu thar alle thîne wunnea farsliti,
41.3378: gôdes an gardun, sô hwat sô thi giƀiðig forð
41.3380: Lazarus an themu liohte, habde thar lêðes filu,
41.3381: wîteas an weroldi. Bethiu skal he nu [welon] êgan,
41.3382: libbien an lustun: thu skalt thea logna tholan,
41.3383: brinnendi fiur: ni mag is thi ênig bôte kumen
41.3384: hinana te helliu: it haƀad the hêlago god
41.3385: sô [gifastnod] mid is faðmun: ni mag thar faren ênig
41.3386: thegno thurh that [thiustri:] it is hêr sô thikki undar ûs."
41.3387: Thô sprak eft Abrahame the erl tegegnes
41.3388: fan theru hêtan hell endi helpono bad,
41.3389: that he Lazarus an liudio drôm
41.3391: brôðarun mînun, hwô ik hêr brinnendi
41.3392: thrâwerk tholon; si [thar] undar theru [thiodu] sind,
41.3393: si fîƀi undar themu folke: ik an forhtun bium,
41.3394: that sie im thar farwirkien, that sie skulin ôk an thit wîti te mi,
41.3395: an sô grâdag fiur." Thô imu eft tegegnes sprak
41.3396: Abraham aldfader, quað that sie thar êo godes
41.3398: Moyseses gibôd endi thar managaro tô
41.3399: wârsaguno word: "ef sie is willige sind,
41.3400: that sie that bihalden, than ni thurƀun sie an [thea] hell innen,
41.3401: an that fern faren, ef sie [gefrummiad] sô,
41.3402: sô thea gebiodad, [the thea] bôk lesat
41.3403: them liudiun te [lêrun.] Ef sie thes than ni williad lêstien wiht,
41.3404: thanne ni hôriad sie ôk themu the [hinan] astâd,
41.3405: man fan dôðe. Lâte man sie an iro môdseƀon
41.3406: selƀon keosen, hweðer im suôtiera thunkie
41.3407: te giwinnanne, sô lango sô sie an thesaru weroldi sind,
41.3408: that sie eft uƀil ettha gôd aftar habbien."

42.3409: Sô lêrde he thô thea liudi liohton wordon,
42.3410: allaro barno bezt, endi biliði sagde
42.3412: quað that imu [ên] sâlig gumo samnon bigunni
42.3413: man an morgen, "endi im mêda gihêt,
42.3414: the hêrosto thes hîwiskeas, swîðo holdlîk lôn",
42.3415: quat that hie iro allaro gihwem ênna gâƀi
42.3417: weros an is wîngardon, - endi hie im werk bifalah -
42.3418: âdro an ûhtan. Sum quam thar ôk an undorn tuo,
42.3419: sum quam thar an middian dag, man te them werke,
42.3420: sum quam thar te nônu, thuo was thiu niguða tîd
42.3421: sumarlanges dages; sum thar ôk sîðor quam
42.3422: an thia elliftun tîd. Thuo geng thar âƀand tuo,
42.3423: sunna ti sedle. Thuo hie selƀo gibôd
42.3425: that man thero [manno] gihwem is meoda forguldi,
42.3426: them erlon arƀidlôn; hiet thiem at êrist geƀan.
42.3427: thia [thar at] lezt wârun, liudi kumana,
42.3428: weros te them [werke,] endi mid is wordon gibôd,
42.3429: that man them mannon iro mieda forguldi
42.3430: alles at aftan, them thar quâmun at êrist tuo
42.3431: willendi te them werke. Wândun sia swîðo,
42.3432: that man im mêra lôn [gimakod] habdi
42.3433: wið iro araƀedie: than man im allon gaf,
42.3434: them liudeon gilîko. Lêð was that swîðo,
42.3435: allon them ando, them thar quâmun at êrist tuo:
42.3436: "wi quâmun hier an moragan", quâðun sia, "endi tholodun hier manag te dage
42.3438: skînandia sunna: nu ni giƀis thu ûs skattes than mêr,
42.3439: thie thu them ôðron duos, thia hier êna hwîla
42.3440: wâron an thînon werke." Thuo habda eft is word garo
42.3441: thie [hêrosto] thes hîwiskes, quat [that] hie im ni habdi gihêtan than mêr
42.3442: werðes wið iro werke: "hwat, ik giwald hebbiu", quathie,
42.3443: "that ik iu allon gilîko muot lôn forgeldan,
42.3444: iwes werkes werð." Than waldandi Crist
42.3445: mênda im thoh mêra thing, thoh hie oƀar that manno folk
42.3446: fan them wîngardon sô wordon sprâki,
42.3448: weros te them werke. Sô skulun fan thero weroldi duon
42.3449: mannkunnies barn an that mârio lioht,
42.3450: gumon an godes wang: sum biginnit ina giriwan sân
42.3451: an is kindiski, haƀit im [gikoranan] muod,
42.3453: farlâtit is lusta; ni mag ina is lîkhamo
42.3456: wrêðaro willion, duot im sô te is weroldi forð,
42.3457: lêstit sô an theson liohte, [antthat] im is lîƀes kumit,
42.3459: thar] wirðit im is araƀedi all gilônot,
42.3460: fargoldan mid guodu an godes rîkie.
42.3461: That mêndun thia wuruhteon, thia an them wîngardon
42.3464: erlos unt âƀand. Sum thar ôk an undern quam,
42.3466: thes dagwerkes forduolon; sô duot doloro filo,
42.3467: gimêdaro manno: drîƀit im mislîk thing
42.3468: gerno an is juguði, - haƀit im gelpquidi
42.3471: that ina after is juguði godes anst manot
42.3472: blîði an is brioston; fâhit im te beteron than
42.3473: wordon endi werkon, lêdit im is werold mid thiu,
42.3474: is aldar ant thena endi: kumit im alles lôn
42.3477: swâra sundiun, fâhit im an sâlig thing,
42.3478: biginnit im thuru godes kraft guodaro werko,
42.3479: buotit balosprâka, lâtit im is [bittrun] dâd
42.3480: an is hugie hrewan; kumit im thiu helpa fon gode,
42.3481: that im gilêstid thie gilôƀo, sô lango sô im is lîf warod;
42.3482: farit im forð mid thiu, antfâhit is mieda,
42.3483: guod lôn at gode; ni sindun êniga geƀa beteran.
42.3484: Sum biginnit [than] ôk furðor, than hie ist fruodot mêr,
42.3485: is aldares afheldit, - than biginnat im is uƀilon werk
42.3486: lêðon an theson liohte, than ina lêra godes
42.3487: gimanod an is muode: wirðit im mildera hugi,
42.3488: thurugengit im mid guodu endi geld nimit,
42.3489: hôh himilrîki, than hie hinan wendit,
42.3490: wirðit im is mieda sô sama, sô them mannun warð,
42.3491: thea thar te [nônu] dages, an thea nigunda tîd,
42.3493: Sum wirðid than sô swîðo gefrôdot, sô he ni wili is sundea bôtien,
42.3494: ak he ôkid sie mid uƀilu gehwiliku, antat imu is âƀand nâhid,
42.3495: is [werold] endi is wunnea farslîtid; than beginnid he imu [wîti andrêden],
42.3496: [is sundeon werðad imu] sorga an môde: gehugid [hwat] he selƀo gefrumide
42.3497: grimmes than [lango], the he môste is [iuguðeo] neoten; ni mag than mid ôðru gôdu gibôtien
42.3498: thea dâdi, thea he sô derƀea gefrumide, ak he slehit allaro dago gihwilikes
42.3499: an is breost mid bêðiun handun endi wôpit sie mid bittrun trahnun,
42.3500: hlûdo he sie mid hofnu kûmid, bidid thene hêlagon drohtin
42.3501: mahtigne, that he imu mildi werðe: ni lâtid [imu] sîðor is môd gitwîflien;
42.3502: sô êgrohtful is, the thar alles geweldid: he ni wili ênigumu irmin[manne]
42.3503: farwernien willean sînes; fargiƀid imu waldand selƀo
42.3504: hêlag [himilrîki:] than is imu giholpen sîður.
42.3505: Alle skulun sie thar êra antfâhen, thoh sie tharod te ênaru tîdi
42.3506: ni kumen, that [kunni manno], thoh [wili] imu the kraftigo drohtin,
42.3507: gilônon allaro liudio [sô hwilikumu], sô hêr is gilôƀon antfâhit:
42.3509: mannun te mêdu. That mênde mahtig Krist,
42.3510: barno that bezte, thô he that biliði sprak,
42.3511: hwô thar te them wîngardun wurhteon quâmin,
42.3512: man mislîko: thoh nam is mêde gehwe
42.3513: fulle te [is] frôian. Sô skulun firiho barn
42.3515: swîðo leoƀlîk lôn, thoh sie sume [sô late werðan.]

43.3516: Hêt imu thô thea is gôdan jungaron nâhor
43.3517: tweliƀi gangan - thea wârun imu triuwiston
43.3518: man oƀar erðu -, sagde im mahtig [selƀo
43.3520: tôward wârun: "thes ni mag ênig tweho werðen", quað he.
43.3521: Quað that sie thô te Hierusalem an that Judeono folk
43.3522: lîðan skoldin: "thar wirðid all gilêstid sô,
43.3523: gefrumid undar themu folke, sô it an furndagun
43.3524: wîse man be mi wordun gesprâkun.
43.3525: Thar skulun mi farkôpon undar thea kraftigon thiod,
43.3526: heliðos te theru hêri; thar werðat mîna hendi [gebundana,]
43.3527: faðmos werðad mi thar gefastnod; filu skal ik thar [githoloian,]
43.3530: sie wêgeat mi te wundron wâpnes eggiun,
43.3531: bilôsiad mi lîƀu: ik te thesumu liohte skal
43.3532: thurh drohtines kraft fan dôðe astanden
43.3533: an thriddeon dage. Ni quam ik undar thesa theoda [herod
43.3534: te thiu,] that mîn eldibarn arƀed habdin,
43.3535: that mi thionodi thius [thiod:] ni williu ik is sie thiggien nu,
43.3536: fergon thit folkskepi, ak ik skal imu te frumu [werðen],
43.3537: theonon imu theolîko endi for alla thesa theoda geƀen
43.3538: seole mîne. Ik williu sie selƀo nu
43.3539: lôsien mid mînu lîƀu, thea hêr lango bidun,
43.3541: Fôr imu thô forðwardes - habde imu [fasten] hugi,
43.3542: blîðean an is breostun barn drohtines -
43.3544: willeon wîsan: he konste thes werodes sô garo
43.3547: furi Hierichoburg; was the godes sunu,
43.3548: mahtig undar [thero menigi. Thar sâtun twênie] man bi wege,
43.3549: blinde wârun sie bêðie: was im bôtono tharf,
43.3551: hwand sie sô lango liohtes tholodun,
43.3552: managa hwîla. Sie gihôrdun thô that megin faren
43.3556: hêrost an hôƀid. Thô sprak im ên helið angegin,
43.3557: quað that thar Hiesu Crist fan [Galilealande,]
43.3559: fôri mid is folku. Thô warð frâhmôd hugi
43.3560: bêðiun them blindun mannun, thô sie that barn godes
43.3561: wissun under themu werode: hreopun im thô mid iro wordun tô,
43.3562: hlûdo te themu hêlagon Criste, bâdun that he im helpe gerêdi:
43.3563: "drohtin Dauides sunu: wis ûs mid thînun dâdiun mildi,
43.3564: neri ûs af thesaru nôdi, sô thu ginôge dôs
43.3565: manno kunnies: thu bist managun gôd,
43.3566: hilpis endi hêlis." Tho bigan im that heliðo folk
43.3567: werien mid wordun, that sie an waldand Krist
43.3568: sô hlûdo ni hriopin. Si ni weldun [im] hôrien te thiu,
43.3569: ak sie simla mêr endi mêr oƀar that manno folk
43.3571: allaro barno bezt, hêt sie [thô] brengien te imu,
43.3572: lêdien thurh thea liudi, sprak im listiun tô
43.3573: [mildlîko] for theru menegi: "hwat williad [git] mînaro hêr", quað he,
43.3575: that he im ira ôgon opana gidâdi,
43.3576: farliwi theses liohtes, that sie liudio drôm,
43.3579: hrên sie thô mid is handun, dede is helpe thar tô,
43.3580: that them blindun thô bêðium wurðun
43.3581: ôgon gioponod, that sie erðe endi himil
43.3583: lioht endi liudi. Thô sagdun sie lof gode,
43.3584: diurdun [ûsan drohtin,] thes sie dages liohtes
43.3585: brûkan môstun: gewitun im bêðie mid imu,
43.3586: folgodun is ferdi: was im thiu fruma giƀiðig,
43.3587: endi ôk waldandes werk wîdo gekûðid,

44.3589: biliði gibôknid, thar the blindon man
44.3590: bi themu wege sâtun, wîti tholodun,
44.3591: liohtes lôse: that mênid thoh liudio barn,
44.3592: al mankunni, hwô sie mahtig god
44.3593: an themu anaginne thurh is ênes kraft
44.3595: Âdam endi Êvan: fargaf im upwegos,
44.3596: [himilo rîki;] ak thô warð im the hatola te nâh,
44.3597: fîund mid fêknu endi mid firinwerkun,
44.3598: bisuêk sie mid sundiun, that sie sinskôni,
44.3599: lioht farlêtun: wurðun an lêðaron stedi,
44.3604: fîundo barnun; sie guldun is im mid [fiuru] lôn
44.3605: an theru hêton [helliu.] Bethiu wârun siu an iro hugi blinda
44.3608: himilisken hêrron, thene [the] sie mid is handun giskôp,
44.3609: giwarhte an is willion. Thius werold was thô sô farhwerƀid,
44.3611: an dôðes dalu: sâtun im thô bi theru drohtines strâtun
44.3613: siu ni mahte im [thô] êr werðen, êr than waldand god
44.3616: that he lioht antluki liudio barnun,
44.3617: oponodi im êwig lîf, that sie thene [alowaldon
44.3619: Ôk mag ik giu [gitellien,] of gi thar tô williad
44.3620: huggien endi hôrien, that gi thes hêliandes [mugun]
44.3621: kraft antkennien, hwô is kumi wurðun
44.3623: ja hwat he mid them dâdiun drohtin selƀo
44.3624: manages mênde, ja behuiu thiu mârie burg
44.3626: gimakod mid mûrun: thiu is aftar themu mânen [ginemnid],
44.3627: aftar themu [torhten] tungle: he ni mag is tîdi bemîðen,
44.3629: wanod ohtho wahsid. Sô dôd an thesaro weroldi hêr,
44.3633: weros awahsane, unttat sie eft wurd farnimid.
44.3634: That mênde that barn godes, thô he fon theru burgi fôr,
44.3635: the gôdo fan Hiericho, that ni mahte êr werðen gumono barnun
44.3636: thiu [blindia] gibôtid, that sie that berhte lioht,
44.3637: gisâhin sinskôni, êr than he selƀo hêr
44.3639: flêsk [endi] lîkhamon. Thô wurðun thes firiho barn
44.3640: [giwar] an thesaru weroldi, the hêr an wîtie êr,
44.3642: tholodun an thiustrie, - [sie] afsôƀun that was [thesaru thiod] kuman
44.3644: Crist allaro kuningo best; sie mahtun is antkennien sân,
44.3645: gifôlien is fardio. Thô sie [sô] filu hriopun,
44.3646: the man te themu mahtigon gode, that im mildi aftar thiu
44.3648: thia swârun sundeon, the sie im êr [selƀon] gidâdun,
44.3649: [lettun] sie thes gilôbon. Sie ni mahtun them liudiun [thoh]
44.3650: biwerien iro willeon, ak sie [an] waldand god
44.3651: hlûdo hriopun, antat he im iro hêli fargaf,
44.3653: open êwig lioht endi an faren
44.3654: an thiu berhtun bû. That mêndun thea blindun man,
44.3655: the thar bi Hierichoburg te themu godes barne
44.3656: hlûdo hriopun, that he im iro hêli farlihi,
44.3657: liohtes an thesumu lîƀe: than [im thea liudi] sô filu
44.3658: weridun mid wordun, thea thar an themu wege fôrun
44.3659: biforen endi bihinden: sô dôt thea firinsundeon
44.3661: Hôriad nu hwô thie blindun, sîður im gibôtid warð,
44.3662: that sie sunnun lioht gesehen môstun,
44.3663: hwô si thô dâdun: gewitun im [mid iro] drohtine samad,
44.3664: folgodun is ferdi, sprâkun filu wordo
44.3665: themu landes hirdie [te] loƀe: sô dôd im noh liudio barn
44.3666: wîdo aftar thesaru weroldi, sîður im waldand [Crist]
44.3667: geliuhte mid is lêrun endi im lîf êwig,
44.3669: hôh himiles lioht endi is helpe thar tô,
44.3670: sô hwemu sô that giwerkod, that he môti themu is wege folgon.

45.3672: the gôdo te Hierusalem. Quam imu thar tegegnes filu
45.3674: antfengun ina fagaro endi imu biforen [streidun]
45.3675: thene weg mid iro giwâdiun endi mid wurtiun sô same,
45.3676: mid berhtun blômun endi mid bômo tôgun,
45.3677: that feld mid fagaron palmun, al sô is fard geburide,
45.3678: that the godes sunu gangan welde
45.3679: te theru mârean burg. Hwarf ina megin umbi
45.3681: that werod an willeon: sagdun waldande thank,
45.3682: thes thar selƀo quam sunu Dauides
45.3683: wîson thes werodes. Thô gesah waldand Krist
45.3684: the gôdo te Hierusalem, gumono bezta,
45.3685: blîkan thene [burges] wal endi bû Judeono,
45.3686: hôha horn[seli] endi ôk that hûs godes,
45.3687: allaro wîho [wunsamost]. Thô wel imu an innen
45.3688: hugi [wið] is herte: thô ni mahte that hêlage barn
45.3689: wôpu awîsien, sprak thô wordo filu
45.3690: hriwiglîko - was imu is hugi sêreg -:
45.3691: "Wê warð thi, Hierusalem", quað he, "thes thu te wârun ni [wêst]
45.3692: thea [wurdegiskefti], the thi noh giwerðen skulun,
45.3695: fîund mid folkun. Than ni haƀas thu friðu hwergin,
45.3696: mundburd mid mannun: lêdiad thi hêr [manage] tô
45.3700: felliad [te foldun:] ni [afstâd] is felis nigiean,
45.3701: stên oƀar ôðrumu, ak werðad thesa stedi wôstia
45.3703: hwand sie ni antkenniad, that im kumana sind
45.3704: iro tîdi tôwardes, ak sie habbiad im twîflien hugi,
45.3705: ni witun that iro wîsad waldandes kraft."
45.3706: Giwêt imu thô mid theru menegi manno drohtin
45.3707: an thea berhton burg. Sô thô that barn godes
45.3708: innan Hierusalem mid thiu gumono folku,
45.3709: [sêg] mid thiu gesîðu, thô warð [thar] allaro sango mêst,
45.3712: barno that bezte; thiu burg warð an hrôru,
45.3713: that folk warð an forhtun endi frâgodun sân,
45.3714: hwe that wâri, that thar mid [thiu werodu] quam,
45.3715: mid theru mikilon menegi. Thô sprak im ên man angegin,
45.3716: quað that thar Hiesu Crist fan Galileo lande,
45.3718: witig wârsago themu werode te helpu.
45.3719: Thô was them Judiun, the imu êr grame wârun,
45.3720: unholde an hugi, harm an môde,
45.3721: that imu thea [liudi sô filu] lofsang warhtun,
45.3722: diurdun iro drohtin. Thô gengun dolmôde,
45.3723: that sie wið waldand Crist wordun sprâkun,
45.3724: bâdun that he that gesîði suîgon hêti,
45.3725: letti thea liudi, that sie imu lof sô filu
45.3726: wordun ni warhtin: "it is thesumu werode lêð", quâðun sie,
45.3727: "thesun burgliudiun." Thô sprak eft [that] barn godes:
45.3728: "ef gi sie amerriad", quað he, "that hêr ni [môtin] manno barn
45.3730: than skulun it hrôpen thoh harde stênos
45.3732: êr than it eo belîƀe, [neƀo] man is lof [spreke]
45.3733: wîdo aftar thesaru [weroldi."] Thô he an thene wîh innen,
45.3734: geng an that godes hûs: fand thar Judeono filu,
45.3736: thea im thar kôpstedi gikoran habdun,
45.3737: mangodun im thar mid manages huî: muniterias sâtun
45.3738: an themu wîhe innan, habdun iro wesl gidago
45.3739: garu te geƀanne. That was themu godes barne
45.3740: al an andun: drêf sie ut thanen
45.3741: rûmo fan themu rakude, quað that wâri [rehtara] dâd,
45.3742: that thar te bedu fôrin barn Israheles
45.3747: unreht [ênfald.] Ne gi êniga êra ni witun
45.3749: Sô rûmde he thô endi rekode, rîki drohtin,
45.3750: that hêlaga hûs endi an helpun was
45.3751: managumu mankunnie, them the is mikilon kraft
45.3753: oƀar langan weg. Warð thar lêf so manag,
45.3754: halt gihêlid endi hâf sô same,

50.4118: Thô warð thar sô managumu manne môd aftar Kriste,
50.4119: gihuorƀen hugiskefti, sîðor sie is hêlagon werk
50.4120: selƀon gisâhun, hwand eo êr sulik ni warð
50.4121: wunder an weroldi. Than was eft thes werodes sô filu,
50.4122: [sô] môdstarke man: ni weldon [the] maht godes
50.4123: antkennien kûðlîko, ak sie wið is kraft mikil
50.4124: wunnun mid iro wordun: wârun im waldandes
50.4125: lêra so lêða: sôhtun [im] liudi ôðra
50.4129: Sie kûðdun im [thô] Kristes werk, quâðun that sie [quikan] sâhin
50.4130: thene erl mid iro ôgun, the an erðu was,
50.4132: dôd bidolƀen, antat he ina mid is dâdiun selƀo,
50.4133: mid is wordun awekide, that he [môsti] these werold sehan.
50.4134: Thô was that sô [wiðerward] wlankun mannun,
50.4135: Judeo liudiun: hêtun iro gumskepi thô,
50.4138: riedun an [runun:] "nis that râd ênig", quâðun sie,
50.4139: "that wi that githoloian: wili thesaro thioda te filu
50.4140: [gilôƀien] aftar is lêrun. Than ûs [liudi] farad,
50.4142: rinkos fan [Rûmu.] Than wi theses rîkies skulun
50.4143: lôse libbien eftha wi skulun ûses lîƀes tholon,
50.4144: heliðos ûsaro hôƀdo." Thô sprak thar ên [gihêrod] man
50.4145: [oƀar warf] wero, the was thes werodes thô
50.4146: an [theru burg innan] biskop thero liudio
50.4147: - Kaiphas was he hêten; habdun ina gikoranen te thiu
50.4149: that he thes godes hûses gômien [skoldi],
50.4150: [wardon] thes wîhes -: "mi thunkid wunder mikil", quað he,
50.4152: huî gi that te wârun ni witin, werod Judeono,
50.4153: that hêr is betera râd barno gehwilikumu,
50.4154: that man hêr ênne man aldru bilôsie
50.4155: endi that he thurh iuwa dâdi drôreg sterƀe,
50.4157: than al thit liudwerod farloren werðe."
50.4158: Ni was it thoh is willean, that he sô wâr gesprak,
50.4159: sô forð for themu folke, frume mankunnies
50.4160: gimênde for theru menegi, ak it quam imu fan theru maht godes
50.4161: thurh is hêlagan [hêd,] hwand he that hûs godes
50.4163: [wardon] thes wîhes: bethiu he sô wâr gisprak,
50.4164: biskop thero liudio, hwô skoldi that barn [godes]
50.4166: mid is lîƀu alôsien: that was allaro thesaro liudio râd,
50.4167: hwand he gihalode mid thiu [hêðina liudi,
50.4168: weros] an is willeon waldandio Crist.
50.4170: werod Judeono, endi an iro [warƀe] gisprâkun,
50.4171: mâri thioda, that sie im ni lêtin iro môd twehon:
50.4172: sô hwe sô ina undar themu folke finden mahti,
50.4173: that [ina] sân gifengi endi forð brâhti
50.4174: an thero thiodo thing; quâðun that sie ni mahtin [githoloian leng],
50.4175: that sie the êno man [sô alla weldi,]
50.4176: werod farwinnen. Than wisse waldand Krist
50.4178: hetigrimmon hugi, hwand imu ni was biholen eowiht
50.4179: an thesaru middilgard: he ni welde thô an thie [menigi] innen
50.4180: sîður openlîko, under that erlo folk,
50.4181: gangan under thea Judeon: bêd the godes sunu
50.4182: thero torohteon [tîd, the] imu tôward was,
50.4183: that he far thesa thioda [tholoian] welde,
50.4184: far thit werod wîti: wisse imu selƀo
50.4185: that dagthingi garo. Thô giwêt imu ûse drohtin forð
50.4186: endi imu thô an Effrem alowaldo Krist
50.4187: an theru hôhon burg hêlag drohtin
50.4188: wonode [mid is werodu,] antat he an is willean hwarf
50.4189: eft te Bethania brahtmu thiu mikilun,
50.4190: mid thiu is gôdum gumskepi. [Judeon bisprâkun that]
50.4191: wordu gehwiliku, thô sie imu sulik werod mikil
50.4192: folgon gisâhun: "nis frume ênig", quâðun sie,
50.4193: "ûses rîkies girâdi, thoh wi reht sprekan,
50.4194: ni [thîhit] ûses thinges wiht: [thius thiod] wili
50.4195: wendien after is willean; imu all thius werold folgot,
50.4196: liudi bi them is lêrun, that wi imu lêðes wiht

51.4198: Giwêt imu thô that barn godes innan Bethania
51.4202: that sie skoldun [haldan] thea hêlagon tîdi,
51.4203: Judeono pascha. Bêd the godes sunu,
51.4204: [mahtig] under theru menegi: was thar manno kraft,
51.4205: werodes bi them is wordun. Thar gengun [ina] twê wîf umbi,
51.4206: Maria endi Martha, mid mildiu hugi,
51.4208: gaf im langsam lôn: [lêt] sea lêðes gihwes,
51.4210: that sea an friðe fôrin wiðer fîundo nîð,
51.4211: thea idisa mid is orloƀu gôdu: habdun iro ambahtskepi
51.4212: biwendid an is willeon. Thô giwêt imu waldand Krist
51.4213: forð mid thiu folku, firiho drohtin,
51.4215: hetelîk hardburi, thar sie thea hêlagon tîd
51.4216: warodun [at] themu wîhe. Was thar werodes sô filu,
51.4217: kraftigaro kunnio, thie ni weldun Cristes [word]
51.4218: gerno [hôrien] ni te themu godes barne
51.4220: ak wârun im sô wrêða wlanka [thioda,]
51.4222: inwid an innan: an aƀuh farfengun
51.4224: wîtnon thero wordo; ak was thar werodes sô filu,
51.4226: habde ine thiu smale thiod thurh is suôtiun word
51.4227: werodu biworpen, that ine thie wiðersakon
51.4228: under themu folkskepi fâhen ne gidorstun,
51.4229: ak miðun is bi theru menegi. Than stôd mahtig Krist
51.4230: an themu wîhe innan, sagde word manag
51.4231: firiho barnun te frumu. Was thar folk umbi
51.4232: allan langan dag, antat [thiu liohte] giwêt
51.4233: sunne te sedle. Thô te seliðun fôr
51.4234: mankunnies manag. Than was thar ên mâri berg
51.4235: bi theru burg ûten, the was brêd endi hôh,
51.4236: grôni endi skôni: hêtun ina Judeo [liudi]
51.4237: Oliueti bi namon. Thar imu up giwêt
51.4238: neriendeo Krist, sô [ina] thiu naht bifeng,
51.4239: was imu thar mid is jungarun, sô ine thar Judeono [ênig]
51.4240: ni wisse ti wârun, hwand he an themu wîhe stôd,
51.4241: liudio drohtin, sô lioht ôstene quam,
51.4242: antfeng that folkskepi endi [im] filu sagde
51.4243: wâroro wordo, sô nis an thesaru weroldi ênig,
51.4245: liudio barno nigên, that thero lêrono mugi
51.4246: [endi] gitellien, [the he] thar [an themu] alahe gisprak,
51.4247: waldand an themu [wîhe,] endi [simlun] mid is wordun [gibôd],
51.4248: that sie [sie gerewidin] te godes rîkie,
51.4249: allaro manno gehwilik, that sie [môstin] an themu mâreon daga
51.4251: Sagde im hwat sie it sundiun frumidun endi simlun gibôd,
51.4252: that sie thea [aleskidin;] hêt sie lioht godes
51.4253: minnion an iro môde, mên farlâten,
51.4255: hlaðen that an iro [hertan;] quað that im than wâri heƀenrîki,
51.4256: garu gôdo [mêst.] Thô warð thar gumono sô filu
51.4257: giwendid aftar is willion, sîður sie that word godes
51.4260: hêrron helpe, ja that heƀenrîki was,
51.4262: manno barnun. Sum sô môdeg was
51.4264: [slîðmôden seƀon ni sorgodun umbi is lera ,]
51.4265: ni weldun is worde [gilôƀien], ak habdun im gewin mikil
51.4266: wið thea Cristes kraft: [kumen ni môstun]
51.4267: thea liudi thurh lêðen strîd, that sie gilôƀon te imu
51.4268: fasto gifengin; ni was im thiu frume giƀiðig,
51.4270: Geng imu thô the godes sunu endi is jungaron mid imu,
51.4271: waldand fan themu wîhe, all sô is willio geng,
51.4272: jak imu uppen thene berg gistêg barn drohtines:
51.4273: sat imu thar mid is gesîðun endi im sagde filu
51.4274: wâroro wordo. Sî bigunnun im thô umbi thene wîh sprekan,
51.4275: thie [gumon] umbi that godes hûs, quâðun that ni wâri gôdlîkora
51.4278: rakud arihtid. Thô the rîkio sprak,
51.4280: "ik mag iu [gitellien",] quað he, "that noh wirðid thiu tîd kumen,
51.4281: that is afstanden ni skal stên oƀar ôðrumu,
51.4282: ak it fallid ti [foldu] endi [fiur] nimid,
51.4283: grâdag logna, thoh it nu sô gôdlîk sî,
51.4284: sô wîslîko giwarht, endi sô dôd [all] thesaro weroldes giskapu,
51.4285: teglîdid grôni [wang."] Thô gengun imu is jungaron tô,
51.4286: frâgodun ina sô stillo: "hwô lango skal standen noh", quâðun sie,
51.4287: "thius werold an wunniun, êr than that giwand kume,
51.4288: that the lasto dag liohtes skîne
51.4289: thurh wolkanskion, eftho hwan is [thîn eft] wân kumen
51.4292: frô mîn the gôdo, ûs is thes firiwit mikil,

52.4296: "that haƀad sô bidernid", quað he, "drohtin the gôdo
52.4298: waldand thesaro weroldes, sô that witen ni mag
52.4299: ênig [mannisk barn,] hwan thiu mârie tîd
52.4300: giwirðid an thesaru weroldi, ne it ôk te wâran ni kunnun
52.4302: simlun] sindun: sie [it] ôk [giseggian] ni mugun
52.4303: te wâran mid iro wordun, [hwan that] giwerðen skuli,
52.4304: that he willie an thesan middilgard, mahtig drohtin,
52.4306: hêlag [fan] himile: elkur is it biholen allun,
52.4307: quikun endi dôdun, hwan is kumi werðad,
52.4308: Ik mag iu thoh gitellien, hwilik [hêr] têkan biforan
52.4309: giwerðad wunderlîk, êr [than] he an these werold kume
52.4310: an themu mâreon daga: that wirðid hêr êr an themu mânon skîn
52.4311: jak an theru sunnon sô same; giswerkad siu bêðiu,
52.4314: biƀod [thius] brêde werold - wirðid sulikaro bôkno filu -:
52.4315: grimmid the grôto sêo, wirkid thie geƀenes strôm
52.4317: Than [thorrot] thiu [thiod] thurh that gethuing mikil,
52.4318: folk thurh thea forhta: than nis friðu hwergin,
52.4319: ak wirðid wîg sô maneg oƀar these werold alla
52.4323: open urlagi - that is egislîk thing,
52.4324: that io sulik morð skulun man afhebbien -,
52.4325: wirðid wôl sô mikil oƀar these werold alle,
52.4326: mansterƀono mêst, [thero] the gio an thesaru middilgard
52.4327: swulti thurh suhti: liggiad seoka man,
52.4328: driosat endi dôiat [endi] iro dag endiad,
52.4329: fulliad mid iro ferahu; ferid unmet grôt
52.4332: thero wîteo an thesaru weroldi, the [hêr] giwerðen [skulun]
52.4333: êr [dômes] dage. Sô hwan sô gi thea dâdi [gisehan]
52.4334: giwerðen an thesaru weroldi, sô mugun gi [than] te wâran farstanden,
52.4335: that than the lazto dag liudiun nâhid
52.4336: mâri te mannun endi maht godes,

52.4340: than sie brustiad endi blôiat endi bladu tôgeat,
52.4342: that than is sân after thiu sumer ginâhid
52.4343: warm endi wunsam endi weder skôni.
52.4344: Sô [witin] gi ôk bi thesun têknun, [the] ik iu talde hêr,
52.4345: hwan the lazto dag liudiun nâhid.

52.4347: tefaran thit folkskepi, êr than [werðe] gefullid sô,
52.4349: himiles endi erðun, endi steid mîn hêlag word
52.4351: gilêstid an thesumu liohte, sô ik for thesun liudiun gespriku.
52.4353: [duomdag] the mâreo endi iuwes drohtines kraft,
52.4354: thiu mikilo [meginstrengi] endi thiu mârie tîd,
52.4355: giwand thesaro weroldes. Fora thiu gi wardon skulun,
52.4359: an thiustrea naht, al sô thiof ferid
52.4360: darno mid is dâdiun, sô kumid the dag mannun,
52.4361: the lazto theses liohtes, sô it êr these liudi ni witun,
52.4362: sô samo sô thiu flôd deda an furndagun,
52.4364: bi Nôeas tîdiun, [biûtan] that ina neride god
52.4366: wið thes flôdes [farm]: sô warð ôk that fiur kuman
52.4367: hêt fan himile, that thea hôhon burgi
52.4369: grim endi grâdag, that thar [nênig gumono] ni ginas

52.4371: drohtines engilos endi is dohter twâ

53.4378: Hwand sô hwan sô that gewirðid, that waldand Krist,
53.4379: mâri mannes sunu mid theru maht godes,
53.4380: kumit mid thiu kraftu kuningo rîkeost
53.4381: sittean an is selƀes maht endi samod mid imu
53.4382: alle thea engilos, the thar uppa sind
53.4383: hêlaga an himile, than skulun tharod heliðo barn,
53.4385: libbeandero liudio, sô [hwat sô] io an thesumu liohte warð
53.4386: firiho afôdid. Thar he themu folke skal,
53.4388: adêlien aftar iro dâdiun. Than skêðid he thea farduanan man,
53.4389: thea farwarhton weros an thea winistron hand:
53.4390: sô duot he ôk thea sâligon an thea swîðeron half;
53.4391: [grôtid] he than thea gôdun endi im tegegnes sprikid:
53.4392: "kumad gi", [quiðid he], "thea thar gikorene sindun, endi antfâhad thit kraftiga rîki,
53.4393: [that] gôde, that [thar] gigerewid stendid, that thar warð gumono barnun
53.4394: giwarht fan thesaro weroldes endie: iu haƀad gewîhid selƀo
53.4395: fader allaro firiho barno: gi môtun [thesaro frumono] neotan,
53.4396: [gewaldon] theses [wîdon] rîkeas, hwand gi oft mînan willeon [frumidun],
53.4397: fulgengun mi gerno endi wârun mi iuwaro geƀo mildie,
53.4398: than ik bithwungan was thurstu endi hungru,
53.4400: biklemmid an karkare: oft wurðun mi [kumana] tharod
53.4401: helpa fan iuwun handun: gi wârun mi an iuwomu hugi mildie,
53.4402: wîsodun mîn werðliko." Than sprikid imu eft that werod angegin:
53.4403: "frô mîn the gôdo", queðat sie, "hwan wâri thu bifangan sô,
53.4404: bethwungan an sulikun tharaƀun, sô thu fora thesaru [thiod] telis,
53.4405: mahtig mênis? Hwan gisah thi man ênig
53.4406: bethwungen an sulikun tharaƀun? Hwat, thu haƀes allaro thiodo giwald
53.4407: jak sô samo thero mêðmo, thero the io manno barn
53.4408: gewunnun an thesaro weroldi." Than sprikid im eft waldand god:
53.4409: "sô hwat sô gi dâdun", quiðit he, "an iuwes drohtines namon,
53.4411: them mannun, the hêr minniston sindun, [thero] nu undar thesaru menegi [standad]
53.4413: [weros, hwand] sie mînan willeon [fremidun] - sô hwat sô gi im iuwaro welono fargâƀun,
53.4414: gidâdun thurh [diuriða], that antfeng iuwa drohtin selƀo,
53.4415: thiu helpe quam te heƀenkuninge. Bethiu [wili] iu the hêlago drohtin
53.4417: Wendid ina than waldand an thea winistron hand,
53.4418: [drohtin] te them farduanun mannun, sagad im that sie skulin thea dâd antgelden,
53.4419: thea man iro [mêngiwerk:] "nu gi fan [mi] skulun", quiðit he.
53.4420: "faran sô forflôkane an that fiur êwig,
53.4421: that thar gigarewid warð godes andsakun,
53.4423: hwand gi mi ni hulpun, than mi hunger endi thurst
53.4424: [wêgde] te wundrun eftha ik gewâdies lôs
53.4425: geng iâmermôd, was mi grôtun tharf,
53.4426: than ni habde ik thar ênige helpe, than ik geheftid was,
53.4427: an liðokospun bilokan, eftha mi legar bifeng,
53.4428: swâra suhti: than ni weldun gi mîn siokes thar
53.4429: wîson mid wihti: ni was iu werð eowiht,
53.4430: that gi mîn gehugdin. Bethiu gi an hellie skulun
53.4431: tholon an thiustre." Than sprikid imu eft thiu thiod angegin:
53.4432: "wola waldand god", queðad sie, "huî [wilt] thu sô [wið] thit werod sprekan,
53.4433: mahlien wið these menegi? Hwan was thi [io] manno tharf,
53.4434: gumono gôdes? Hwat, sie it al be thînun geƀun [êgun],
53.4435: [welon an thesaro] weroldi". Than sprikid eft waldand god:
53.4437: manno thea minniston an iuwomu môdseƀon
53.4438: heliðos farhugdun, lêtun sea iu an iuwomu hugi lêðe,
53.4439: bedêldun sie iuwaro diurða, than dâdun gi [iuwana drohtin] sô sama,
53.4440: [giwernidun imu] iuwaro welono: bethiu ni [wili] iu waldand god,
53.4441: antfâhen fader [iuwa], ak gi an that fiur skulun,
53.4442: an thene diopun dôð, diuƀlun thionon,
53.4443: wrêðun wiðersakun, hwand gi sô [warhtun] biforan."
53.4444: Than aftar them [wordun skêðit] that werod an twê,
53.4445: thea gôdun endi thea uƀilon: farad thea fargriponon man
53.4450: an that langsame lioht: "thar is lîf êwig,

54.4452: Sô gefragn ik that them rinkun tho rîki drohtin
54.4453: umbi thesaro weroldes giwand wordun talde,
54.4454: hwô thiu forð ferid, than [lango] the sie firiho barn
54.4455: ardon môtun, ja hwô siu an themu endie skal
54.4456: teglîden endi tegangen. He sagde ôk is jungarun thar
54.4457: wârun wordun: "hwat, gi witun alle", quað he,
54.4458: "that nu oƀar twâ naht sind tîdi kumana,
54.4459: Judeono pascha, that sie skulun iro gode thionon,
54.4460: weros an themu wîhe. Thes nis gewand ênig,
54.4461: [that] thar wirðid mannes sunu te theru meginthiodu
54.4463: tholod thiadquâla." Thô warð thar thegan manag
54.4465: Judeono gumskepi, thar sie skoldun iro gode thionon.
54.4467: an [warf] weros, the sie thô wîsostun
54.4470: biskop thero liudio. Sie rêdun thô an that barn godes,
54.4471: hwô sie ina asluogin sundea lôsan,
54.4472: [quâðun] that sie ina an themu hêlagon daga hrînen ni skoldin
54.4473: undar thero manno menegi, "that ni werðe thius meginthioda,
54.4474: heliðos an hrôru, hwand ina thit heriskepi wili
54.4475: farstanden mid strîdu. Wi sô stillo skulun
54.4476: frêson is ferahes, that [thit] folk Judeono
54.4477: an thesun wîhdagun wrôht ni afhebbien."
54.4478: Thô geng imu thar Jûdas forð, jungaro Kristes,
54.4479: ên thero tweliƀio, [thar] that aðali sat,
54.4480: Judeono gumskepi; quað that he is im gôdan râd
54.4481: seggian mahti: "hwat williad gi mi sellien hêr", quað he,
54.4482: "mêðmo te mêdu, ef ik iu thene man giƀu
54.4483: âno wîg endi âno wrôht?" Thô warð thes werodes hugi,
54.4484: thero liudio an lustun: "ef thu [wili] gilêstien sô", quâðun sie,
54.4485: "thîn word giwâron, than thu giwald haƀes,
54.4486: hwat thu at thesaru thiodu thiggean willies
54.4487: gôdaro mêðmo." Thô gihêt imu that gumskepi thar
