58.4842: manno hwilikumu." Thô sprak imu eft thiu [menegi] angegin,
58.4843: quâðun that im hêleand thar an themu holme uppan
58.4846: selƀon hêtid. Ina quâmun wi sôkean herod,
58.4847: [weldin] ina gerno bigeten: he is fan Galileo lande,
58.4848: fan Nazarethburg." Sô im thô the neriendio Crist
58.4849: sagde te sôðan, that he it selƀo was,
58.4850: sô wurðun thô an forhtun folk Judeono,
58.4851: wurðun underbadode, that sie under bak fellun
58.4853: wiðer[wardes] that werod: ni [mahte] that word godes,
58.4854: thie stemnie antstandan: wârun thoh sô strîdige man,
58.4855: ahliopun eft up an themu holme, hugi fastnodun,
58.4857: nâhor mid nîðu, anttat sie thene neriendion Crist
58.4860: [biforan] theru dereƀeon dâdi endi te iro drohtine [sprâkun:]
58.4861: "wâri it [nu] thîn willio", quâðun sie, "waldand frô mîn,
58.4862: [that sie ûs hêr an speres ordun spildien môstin]
58.4863: wâpnun wunde, than ni wâri ûs wiht sô gôd,
58.4864: sô that wi hêr for ûsumu drohtine dôan môstin
58.4867: [well] imu innan hugi, that he ni mahte ênig word sprekan:
58.4868: sô harm warð imu an is hertan, that man is hêrron thar
58.4870: swîðo thrîstmôd thegan for is thiodan [standen,]
58.4871: hard for is hêrron: ni was imu is hugi twîfli,
58.4872: [blôð] an is breostun, ak he is bil atôh,
58.4875: that thô Malchus warð mâkeas eggiun,
58.4876: an thea swîðaron half swerdu gimâlod:
58.4877: thiu hlust warð imu farhawan, he warð an that hôƀid wund,
58.4878: that imu herudrôrag hlear endi ôre
58.4880: well fan wundun. Thô was an is wangun skard
58.4881: the furisto thero fîundo. Thô stôd that folk an rûm:
58.4882: andrêdun im thes billes biti. Thô sprak that barn godes
58.4883: selƀo te Sîmon Petruse, hêt that he is swerd dedi
58.4884: skarp an skêðia: "ef ik wið thesa skola weldi", quað he,
58.4886: than manodi ik thene mâreon mahtigne god,
58.4888: that he mi sô managan engil herod oƀana sandi
58.4889: wîges sô wîsen, sô ni [mahtin] iro [wâpanthreki]
58.4890: man adôgen: iro ni stôdi gio sulik megin samad,
58.4891: folkes [gifastnod,] that im iro ferh aftar thiu
58.4892: werðen [mahti]. Ak it haƀad waldand god,
58.4894: that wi [githoloian] skulun, sô hwat sô ûs [thius thioda] tô
58.4895: bittres brengit: ni skulun ûs belgan wiht,
58.4896: wrêðean wið iro gewinne; hwand sô hwe sô wâpno nîð,
58.4899: [dôit] im [bidrôregan]: wi mid ûsun dâdiun ni skulun
58.4900: wiht awerdian." Geng [he] thô te themu wundon [manne],
58.4902: hôƀidwundon, that siu sân gihêlid warð,
58.4903: thes billes biti, endi sprak that barn godes
58.4904: wið that wrêðe werod: "mi thunkid wunder mikil", quað he,
58.4905: "ef gi mi lêðes wiht lêstien weldun,
58.4906: huî gi mi [thô] ni [fengun,] than ik undar iuwomu folke stôd,
58.4907: an themu wîhe innan endi thar word manag
58.4909: diurlîk [dages lioht,] than ni weldun gi mi dôan eowiht
58.4910: lêðes an thesumu liohte, endi nu lêdiad mi [iuwa] liudi tô
58.4911: an thiustrie naht, al sô man thioƀe dôt,
58.4912: than man thene fâhan wili endi he is ferhes haƀad
58.4914: gripun thô an thene godes sunu, grimma thioda,
58.4916: môdag manno folk - mênes ni sâhun -,
58.4918: faðmos mid fitereun. Im ni was [sulikaro] firinquâla
58.4920: te winnanne sulik wîti, ak he it thurh thit werod deda,
58.4921: hwand he liudio barn lôsien welda,
58.4923: an thene wîdon welon: bethiu he thes wiht ne bisprak,
58.4924: thes sie imu thurh inwidnîð ôgean weldun.

59.4925: Thô wurðun thes sô [malske] môdag folk Judeono,
59.4926: thiu hêri warð thes sô hrômeg, thes sie thena [hêlagon] Krist
59.4928: [fôrian] an fitereun. Thie fîund eft gewitun
59.4929: fan themu berge te burg. Geng that barn godes
59.4931: drûƀondi te dale. Wârun imu thea is diurion thô
59.4932: [gesîðos] geswikane, al sô he im êr selƀo gisprak:
59.4933: ni was it thoh be ênigaru blôði, that sie that barn godes,
59.4934: [lioƀen] farlêtun, ak it was sô lango biforen
59.4935: wârsagono word, that it [skoldi] giwerðen sô:
59.4936: bethiu ni mahtun sie is bemîðan. Than aftar theru menegi gengun
59.4937: Johannes endi Petrus, thie gumon twêne,
59.4939: hwat thea grimmon Judeon themu godes barne,
59.4940: [weldin] iro drohtine dôen. Thô sie te dale quâmun
59.4941: fan themu berge te burg, thar iro biskop was,
59.4942: iro wîhes ward, thar lêddun ina wlanke man,
59.4943: erlos undar ederos. Thar was êld mikil,
59.4944: fiur an frîdhoƀe themu folke tegegnes,
59.4945: gewarht for themu werode: thar gengun sie im wermien tô,
59.4947: bîdon an bendiun. Was thar braht mikil,
59.4949: themu hêroston kûð: bethiu môste he an thene hof innan
59.4950: thringan mid theru [thioda.] Stôd allaro thegno bezto,
59.4951: Petrus thar ûte: ni lêt ina [the] portun ward
59.4952: folgon is frôen, êr it at is friunde abad,
59.4953: Johannes at ênumu Judeon, that man ina gangan lêt
59.4954: forð an thene frîdhof. Thar quam im ên fêkni wîf
59.4955: gangan tegegnes, thiu ênas Judeon was,
59.4956: iro theodanes thiw, endi thô te themu thegne sprak
59.4957: magað [unwânlîk]: "Hwat, thu mahtis man wesan", quað siu,
59.4958: "giungaro fan Galilea, thes the thar genower stêd
59.4959: faðmun gifastnod." Thô an forhtun warð
59.4960: Sîmon Petrus sân, [slak] an is môde,
59.4961: quað that he thes wîƀes word ni bikonsti
59.4962: ni thes theodanes thegan ni wâri:
59.4963: mêð is thô for theru menegi, quað that he thena man ni antkendi:
59.4964: "ni sind mi thîne [quidi] kûðe", quað he; was imu thiu kraft godes,
59.4965: [the herdislo] fan themu hertan. Hwaraƀondi geng
59.4966: forð undar themu folke, antat he te themu fiure quam;
59.4967: [giwêt] ina thô warmien. Thar im ôk ên wîf bigan
59.4968: felgian firinsprâka: "hêr mugun gi", quað siu, "an iuwan fîund sehan:
59.4970: is selƀes gesîð." Thô gengun imu sân aftar thiu
59.4972: frâgodun fîundo barn, hwilikes he folkes wâri:
59.4973: "ni bist thu thesoro burgliudio", [quâðun sie]; "that mugun wi [an thînumu gibârie gisehan],
59.4974: an thînun wordun endi an thînaru wîson, that thu theses werodes ni bist,
59.4975: ak thu bist galilêisk man." He ni welda thes thô gehan eowiht,
59.4976: ak stôd thô endi strîdda endi starkan êð
59.4977: swîðlîko gesuôr, that he thes gesîðes ni wâri.
59.4978: Ni habda is wordo gewald: it skolde giwerðen sô,
59.4979: sô it the gemarkode, the mankunnies
59.4980: farwardot an thesaru weroldi. Thô quam imu ôk an themu [warƀe] tô
59.4981: thes mannes mâgwini, the he êr mid is [mâkeo] giheu,
59.4982: swerdu thiu skarpon, quað that he ina sâhi thar
59.4983: an themu berge uppan, "thar wi an themu bômgardon
59.4985: fastnodun is folmos." He thô thurh forhtan hugi
59.4986: forlôgnide thes is [lioƀes] hêrron, quað that he weldi wesan thes lîƀes skolo,
59.4987: ef it mahti ênig thar irminmanno
59.4988: giseggian te sôðan, that he thes gesîðes wâri,
59.4989: folgodi theru ferdi. Thô warð an thena formon sîð
59.4990: hanokrâd [afhaƀen]. Thô sah the hêlago Crist,
59.4991: [barno that bezte, thar he gebunden stôð],
59.4992: selƀo te Sîmon Petruse, sunu drohtines
59.4993: te themu erle oƀar is ahsla. Thô warð imu an innan sân,
59.4994: Sîmon Petruse sêr an is môde,
59.4995: harm an is hertan endi is hugi drôƀi,
59.4996: swîðo warð imu an sorgun, that he êr selƀo gesprak:
59.4997: gihugde thero wordo thô, the imu [êr] waldand Krist
59.4998: selƀo sagda, that he an theru swartan naht
59.5000: thrîwo farlôgnien. Thes thram imu [an] innan môd
59.5001: bittro an is breostun, endi geng imu thô gibolgan thanen
59.5002: the man fan theru menigi an môdkaru,
59.5003: swîðo an sorgun, endi is selƀes word,
59.5006: blôdage fan is breostun. He ni wânde that he is mahti gibôtien wiht,
59.5007: firin[werko] furður eftha te is frâhon kuman,
59.5008: hêrron huldi: nis ênig heliðo [sô] ald,
59.5011: karon eftha kûmien: "wola krafteg god", quað he,
59.5012: "that ik hebbiu mi sô forwerkot, sô ik mînaro weroldes ni tharf
59.5013: ôlat seggean. Ef ik nu te aldre skal
59.5015: theoden, tholoian, than ni tharf mi thes ênig thank wesan,
59.5016: lioƀo drohtin, [that] ik io te thesumu liohte [quam].
59.5017: Ni bium ik nu thes wirðig, waldand frô mîn,
59.5018: that ik under thîne jungaron gangan môti,
59.5019: thus sundig under thîne gesîðos: ik iro selƀo skal
59.5020: mîðan an mînumu môde, nu ik mi sulik mên gesprak. "
59.5022: hrau [im] sô hardo, that [he] habde is hêrren thô
59.5023: leoƀes farlôgnid. Than ni thurƀun thes liudio barn,
59.5024: weros wundroian, behuî it weldi god,
59.5025: that sô lioƀen man lêð gistôdi,
59.5026: that he sô hônlîko hêrron sînes
59.5028: farlôgnide sô lioƀes: it was al bi thesun liudiun giduan,
59.5029: firiho barnun te [frumu.] He welde ina te furiston dôan,
59.5030: hêrost oƀar is hîwiski, hêlag drohtin:
59.5031: lêt ina gekunnon, hwilike kraft haƀet
59.5032: the menniska môd âno [the] maht godes;
59.5033: lêt ina gesundion, that he sîðor thiu bet
59.5036: that man ina alâte lêðes thinges,
59.5037: sakono endi sundeono, sô im thô selƀo dede

60.5040: [hagustaldes] hrôm: ef imu thiu helpe godes
60.5041: gesuîkid thurh is [sundeon,] than is imu sân aftar thiu
60.5042: breosthugi blôðora, thoh he êr bihêt spreka,
60.5043: hrômie fan is [hildi] endi fan is handkrafti,
60.5044: the man fan is megine. That warð thar an themu mâreon skîn,
60.5045: thegno bezton, thô imu is thiodanes gisuêk
60.5046: hêlag helpe. Bethiu ni skoldi hrômien man
60.5047: te swîðo fan imu selƀon, hwand imu thar suîkid oft
60.5048: wân endi willeo, ef imu waldand god,
60.5050: Than bêd allaro barno bezt, bendi tholode
60.5051: thurh mankunni. Hwurƀun ina managa umbi
60.5053: [habdun] ina te hoska, thar he [giheftid] stôd,
60.5054: tholode [mid] gethuldiun, sô hwat sô imu thiu [thiod] deda,
60.5055: liudi lêðes. Thô warð eft lioht kuman,
60.5057: heri Judeono: habdun im hugi wulƀo,
60.5058: inwid an innan. Warð thar êosago
60.5061: wrêðes willean. Gengun im an [warf] samad
60.5062: rinkos an rûna, bigunnun im râdan thô,
60.5065: te giseggianne sundea thurh is selƀes word,
60.5066: that sie ina than te wunderquâlu wêgean môstin,
60.5067: adêlien te dôðe. Sie ni mahtun an themu dage finden
60.5068: sô wrêð gewitskepi, that sie imu wîti bethiu
60.5070: lîƀu bilôsien. Thô quâmun thar [at laztan] forð
60.5072: twêne gangan endi bigunnun im tellien an,
60.5073: quâðun that sie ina selƀon seggian gihôrdin,
60.5074: that he [mahti] tewerpen thena wîh godes,
60.5075: allaro hûso hôhost endi thurh is handmegin,
60.5076: thurh is ênes kraft up arihtien
60.5077: an thriddion daga, sô is [elkor] ni thorfti bethîhan man.
60.5078: He thagoda endi tholoda: ni sprak imu io thiu [thiod] sô filu,
60.5079: thea liudi mid luginun, that he it mid lêðun angegin
60.5080: wordun [wrâki]. Thô thar undar themu werode arês
60.5082: the furisto thes folkes endi frâgode Krist
60.5083: jak ina be imu selƀon bisuôr swîðon êðun,
60.5084: grôtte ina an godes namon endi gerno bad,
60.5085: that he im that gisagdi, ef he sunu wâri
60.5087: Krist kuning êwig. Wi ni mugun is [antkiennien] wiht
60.5088: ne an thînun wordun ni an thînun werkun." Thô sprak imu eft the wâro angegin,
60.5089: the gôdo godes sunu: "thu quiðis it for thesun Judeon nu,
60.5090: sôðlîko segis, that ik it selƀo bium.
60.5091: Thes ni gilôƀiad mi these liudi: ni williad mi forlâtan bethiu;
60.5092: ni sind im [mîn] word wirðig. Nu seggiu ik iu te wârun thoh,
60.5093: that gi noh skulun sittien gisehan an [the] swîðaron half godes
60.5095: thes alowalden fader, endi thanan eft kuman
60.5096: an himilwolknun herod endi allumu heliðo kunnie
60.5097: mid is wordun adêlien, al sô iro gewurhti sind."
60.5098: Tho balg ina [the] biskop, habde bittren hugi,
60.5099: wrêðida [wið] themu [worde] endi is giwâdi slêt,
60.5100: brak for is breostun: "nu ni thurƀun gi bîdan leng", quað he,
60.5101: "thit werod gewitskepies, nu im [sulik] word farad,
60.5102: mênsprâka fan is mûðe. That gihôrid [hêr nu] manno filu,
60.5103: rinko an thesumu rakude, that he ina sô rîkean telit,
60.5104: gihid that he god sî. Hwat williad gi Judeon thes
60.5105: adêlien te dôme? Is he dôðes [nu]

61.5107: folk Judeono, that he wâri [thes] ferhes skolo,
61.5108: wîties sô wirðig. Ni was it thoh be is gewurhtiun gidôen,
61.5109: that ine thar an Hierusalem Judeo liudi,
61.5111: adêldun te dôðe. Thô was thero dâdio hrôm
61.5112: Judeo liudiun, hwat sie [themu] godes [barne mahtin]
61.5114: Bewurpun ina thô mid [werodu] endi ina an is wangon slôgun,
61.5115: an is hleor mid iro handun - al was imu that te hoske gidôen -,
61.5118: fast under fîundun: wârun imu [is] faðmos gebundene,
61.5119: tholode [mid] githuldiun, sô hwat sô imu thiu [thioda] tô
61.5120: bittres brâhte: ni balg ina neowiht
61.5121: wið thes werodes gewin. Thô nâmon ina wrêðe man
61.5123: endi ina thô lêddun, thar [thero] liudio was,
61.5125: hwurƀun umbi iro heritogon. Thar was iro hêrron bodo
61.5126: fan Rûmuburg, thes the thô thes rîkeas giweld:
61.5127: kumen was he fan themu kêsure, gisendid was he undar that kunni Judeono
61.5128: te [rihtienne] that rîki, was thar râdgeƀo:
61.5129: Pilatus was he hêten; he was fan Ponteo lande
61.5130: knôsles kennit. Habde imu kraft mikil,
61.5133: agâƀun thô thena godes sunu, Judeo liudi,
61.5134: under fîundo folk, quâðun that he wâri thes ferhes skolo,
61.5135: that man ina wîtnodi wâpnes eggiun,
61.5136: skarpun skûrun. [Ni] welde thiu skole Judeono
61.5137: thringan an that thinghûs, ak thiu thiod ûte stôd,
61.5138: mahlidun thanen wið thea menegi: ni weldun an that gimang faren,
61.5139: [an] elilandige man, that sie thar unreht word,
61.5140: an [themu dage derƀies wiht adêlian ne gihôrdin,]
61.5141: ak quâðun that sie [im] sô [hluttro hêlaga tîdi],
61.5144: sundea lôsen. Thô an sorgun warð
61.5145: Judases hugi, thô he ageƀan gisah
61.5146: is drohtin te dôðe, thô bigan imu thiu dâd aftar thiu
61.5147: an is hugea hrewan, that he habde is hêrron êr
61.5148: [sundea lôsen] gisald. Nam imu thô [that] siluƀar an hand,
61.5149: thrîtig skatto, that man imu êr wið is thiodane gaf,
61.5150: geng imu thô te them Judiun endi im is grimmon dâd,
61.5151: sundeon sagde, endi im that siluƀar bôd
61.5152: gerno te [ageƀanne:] "ik hebbiu it sô [griolîko",] quað he,
61.5154: sô ik wêt that it mi ni thîhit." Thiod Judeono
61.5155: ni weldun it thô antfâhan, ak hêtun ina forð aftar thiu
61.5157: hwat he wið is frâhon gefrumid habdi:
61.5158: "thu sâhi thi [selƀo thes",] quaðun sie; "hwat [wili] thu thes [nu] sôken te ûs?
61.5159: Ne wît thu that thesumu werode!" Thô giwêt imu eft thanan
61.5160: Judas gangan te themu godes wîhe
61.5161: swîðo an sorgun endi that siluƀar warp
61.5162: an thena alah innan, ne gidorste it êgan leng;
61.5163: fôr imu thô sô an forhtun, sô ina fîundo barn
61.5165: gramon under[gripanen], was imu god abolgan,
61.5166: that he imu selƀon thô sîmon warhte,
61.5167: hnêg thô an herusêl an hinginna,
61.5168: warag an wurgil endi wîti gekôs,
61.5170: diap dôðes dalu, hwand he êr umbi is drohtin suêk.

62.5171: Than bêd that barn godes - bendi tholode
62.5172: an themu thinghûse -, hwan êr thiu [thiod] under im,
62.5174: hwat sie imu [than] te ferahquâlu [frummian weldin.]
62.5175: [Thô thar] an them benkiun arês bodo kêsures
62.5176: fan Rûmuburg endi geng imu wið that rîki Judeono
62.5177: môdag mahlien, thar thiu menigi stôd
62.5178: aftar themu hoƀe [hwarƀon:] ni weldun an that hûs kuman
62.5180: frôkno frâgon oƀar that folk Judeono,
62.5181: mid huiu the man habdi morðes giskuldit,
62.5182: wîties giwerkot: "be huî gi imu sô wrêðe sind,
62.5183: an iuwomu hugea hôtie?" Sie quâðun that he im habdi harmes sô filu,
62.5184: lêðes gilêstid: "ni gâƀin ina thesa liudi thi,
62.5185: thar sie ina êr biforan uƀilan ni wissin,
62.5186: wordun farwarhten. He haƀat theses werodes sô filu
62.5187: farlêdid mid is lêrun - endi thesa liudi merrid,
62.5188: dôit im iro hugi twîflien -, that wi ni môtun te themu hoƀe kêsures
62.5189: tinsi gelden; that mugun wi ina gitellien an
62.5190: mid wâru gewitskepi. He sprikid ôk word mikil,
62.5191: quiðit that he Crist sî, kuning oƀar thit rîki,
62.5192: begihit ina sô grôtes." Thô im [eft] tegegnes sprak
62.5193: bodo kêsures: "ef he sô barlîko", quað he,
62.5195: antfâhad ina than eft under iuwe folkskepi, ef he sî is ferhes skolo,
62.5196: endi imu sô adêliad, ef he sî dôðes werð,
62.5197: sô it an iuwaro aldrono êo gebiode."
62.5198: Sie quâðun thô, that sie ni môstin manno [nigênumu]
62.5201: Thô wende ina fan themu werode wrêðhugdig man,
62.5202: thegan kêsures, [the] oƀar thea thioda was
62.5203: bodo fan [Rûmuburg] -: hêt imu thô that barn godes
62.5205: frâgoda frôkno, ef he oƀar that folk kuning
62.5206: thes werodes wâri. Thô habde eft is word garu
62.5207: sunu drohtines: "hweðer thu that fan thi selƀumu sprikis", quað he,
62.5208: "the it thi ôðre hêr erlos sagdun,
62.5209: quâðun umbi mînan kuningduom?" Thô sprak eft [the] kêsures bodo
62.5210: wlank endi wrêðmôd, thar he wið waldand Krist
62.5211: reðiode an them rakude: "ni bium ik theses rîkies hinan", quað he,
62.5213: thesaro manno mâgwini, ak mi thi thius menigi bifalah,
62.5214: agâƀun thi thîna gadulingos [mi], Judeo liudi,
62.5215: [haftan] te handun. Hwat haƀas thu harmes giduan,
62.5217: qualm] undar thînumu kunnie?" Thô sprak [imu eft Krist] angegin,
62.5218: hêlendero bezt, thar he giheftid stôd
62.5219: an themu rakude innan: "nis mîn rîki hinan", quað he,
62.5220: "fan thesaru weroldstundu. Ef it [thoh] wâri sô,
62.5221: than wârin sô starkmôde wiðer strîdhugi,
62.5223: sô man mi ni gâƀi Judeo liudiun,
62.5225: te wêgeanne te wundrun. Te thiu warð ik an thesaru weroldi giboran,
62.5227: mid mînun kumiun kûðdi. That mugun antkennien wel
62.5228: the weros, the sind fan wâre kumane: the mugun mîn word farstanden,
62.5229: [gilôƀien] mînun lêrun." Thô ni mahte lasteres wiht
62.5230: an them barne godes bodo kêsures,
62.5231: findan [fêknea] word, that he is ferhes bethiu
62.5232: skuldig wâri. Thô geng he im eft wið thea skola Judeono
62.5233: môdag mahlien endi theru menigi sagde
62.5234: oƀar hlust mikil, that he an themu hafton manne
62.5236: [for them folkskipie], sô he wâri is ferhes skolo,
62.5238: Judeo liudi endi thane godes sunu
62.5239: wordun wrôgdun: quâðun that he giwer êrist
62.5240: begunni an [Galileo lande,] "endi oƀar Judeon fôr
62.5242: manno môdseƀon, sô he is morðes werð,
62.5244: ef eo [man] mid sulikun dâdiun mag dôðes geskuldien."

63.5245: Sô wrôgdun ina mid wordun werod Judeono
63.5246: thurh hôtean hugi. Thô the heritogo,
63.5249: manno the bezto: he was fan theru mârean [thiadu],
63.5252: [kraftagne] kuningdôm, sô ina imu the kêsur [fargaf],
63.5253: the rîkeo fan Rûmu, that he thar rehto gehwilik
63.5254: gefrumidi undar themu folke endi friðu lêsti,
63.5255: dômos adêldi. He was ôk an themu dage selƀo
63.5257: mid is werode [at] themu wîhe: sô was iro wîse than,
63.5258: that sie thar [thia hêlagun tîd haldan] skoldun,
63.5260: that thena hafton man heliðos nâmin
63.5262: [hêt] that sie ina Erodese, erlos brâhtin
63.5263: haften te handun, hwand he fan is heriskepi was,
63.5264: fan is werodes gewald. Wîgand frumidun
63.5266: fôrdun an fiteriun for thena folktogun,
63.5267: allaro barno bezt, thero the io [giboren] wurði
63.5268: an liudio lioht; an liðubendiun geng,
63.5269: antat sie ina brâhtun, thar he an is benkia sat,
63.5270: kuning Erodes: umbihwarf ina kraft wero,
63.5273: wândun that he im sum têkan thar tôgean skoldi,
63.5274: mâri endi mahtig, sô he managun dede
63.5276: Frâgoda ina thuo thie folkkuning firiwitlîko
63.5278: forð undarfindan, hwat hie te frumu mohti
63.5279: mannon gimarkon. Than stuod mahtig Crist,
63.5280: thagoda endi tholoda: ne wolda them thiedkuninge,
63.5281: Erodese ne is erlon antsuôr geƀan
63.5282: wordo nigênon. Than stuod thiu wrêða thiod,
63.5283: Judeo liudi endi thena godes suno
63.5284: wurrun endi wruogdun, anthat im warð thie weroldkuning
63.5285: an is huge huoti endi all is heriskipi,
63.5286: farmuonstun ina an iro muode: ne antkendun maht godes,
63.5287: himiliskan hêrron, ak was im iro hugi thiustri,
63.5291: sô hwat sô sia im tionono [thuo] tuogian woldun.
63.5292: Sia hietun im thuo te hoske huît giwâdi
63.5293: umbi is liði leggian, thiu mêr hie wurði them liudion thar,
63.5295: thuo sia ina te [hoske] hebbian gisâhun,
63.5296: erlos oƀarmuoda. Thuo senda ina eft thanan
63.5297: Erodes se kuning an that ôðer folk;
63.5298: [alêdian] hiet ina lungra mann, endi lastar sprâkun,
63.5299: [felgidun] im firinword, thar hie an feteron geng
63.5300: bihlagan mid hosku: ni was im hugi twîfli,
63.5301: neƀa hie it thuru ôdmuodi all githoloda;
63.5303: hosk endi harmquidi. Thuo brâhtun sia ina eft an that hûs innan,
63.5304: an [thia] palencea uppan, thar Pilatus was
63.5310: Judeon far them gastselie: habdun sia [gramono] barn,
63.5311: thia skola farskundid, that sia ne beskriƀun iowiht
63.5312: grimmera dâdio. Thuo giwêt im gangan tharod
63.5313: thegan kêsures wið thia thiod sprekan,
63.5314: hard heritogo: "hwat, gi mi thesan haftan mann", quathie,
63.5315: "an thesan seli sendun endi selƀon anbudun,
63.5316: that hie iuwes werodes sô filo awerdit habdi,
63.5317: [farlêdid] mid is lêron. Nu ik mid theson liudon ni mag,
63.5318: findan mid thius folku, that hie is ferahes sî
63.5319: furi thesaro skolu skuldig. Skîn was that hiudu:
63.5320: Erodes mohta, thie iuwan êo bikan,
63.5321: iuwaro liudo landreht, hie ni mahta is lîƀes gifrêson,
63.5322: that hie hier thuru êniga sundia te dage sweltan skoldi,
63.5323: lîf farlâtan. Nu williu ik ina for theson liudion hier
63.5325: buotian im is briosthugi, lâtan ina brûkan forð
63.5327: hreopun thuo alla samad hlûdero stemnu,
63.5329: Crist mid qualmu endi an krûci slahan,
63.5330: wêgian te wundron: "hie mid is wordon haƀit
63.5331: dôðes giskuldid: sagit that hie drohtin sî,
63.5332: gegnungo godes suno. That hie ageldan skal,
63.5333: inwidsprâka, sô is an ûson êwe giskriƀan,
63.5334: that man sulika firinquidi ferahu kôpo."

64.5335: Thuo warð thie an forahton, thie thes folkes giweld,
64.5336: mikilon an is muode, thuo hie gihôrda thia man sprekan,
64.5337: that sia ina selƀon seggian gihôrdin,
64.5338: gehan fur them gumskipe, that hie wâri godes suno.
64.5339: Thuo [hwarf] im eft thie heritogo an that hûs innan
64.5341: gruotta thena godes suno endi frâgoda, hwat hie gumono wâri:
64.5342: "hwat bist thu manno?" quathie. "Te huî thu mi sô thînan muod hilis,
64.5343: dernis diopgithâht? Wêst thu that it all an mînon duome stêd
64.5344: umbi thînes lîƀes gilagu? Mi [thi] hebbiat thesa liudi fargeƀan,
64.5345: werod Judeono, thak ik giwaldan muot
64.5346: sô thik te spildianne an speres orde,
64.5347: sô ti quellianne an krûcium, sô quikan lâtan,
64.5348: sô hweðer sô mi selƀon swôtera thunkit
64.5349: te gifrummianne mid mînu folku." Thuo sprak eft that friðubarn godes:
64.5350: "Wêst thu that te wâron", quathie, "that thu giwald oƀar mik
64.5351: hebbian ni mohtis, ne wâri that it thi hêlag god
64.5352: selƀo fargâƀi? Ôk hebbeat thia sundeono mêr,
64.5353: thia mik thi bifulhun thuru fîondskipi,
64.5354: gisaldun an sîmon haftan." Thuo welda ina [sîð] after thiu
64.5356: thegan kêsures, thar hie is haƀdi for thero thioda giwald;
64.5357: ak sia weridun im thena willion wordu gihwiliku,
64.5358: kunni Judeono: "ne bist thu", quâðun sia, "thes kêsures friund,
64.5359: thînon hêrren hold, ef thu ina hinan lâtis
64.5360: sîðon gisundon: that thi noh te soragan mag,
64.5361: werðan te wîte, hwand sô hwe sô sulik word sprikit,
64.5362: ahaƀið ina sô hôho, quiðit that hie hebbian mugi
64.5363: kuningduomes namon, ne sî that ina im thie kêsur geƀe,
64.5364: hie wirrid im is weruldrîki endi is word farhugid,
64.5365: farman ina an is muode. Bethiu skalt thu sulik mên wrekan,
64.5366: [hoskword manag, ef thu umbi thînes hêrren ruokis],
64.5367: umbi thînes frôhon friundskipi, than skalt thu ina thiu ferhu beniman."
64.5368: Thuo gihôrda thie heritogo thia [hêri] Juðeono
64.5369: [thrêgian] fan is thiodne; thuo hie [far] thero thingstedi geng
64.5371: [sô mikil warf] werodes, hiet waldand Crist
64.5372: lêdian for thia liudi. Langoda Judeon,
64.5373: hwan êr sia that hêlaga barn hangon gisâwin,
64.5374: quelan an krûcie; sia quâðun that sia kuning ôðran
64.5375: ne haƀdin undar iro heriskipie, neƀan thena hêran kêsar
64.5376: fan Rûmuburg: "thie haƀit hier rîki oƀer ûs.
64.5377: Bethiu ni skalt thu thesan farlâtan; hie haƀit ûs sô filo lêðes gisprokan,
64.5378: farduan haƀit hie im mid is dâdion. Hie skal dôð tholon,
64.5380: sô manag mislîk thing an mahtigna Crist
64.5381: sagdun te sundiun. Hie suîgondi stuod
64.5383: wið iro wrêðun word: wolda thesa werold alla
64.5384: lôsian mid is lîƀu: bithiu liet hie ina thia lêðun thiod
64.5385: wêgian te wundron, all sô iro willio geng:
64.5386: ni wolda im opanlîko allon kûðian
64.5387: Judeo liudeon, that hie was god selƀo;
64.5388: hwand wissin sia that te wâron, that hie sulika giwald haƀdi
64.5389: oƀar theson middilgard, than wurði im iro muodseƀo
64.5390: giblôðit an iro brioston: [than] ne gidorstin sia that barn godes
64.5393: Bethiu mêð hie is sô an is muode, ne lêt that manno folk
64.5394: witan, hwat sia warahtun. Thiu wurd nâhida thuo,
64.5395: mâri maht godes endi middi dag,
64.5396: that sia thia ferahquâla frummian skoldun.
64.5397: Than lag thar ôk an bendion an thero burg innan
64.5398: ên ruof reginskaðo, thie habda under them rîke sô filo
64.5400: was mâri meginthiof: ni was thar is gimako hwergin;
64.5402: Barrabas was hie hêtan; hie after them burgion was
64.5405: that sia jâro [gihwen] an godes minnia
64.5406: an them hêlagon dage ênna haftan mann
64.5407: abiddian skoldun, that im iro burges ward,
64.5409: Thuo bigan thie heritogo thia hêri Judeono,
64.5410: that folk frâgoian, thar sia im fora stuodun,
64.5411: hweðeron sia thero tweio tuomian weldin,
64.5412: ferahes biddian: "thia hier an feteron sind
64.5413: haft undar theson heriskipie?" Thiu hêri Judeono
64.5414: habdun thuo thia aramun man alla gispanana,
64.5415: that sia themo landskaðen lîf abâdin,
64.5416: githingodin them thioƀe, thie oft an thiustria naht
64.5418: quelidin an krûcie. Thuo warð that kûð oƀar all,
64.5419: [hwô thiu thiod haƀda duomos adêlid. Thuo skoldun sia thia dâd frummian,]
64.5420: [hâhan] that hêlaga barn. That warð them heritogen
64.5421: sîðor te sorgon, that hie thia saka wissa,
64.5422: that sia thuru nîðskipi neriendon Crist,
64.5423: hatoda thiu hêri, endi hie im hôrda te thiu,
64.5424: warahta iro willion: thes hie wîti antfeng,
64.5425: lôn an theson liohte endi lang after,
64.5426: [wôi sîðor] wann, sîðor hie thesa werold agaf.

65.5427: Thuo warð thas thie wrêðo giwaro, wamskaðono mêst,
65.5428: Satanas selƀo, thuo thiu seola quam
65.5430: thuo wissa hie te wâren, that that was waldand Crist,
65.5431: barn drohtines, that thar gibundan stuod;
65.5432: wissa thuo te wâron, that hie [welda] thesa werold alla
65.5435: That was Satanase sêr an muode,
65.5436: tulgo harm an is hugie: welda is helpan thuo,
65.5437: that im liudio barn lîf ne binâmin,
65.5438: ne quelidin an krûcie, ak hie welda, that hie quic liƀdi,
65.5439: te thiu that [firiho] barn fernes ne wurðin,
65.5442: an thero burg innan. Hie thero is brûdi bigann,
65.5444: wunder tôgian, that sia an wordhelpon
65.5445: Criste wâri, that hie muosti [quik] libbian,
65.5446: drohtin manno - hie was iu than te dôðe giskerid -
65.5447: wissa that te wâron, that hie im skoldi thia giwald biniman,
65.5448: that hie sia oƀar thesan middilgard sô mikila ni haƀdi,
65.5449: oƀar wîda werold. That wîf warð thuo an forahton,
65.5450: swîðo an sorogon, thuo iru thiu gisiuni quâmun
65.5451: thuru thes dernien [dâd] an dages liohte,
65.5452: an heliðhelme bihelid. Thuo siu te iru hêrren anbôd,
65.5453: that wîf mid iro wordon endi im te wâren hiet
65.5454: selƀon seggian, hwat iro thar te gisiunion quam
65.5455: thuru thena hêlagan mann, endi im helpan bad,
65.5456: formon is ferhe: "ik hebbiu hier sô filo thuru ina
65.5457: seldlîkes gisewan, sô ik wêt, that thia sundiun skulun
65.5459: sô im fruokno tuo ferahes âhtið."
65.5460: Thie segg warð thuo an [sîðe], antat hie sittian fand
65.5462: an them stênwege, thar thiu strâta was
65.5463: felison gifuogid. Thar hie te is frôhon geng,
65.5464: sagda im thes wîƀes word. Thuo warð im [wrêð] hugi,
65.5466: giblôðit briostgithâht: was im bêðies wê,
65.5467: gie that sea ina sluogin sundia lôsan,
65.5468: gie it bi them liudion thuo forlâtan ne gidorsta
65.5469: thuru thes werodes word. Warð im giwendid thuo
65.5470: hugi an herten after thero hêri Judeono,
65.5471: te werkeanne iro willion: ne wardoda im niewiht
65.5472: thia swârun sundiun, thia hie im thar thuo selƀo gideda.
65.5473: Hiet im thuo te is handon dragan hluttran brunnion,
65.5474: watar an [wêgie], thar hie furi them werode sat,
65.5475: thwôg ina thar for thero thioda thegan kêsures,
65.5476: hard heritogo endi thuo fur thero hêri sprak,
65.5477: quað that hie ina thero sundiono thar sikoran dâdi,
65.5478: wrêðero werko: "ne williu ik thes wihtes plegan", quathie,
65.5479: "umbi thesan hêlagan mann, ak [hleotad] gi thes alles,
65.5480: gie wordo gie werko, thes gi im hêr te wîtie giduan."
65.5481: Thuo hreop all saman heriskipi Judeono,
65.5482: thiu mikila menigi, quâðun that sia weldin umbi thena man plegan
65.5483: deraƀoro dâdio: "fare is drôr oƀar ûs,
65.5484: is bluod endi is baneði endi oƀar ûsa barn sô samo,
65.5485: oƀar ûsa aƀaron thar after - wi [williat] is alles plegan", quaðun sia,
65.5486: "umbi thena slegi selƀon, - ef wi thar êniga sundia giduan!"
65.5487: Ageƀan warð thar thuo furi them Judeon allaro gumono besta
65.5492: tholoda githuldion, sô hwat sô im thiu thioda deda.
65.5493: Sia hietun ina thuo fillian, êr than sia im ferahes tuo,
65.5494: aldres âhtin, endi im undar is ôgun spiwun,
65.5495: [dedun] im that te hoske, that sia mid iro handon slôgun,
65.5496: weros an is wangun endi im is giwâdi binâmun,
65.5498: dedun im eft ôðer an thuru unhuldi;
65.5501: selƀon settean, endi gengun im thia gisîðos tuo,
65.5502: queddun ina an kuningwîsu endi thar an knio fellun,
65.5503: hnigun im mid iro hôƀdu: all was im that te hoske giduan,
65.5504: thoh hie it all githolodi, thiodo drohtin,
65.5506: Hietun sia thuo wirkian wâpnes eggion
65.5508: kraftiga] krûci endi hietun sia Cristan thuo,
65.5510: dragan hietun sia ûsan drohtin, thar hie [bedrôragad skolda]
65.5512: weros an willon, lêddun waldand Crist,
65.5513: drohtin te dôðe. Thar mohta man thuo dereƀi thing
65.5516: thia fan Galilea mid im gangan quâmun,
65.5517: folgodun oƀar ferrwegos: was im iro frôhon dôð
65.5518: swîðo an soragan. Thuo hie selƀo sprak,
65.5519: barno that besta endi under bak besah,
65.5520: hiet that sia ni wêpin: "ni tharf iu wiht tregan", quathie,
65.5521: "mînero hinferdio, ak gi mid hofnu mugun
65.5523: tornon trahnon. Noh wirðið thiu tîd kuman,
65.5525: brûdi Judeono, them gio barn ni warð
65.5526: ôdan an aldre. Than gi iuwa inwid skulun
65.5527: grimmo angeldan; than gi sô gerna sind,
65.5528: that iu hier bihlîdan hôha bergos,
65.5529: diopo bedelƀan; dôð wâri iu than allon
65.5530: lioƀera an theson lande than sulik liudio [qualm]
65.5531: te githolianne, sô hier than thesaro thioda kumid."

66.5532: Thuo sia thar an griete galgon rihtun,
66.5534: bôm an berege, endi thar an that barn godes
66.5535: quelidun an krûcie: slôgun kald îsarn,
66.5537: hardo mid hamuron thuru is hendi endi [thuru is] fuoti,
66.5538: bittra bendi: is blôd ran an erða,
66.5539: drôr fan ûson drohtine. Hie ni welda thoh thia dâd wrekan
66.5540: grimma an them Judeon, ak hie [thes] god fader
66.5541: mahtigna bad, that hie ni wâri them manno folke,
66.5542: them werode thiu [wrêðra]: "hwand sia ni witun, hwat sia [duot]", quathie.
66.5545: thes rîken girôbi. Thia rinkos ni mahtun
66.5547: êr sia an iro [hwaraƀe] hlôtos wurpun,
66.5548: hwilik iro skoldi hebbian thia hêlagun pêda,
66.5550: hiet thuo, the heritogo, oƀar them [hôƀde selƀes]
66.5551: [Cristes an] krûce skrîƀan, that that wâri kuning Judeono,
66.5552: Jesus fan Nazarethburh, thie thar neglid stuod
66.5554: an bômin treo. Thuo bâdun thia liudi
66.5555: that word wendian, quâðun that hie im sô an is willeon sprâki,
66.5556: selƀo sagdi, that hie habdi thes gisîðes giwald,
66.5557: kuning wâri oƀar Judeon. Thuo sprak eft thie kêsures bodo,
66.5558: hard heritogo: "it ist iu sô oƀar is hôƀde giskriƀan,
66.5559: wîslîko giwuritan, sô ik it nu wendian ni mag."
66.5560: Dâdun thuo thar te wîtie [werod] Judeono
66.5561: twêna fartalda man an twâ halƀa
66.5562: Cristes an krûci: lietun sia [qualm] tholon
66.5566: grottun ina mid gelpu: sâwun allaro gumono then beston
66.5567: quelan an themo krûcie: "ef thu sîs kuning oƀar all", quâðun sia,
66.5569: neri thik fan thero nôdi endi nîðes atuomi,
66.5570: gang thi hêl herod; than welliat an thik heliðo barn,
66.5571: thesa liudi gilôƀian." Sum imo ôk lastar sprak
66.5572: swîðo gêlhert Judeo, thar hie fur them galgon stuod:
66.5573: "wah warð thesaro weroldi", quathie, "ef thu iro skoldis giwald êgan.
66.5574: Thu sagdas that thu mahtis an ênon dage all tewerpan
66.5576: stênwerko mêst endi eft standan giduon
66.5577: an thriddion dage, sô is elkor ni thorfti bithîhan mann
66.5578: theses folkes furðor. Sînu hwô thu nu gifastnod stês,
66.5579: swîðo gisêrid: ni maht thi selƀon wiht
66.5580: balowes gibuotian." Thuo thar ôk an them bendion sprak
66.5581: thero theoƀo ôðer, all sô hie thia thioda gihôrda,
66.5582: wrêðon wordon - ne was is willio guod,
66.5583: thes thegnes githâht -: "ef thu sîs thiodkuning", quathie,
66.5584: "Crist, godes suno, gang thi [than] fan them krûce niðer,
66.5585: slôpi thi fan them sîmon endi ûs samad allon
66.5586: hilp endi hêli. Ef thu sîs heƀankuning,
66.5587: waldand thesaro weroldes, giduo it than an thînon werkon skîn,
66.5588: mâri thik fur thesaro menigi." Thuo sprak thero manno ôðer
66.5589: an thero henginna, thar hie giheftid stuod,
66.5590: wan wunderquâla: "behuî wilt thu sulik word sprekan,
66.5591: gruotis ina mid gelpu? stês thi hier an galgen haft,
66.5592: [gibrôkan] an bôme. Wit hier bêðia tholod
66.5593: sêr thuru unka sundiun: is unk unkero selƀero dâd
66.5594: worðan te wîtie. Hie stêd hier wammes lôs,
66.5595: allaro sundiono sikur, sô hie selƀo gio
66.5596: firina ni gifrumida, botan that hie thuru theses folkes nið
66.5597: willendi an thesaro weruldi wîti antfâhid.
66.5598: Ik williu thar gilôƀian tuo", quathie, "endi williu thena landes ward,
66.5600: that thu mîn gihuggies endi an helpun sîs,
66.5601: râdendero best, than thu an thîn rîki kumis:
66.5602: wes mi than ginâðig." Thuo sprak im eft neriendo Crist
66.5603: wordon tegegnes: "ik seggiu thi te wâron hier", quathie,
66.5604: "[that thu noh hiudu môst an himilrîke]
66.5606: an themo paradyse, thoh thu nu an sulikoro pînu sîs."
66.5607: Than stuod thar ôk Maria, muoder Cristes,
66.5608: blêk under them bôme, gisah iro barn tholon,
66.5609: winnan wunderquâla. Ôk wârun thar wîf mid iro
66.5611: than stuod thar ôk Johannes, jungro Cristes,
66.5612: hriwi undar is hêrren, was im is hugi sêrag -
66.5613: [drûƀodun fur] them dôðe. Thar sprak drohtin Crist
66.5614: mahtig te thero muoder: "nu ik thi hier mînemo skal
66.5615: jungron befelhan, them thi hier geginward stêd:
66.5616: [wis] thi an is gisîðie samad: thu skalt ina furi suno hebbian."
66.5617: Grôtta hie thuo Johannes, [hiet] that hie iru fulgengi [wel],
66.5618: minniodi sia sô [mildo], sô man is muoder skal,
66.5619: idis unwamma. Thuo hie sia an is êra antfeng
66.5620: thuru hluttran hugi, sô im is hêrro gibôd.

67.5621: Thuo warð thar an middian dag [mahtig] têkan,
67.5623: thuo man thena godes suno an thena galgon huof,
67.5624: Crist an that krûci: thuo warð it kûð oƀar all,
67.5625: hwô thiu sunna warð gisworkan: ni mahta suigli lioht
67.5627: thimm endi thiustri endi [sô githrusmod neƀal].
67.5629: oƀar [thesan] wîdun weruld, sô lango sô waldand Crist
67.5630: qual an themo krûcie, kuningo rîkost,
67.5631: ant nuon dages. Thuo thie neƀal tiskrêd,
67.5632: that giswerk warð thuo teswungan, bigan sunnun lioht
67.5633: hêdron an himile. Thuo hreop [up] te gode
67.5634: allaro kuningo kraftigost, thuo hie an themo krûcie stuod
67.5636: "te huî thu mik sô farlieti, lieƀo drohtin,
67.5637: hêlag heƀankuning, endi thîna helpa dedos,
67.5638: fullisti sô ferr? Ik [standu] under theson fîondon hier
67.5640: hlôgun is im thuo te hoske: gihôrdun thena hêlagun Crist,
67.5641: drohtin furi them dôðe drinkan biddian,
67.5642: quað that ina thurstidi. Thiu thioda ne latta,
67.5643: wrêða wiðarsakon: was im willeo mikil,
67.5644: hwat sia im bittres [tuo] bringan mahtin.
67.5645: Habdun im unsuôti ekid endi galla
67.5646: gimengid thia mênhwaton; stuod [ên] mann garo,
67.5647: swîðo skuldig skaðo, thena habdun sia giskerid te thiu,
67.5648: farspanan mid sprâkon, that hie sia en êna spunsia nam,
67.5649: lîðo thes lêðosten, druog it an [ênon] langan skafte,
67.5650: gibundan an ênon bôme endi deda it them barne godes,
67.5651: mahtigon te mûðe. Hie ankenda iro mirkiun dâdi,
67.5653: is sô] bittres anbîtan, ak hreop that barn godes
67.5654: hlûdo te them himiliskon fader: "ik an thina hendi [befilhu",] quathie,
67.5655: "mînon gêst an godes willion; hie ist nu garo te thiu,
67.5657: gihnêgida thuo is hôƀid, hêlagon âðom
67.5658: liet fan themo lîkhamen. Sô thuo thie landes ward
67.5659: swalt an them sîmon, sô warð sân after thiu
67.5663: hrisidun thia hôhun bergos, harda stênos kluƀun,
67.5664: felisos after them felde, endi that [fêha lakan] tebrast
67.5665: an middion an twê, that êr managan dag
67.5666: an themo wîhe innan wundron gistriunid
67.5667: hêl hangoda - ni muostun heliðo barn,
67.5668: thia liudi skawon, hwat under themo lakane was
67.5669: hêlages behangan: thuo mohtun an that horð sehan
67.5671: dôdero manno, endi sia thuru drohtines kraft
67.5673: [up] fan erðu endi wurðun giôgida thar
67.5674: mannon te mârðu. That was sô mahtig thing,
67.5676: sô filo thes gifuolian, [thie] gio mid firihon ne sprak
67.5677: word an thesaro weroldi. Werod Judeono
67.5678: sâwun seldlîk thing, ak was im iro slîði hugi
67.5679: sô farhardod an iro herten, that thar io sô hêlag ni warð
67.5680: têkan gitôgid, that sia trûodin thiu bat
67.5681: an thia Cristes kraft, that hie kuning oƀar all,
67.5682: thes werodes wâri. Suma sia thar mid iro wordon gisprâkun,
67.5683: thia thes hrêwes thar huodian skoldun,
67.5684: that that wâri te wâren waldandes suno,
67.5685: godes gegnungo, that thar an them galgon swalt,
67.5686: barno that besta. Slôgun an iro briost filo
67.5687: wôpiandero wîƀo: was im thiu wunderquâla
67.5688: harm an iro herten endi iro hêrren dôð
67.5689: swîðo an sorogon. Than was sido Judeono,
67.5690: that sia thia [haftun thuru thena hêlagon dag] hangon ni [lietin]
67.5691: lengerun hwîla, [than] im that lîf skriði,
67.5693: gengun im mid nîðskipiu nâhor, thar [sô beneglida stuodun
67.5695: quâla bi Criste: wârun im quika noh than,
67.5696: untthat sia thia grimmun Judeo liudi
67.5697: bênon bebrâkon, that sia bêðia samad
67.5699: Sia ni thorftun drohtin Crist dôðes bêdian
67.5700: furðor mid ênigon firinon: fundun ina gifaranan thuo iu:
67.5701: is seola was gisendid an suoðan weg,
67.5702: an langsam lioht, is liði kuolodun,
67.5703: that [ferah] was af them [flêske.] Thuo geng im ên thero fîondo tuo
67.5705: hard an is handon, mid heruthrummeon stak,
67.5707: that an selƀes warð sîdu Cristes
67.5708: antlokan is lîkhamo. Thia liudi gisâwun,
67.5709: that thanan bluod endi water bêðiu sprungun,
67.5710: wellun fan thero wundun, all sô is willio geng
67.5711: endi hie habda [gimarkod êr] manno kunnie,
67.5712: firiho barnon te frumu: thuo was it all gifullid sô.

68.5713: Sô thuo gisêgid warð seðle nâhor
68.5715: an them druoƀen dage, thuo geng im ûses drohtines thegan
68.5716: - was im glau gumo, jungro Cristes
68.5717: managa hwîla, sô it thar manno filo
68.5718: ne wissa te wâron, hwand hie it mid is wordon hal
68.5720: darnungo was hie ûses drohtines jungro: hie ni welda thero farduanun thiod
68.5721: [folgon] te ênigon firinwerkon, ak hie bêd im under them folke Judeono,
68.5722: hêlag himilo rîkies - hie geng im thuo wið thena heritogon mahlian,
68.5723: thingon wið thena thegan kêsures, thigida ina gerno,
68.5724: that hie muosti alôsian thena lîkhamon
68.5725: Cristes fan themo krûcie, thie thar giquelmid stuod,
68.5726: thes guoden fan them galgen endi an graf leggian,
68.5727: foldu bifelahan. Im ni welda thie folktogo thuo
68.5728: wernian thes willien, ak im giwald fargaf,
68.5729: that hie sô muosti gifrummian. Hie giwêt im thuo forð thanan
68.5730: gangan te them galgon, thar hie [wissa that godes barn,]
68.5732: nam ina thuo [an] thero niuwun ruodun endi ina fan naglon atuomda,
68.5733: antfeng ina mid is faðmon, sô man is frôhon skal,
68.5734: lioƀes lîkhamon, endi ina an lîne biwand,
68.5735: druog ina diurlîko - sô was thie drohtin werð -,
68.5736: thar sia thia stedi haƀdun an ênon stêne innan
68.5737: handon gihauwan, thar gio heliðo barn
68.5738: gumon ne bigruoƀon. Thar sia [that godes barn]
68.5740: foldu bifulhun endi mid ênu felisu belukun
68.5743: thes gumen grimman dôð. Giwitun [im] thuo gangan thanan
68.5745: [hwô sia eft te them graƀe] gangan mahtin:
68.5747: mikila muodkara: Maria wârun sia hêtana,
68.5748: idisi armskapana. Thuo warð âƀand kuman,
68.5751: rekidun an rûnon: "hwat, thu wêst, hwô thit rîki was
68.5752: thuru thesan ênan man all gitwîflid,
68.5753: werod giworran: nu ligid hie wundon siok,
68.5754: diopa bidolƀan. Hie sagda [simnen], [that hie skoldi fan dôðe astandan]
68.5755: [an thriddian dage.] Thius thiod gilôƀit te filo,
68.5756: thit werod after is wordon. Nu thu hier wardon hêt,
68.5757: oƀar them graƀe gômian, that ina is jungron thar
68.5758: ne farstelan an themo stêne endi seggian than, that hie astandan sî,
68.5759: rîki fan raston: than wirðit thit rinko folk
68.5760: mêr gimerrid, ef [sia it biginnat] mârian hier."
68.5761: Thuo wurðun thar giskerida fan thero skolu Judeono
68.5762: weros te thero wahtu: giwitun im mid iro giwâpnion tharod
68.5763: te them graƀe gangan, thar sia skoldun thes godes barnes
68.5765: Judeono fargangan. Sia oƀar themo graƀe sâtun,
68.5767: bidun undar iro bordon, hwan êr thie berehto dag
68.5769: liudon te liohte. Thuo ni was lang te thiu,
68.5770: that thar warð thie gêst kuman be godes krafte,
68.5771: hâlag âðom undar thena hardon stên
68.5772: an [thena] lîkhamon. Lioht was thuo giopanod
68.5773: [firiho] barnon te frumu: was ferkal manag
68.5774: antheftid fan [helldoron] endi te himile weg
68.5775: giwaraht fan thesaro weroldi. Wânom [up] astuod
68.5776: friðubarn godes, fuor im thuo thar hie welda,
68.5777: sô thia wardos thes wiht ni afsuoƀun,
68.5778: [derƀia] liudi, hwan hie fan them dôðe astuod,
68.5779: arês fan thero rastun. Rinkos sâtun
68.5780: umbi that graf ûtan, Judeo liudi,
68.5781: skola mid iro skildion. Skrêd forðwardes
68.5783: te them graƀe gangan, gumkunnies wîf,
68.5786: werðes wiðer wurtion, sô sia mahtun awinnan mêst,
68.5787: that sia thena lîkhamon lioƀes hêrren,
68.5790: an iro seƀon swîðo, endi suma sprâkun,
68.5791: huie im thena grôtan stên fan themo graƀe skoldi
68.5792: gihwereƀian an halƀa, the sia oƀar that hrêo sâwun
68.5793: thia liudi leggian, thuo sia thena lîkhamon thar
68.5794: befulhun an themo felise. Sô thiu frî haƀdun
68.5795: gegangan te them gardon, that sia te them graƀe mahtun
68.5796: gisehan selƀon, thuo thar suôgan quam
68.5797: engil thes alowaldon oƀana fan radure,
68.5798: faran an feðerhamon, that all thiu folda [an skian,]
68.5799: thiu erða dunida endi thia erlos wurðun
68.5801: bifellun bi them forahton: ne wândun ira [ferah] êgan,

69.5804: thie grôto stên fan them graƀe, sô ina thie godes engil
69.5805: gihweriƀida an halƀa, endi im uppan them [hlêwe] gisat
69.5806: diurlîk drohtines bodo. Hie was an is dâdion gelîk,
69.5807: an is ansiunion, sô huem sô ina [muosta] undar is ôgon skawon,
69.5808: sô [bereht] endi sô blîði all sô [bliksmun] lioht;
69.5810: [snêwe gilîkost. Thuo sâwun sia ina sittian thar,]
69.5811: thiu wîf uppan them giwendidan stêne, endi im fan them wlitie [quâmun,]
69.5812: them idison sulika egison [tegegnes: all wurðun fan them grurie
69.5813: thiu frî an forahton mikilon,] furðor ne gidorstun
69.5814: [te themo graƀe gangan, êr sia thie godes engil],
69.5816: quað that hie iro ârundi all bikunsti,
69.5817: werk endi willion endi thero wîƀo hugi,
69.5818: hiet that sia im ne andrêdin: "ik wêt that gi iuwan drohtin suokat,
69.5820: thena thi hier quelidun endi an krûci slôgun
69.5821: Judeo liudi endi an graf lagdun
69.5823: ak hie ist astandan iu, endi sind thesa stedi lârea,
69.5824: thit graf an theson griote. Nu mugun gi gangan herod
69.5825: nâhor mikilu - ik wêt that is iu ist niud sehan
69.5826: an theson stêne innan -: hier sind noh thia stedi skîna,
69.5827: thar is lîkhamo lag." Lungra fengun
69.5828: gibada an iro brioston blêka idisi,
69.5829: wlitiskôni wîf: was im wilspell mikil
69.5830: te gihôrianne, that im fan iro [hêrren] sagda
69.5831: engil thes alowalden. Hiet sia eft thanan
69.5832: fan them graƀe gangan endi faran te them jungron Cristes,
69.5833: seggian them is gisîðon suoðon wordon,
69.5834: that iro drohtin was fan dôðe astandan.
69.5835: Hiet ôk an sundron Sîmon Petruse
69.5838: [was an] Galileo land, "thar ina eft is jungron skulun,
69.5839: gisehan is [gisîðos], sô hie im êr selƀo gisprak
69.5840: wâron wordon." Reht sô thuo thiu wîf thanan
69.5841: gangan weldun, sô stuodun im tegegnes thar
69.5843: wânamon giwâdion endi sprâkun [im] mid iro wordon tuo
69.5845: then idison an egison: ne mahtun an thia engilos godes
69.5846: bi themo wlite skawon: was im thiu wânami te strang,
69.5847: te swîði te sehanne. Thuo sprâkun im sân angegin
69.5848: waldandes bodun endi thiu wîf frâgodun,
69.5849: te huî sia Cristan tharod quikan mid dôdon,
69.5851: ferahes fullan; "nu gi ina ni findat hier
69.5852: an theson stêngraƀe, ak hie ist astandan [nu]
69.5853: an is lîkhamen: thes gi gilôƀian skulun
69.5854: endi gihuggian thero wordo, the hie iu te wâron oft
69.5855: selƀo sagda, [than] hie an iuwon gisîðe was
69.5856: an [Galilealande,] hwô hie skoldi gigeƀan werðan,
69.5859: that sia ina quelidin endi an krûci [slôgin,]
69.5860: dôdan gidâdin endi that hie skoldi thuru drohtines kraft
69.5861: an thriddion dage thioda te willion
69.5862: libbiandi astandan. Nu haƀit hie all gilêstid sô,
69.5863: gifrumid mid firihon: îliat gi nu forð hinan,
69.5864: gangat gâhlîko endi duot it them is jungron kûð.

70.5865: Hie haƀit sia iu furfarana endi ist im forð hinan
70.5866: an Galileo land, thar ina eft is jungron skulun,
70.5867: gisehan is gisîðos." Thuo warð [sân] after thiu
70.5868: them wiƀon an willon, that sia gihôrdun sulik word sprekan,
70.5869: kûðian thia kraft godes - wârun im sô akumana thuo noh
70.5870: gie sô forahta gefrumida -: giwitun im forð thanan
70.5871: fan them graƀe gangan endi sagdun them jungron Cristes
70.5873: bidun sulikero buota. Thuo wurðun ôk an thia burg [kumana]
70.5874: Judeono wardos, thia oƀar themo graƀe sâtun
70.5875: alla [langa] naht endi thes lîkhamen thar,
70.5876: huodun [thes] hrêwes. Sia sagdun thero hêri Judeono,
70.5877: hwilika im thar andwarda egison quâmun,
70.5879: al sô it giduan was an thero drohtines kraft,
70.5880: ni miðun an iro muode. Thuo budun im mêðmo filo
70.5882: saldun im sink manag, [te thiu that] sia it ni sagdin forð,
70.5883: ne mâridin thero menigi: "ak queðat that iu môði hugi
70.5884: answeƀidi mid slâpu endi that thar quâmin [is] gisîðos tuo,
70.5885: farstâlin ina an them stêne. Simnen wesat gi an strîde mid thiu,
70.5886: forð an flîte: ef it wirðit them folktogen kûð,
70.5887: wi gihelpat iu wið thena [hêrosten,] that hie iu harmes wiht,
70.5888: lêðes ni gilêstid." Thuo nâmun sia an them liudon filo
70.5889: [diurero mêðmo,] dâdun all sô sia bigunnun
70.5890: - ne giweldun iro willion - [dâdun sô wîdo] kûð
70.5891: them liudon after them lande, that sia sulika lugina woldun
70.5892: ahebbian be than hêlagan drohtin. [Than] was eft gihêlid [hugi]
70.5893: jungron Cristes, thuo sia [gihôrdun] thiu guodun wîf
70.5894: mârian [thia] maht godes; thuo wârun sia an iro muode frâha,
70.5895: gie im te them graƀe bêðia, Johannes endi Petrus
70.5897: Johannes thie guodo, endi im oƀar them graƀe gistuod,
70.5898: antat thar sân after quam Sîmon Petrus,
70.5899: erl ellanruof endi im thar in giwêt
70.5900: an that graf gangan: gisah thar thes godes barnes,
70.5902: lînin liggian, mid thiu was êr thie lîkhamo
70.5903: fagaro bifangan; lag thie fano sundar,
70.5904: mit them was that hôƀid bihelid hêlages Cristes,
70.5905: rîkies drohtines, [than] hie an thesaro rastu was.
70.5906: Thuo geng im ôk Johannes an that graf innan
70.5907: sehan seldlîk thing; warð im sân after thiu
70.5908: antlokan is gilôƀo, [that hie wissa,] that skolda eft an thit lioht kuman
70.5909: is drohtin diurlîko, fan dôðe astandan
70.5910: [up] fan erðu. Thuo giwitun im eft thanan
70.5911: Johannes endi Petrus, endi quâmun thia jungron Cristes,
70.5912: thia gisîðos tesamne. Than stuod sêragmuod
70.5914: griotandi oƀar them graƀe, was iro [jâmar muod -]
70.5915: Maria was that Magdalena -, was iro muodgithâht,
70.5916: [seƀo] mit [sorogon] giblandan, ne wissa hwarod siu sôkian skolda
70.5917: thena hêrron, thar iro wârun at thia helpa gilanga. Siu ni mohta thuo hofnu awîsan,
70.5918: that wîf ni mahta wôp forlâtan: ne wissa hwarod siu sia wendian skolda;
70.5919: gimerrid wârun iro thes muodgithâhti. Thuo gisah siu thena [mahtigan thar]
70.5921: seggian that hie it selƀo wâri. Hie frâgoda hwat siu sô sêro biwiepi,
70.5922: sô harmo mid hêton trahnin. Siu quað, that siu umbi iro hêrron ni [wissi]
70.5923: te wâren, hwarod hie werðan skoldi: "ef thu ina mi giwîsan mohtis,
70.5924: frô mîn, ef ik thik frâgon gidorsti, ef thu ina hier an theson felise ginâmis,
70.5925: wîsi ina mi mid wordon thînon: than wâri mi allaro williono mêsta,
70.5926: that ik ina selƀo gisâhi." Sia ni wissa, [that] sia thie suno drohtines
70.5927: gruotta mid gôdaro sprâkun: siu wânda that it thie gardari wâri,
70.5928: hofward hêrren sînes. Thuo gruotta sia thie hêlago drohtin,
70.5929: bi namen neriendero best: siu geng im thuo nâhor sniumo,
70.5930: that wîf mid willion guodan, antkenda iro waldand selƀan,
70.5931: [mîðan] siu is thuru thia minnia ni wissa: welda ina mid iro [mundon] grîpan,
70.5932: [thiu fêhmia] an thena folko drohtin, noƀan that iro friðubarn godes
70.5933: werida mid wordon sînon, quað that siu ina mid wihti ni môsti
70.5934: handon anthrînan: "ik ni stêg noh", quathie, "te them himiliskon fader;
70.5935: ak îli thu nu ofstlîko endi them erlon kûði,
70.5936: bruoðron mînon, that ik ûser bêðero fader,

71.5939: That wîf warð thuo an wunnon, that siu muosta sulikan willion kûðian,
71.5940: seggian fan im gisundon: warð sân garo
71.5941: thiu idis an that ârundi endi them erlon brâhta,
71.5943: gisundan gisâwi, endi sagda hwô [he] iru selƀo gibôd
71.5944: torohtero têkno. Sia ni weldun gitrûoian thuo noh
71.5945: thes wîbes wordon, that siu sulik willspel brâhte
71.5946: gegnungo fan themo godes [suno], ak sia sâtun im iâmormuoda,
71.5947: heliðos [hriwonda.] Thuo warð thie hêlago Crist
71.5949: drohtin gitôgid, sîðor hie fan dôðe astuod,
71.5950: than wîƀon an willion, that hie im thar an wege muotta.
71.5951: Quedda sia kûðlîko, endi sia te is kneohon hnigun,
71.5952: fellun im tô fuoton. Hie hêt that sia forahtan hugi
71.5953: ne bârin an iro brioston: "ak gi mînon bruoðron skulun
71.5954: thesa quidi kûðian, that sia kuman after mi
71.5955: an Galileo land; thar ik im eft tegegnes biun."
71.5956: Than fuorun im ôk fan Hierusalem thero jungrono twêna
71.5957: an them selƀon daga sân [an] morgan,
71.5958: erlos an iro ârundi: weldun im te Emaus
71.5959: that kastel suokan. Thuo bigunnun im quidi managa
71.5960: under them weron wahsan, thar sia after them wege fuorun,
71.5961: them heliðon umbi iro hêrron. Thuo quam im thar thie hêlago tuo
71.5962: gangandi godes suno. Sia ni mahtun ina garolîko
71.5963: antkennan kraftigna: hie ni welda ina thuo noh kûðian te im;
71.5964: was im [thoh] an iro gisîðie samad endi frâgoda, umbi hwilika sia saka sprâkin:
71.5965: "huî gangat gi sô gornondia?" quathie. "Ist ink iâmer hugi,
71.5966: seƀo soragono full." Sia sprâkun im sân angegin,
71.5967: thia erlos andwurdi: "te huî thu thes [êskos sô]", quâðun sia;
71.5970: [mid them grôtun godes kraft."] Nam is jungaron thô,
71.5971: erlos gôde, lêdda sie ût thanan,
71.5972: antat he sie brâhte an Bethania;
71.5973: thar hôf he is hendi up endi hêlegoda sie alle,
71.5974: wîhida sie mid is wordun. Giwêt imo up thanan,
71.5975: sôhta imo that hôha himilo rîki endi thena is hêlagon stôl:
71.5976: sitit imo [thar] an thea swîðron half godes,
71.5977: alomahtiges fader endi thanan all gesihit
71.5978: waldandeo Crist, sô hwat sô thius werold behaƀet.
71.5979: Thô an theru selƀon stedi gesîðos gôde
71.5980: te bedu fellun endi im eft te burg thanan
71.5982: fôrun faganondi: was im frâhmod hugi,
71.5983: wârun im thar at themu wîhe. Waldandes kraft
